zh-Hans.translation: {0} 个 {1} 个框后取消审核；部分进度已保存。

zh-Hans.source: Audited all {0} boxels and saved the refreshed progress.
zh-Hans.translation: 审核了所有 {0} 框并保存刷新的进度。
审核了所有带有 {1} 警告的 {0} 框。

zh-Hans.source: Author the scanned obelisk, log, and required artifact metadata used when publishing an unpublished site survey.
zh-Hans.translation: 创作发布未发布的站点调查时使用的扫描方尖碑、日志和所需工件元数据。

zh-Hans.source: Auto add tracker location when Composition scanning organisms.
zh-Hans.translation: 构图扫描生物体时自动添加跟踪器位置。

zh-Hans.source: Auto remove tracker location when sampling an organism within 250 m.
zh-Hans.translation: 对 250 m 范围内的生物体进行采样时，自动移除跟踪器位置。

zh-Hans.source: Auto remove tracker locations upon final scan
zh-Hans.translation: 最终扫描时自动删除跟踪器位置

zh-Hans.source: Auto zoom map if within 30 m of obelisks
zh-Hans.translation: 方尖碑 30 m 范围内自动缩放地图

zh-Hans.source: Auto-copy is mutually exclusive with Route Manager and FC Routes so only one Galaxy Map destination source can control the clipboard.
zh-Hans.translation: 自动复制与路线管理器和 FC 路线互斥，因此只有一个 Galaxy Map 目标源可以控制剪贴板。

zh-Hans.source: Auto-copy next system in Galaxy Map
zh-Hans.translation: 自动复制银河地图中的下一个系统
如果在建筑物内则自动缩放
使用分析工具自动缩放
重复时自动隐藏生物图
没有起落架时自动隐藏地面雷达
在最终样本上自动删除跟踪器
采样时自动删除跟踪器

zh-Hans.source: Automatic Fleet Carrier cargo sync is off.
zh-Hans.translation: 自动舰队承运商货物同步已关闭。

zh-Hans.source: Automatic detection is available on Windows. Use Choose folder for copied profiles, older installs, or migration on Linux.
zh-Hans.translation: Windows 上可以进行自动检测。在 Linux 上使用“选择文件夹”来复制配置文件、旧版安装或迁移。

zh-Hans.source: Automatic replacement is disabled because this copy was not launched from a checksum-indexed release package. Open the releases page to install manually.
zh-Hans.translation: 自动替换被禁用，因为该副本不是从校验和索引的发行包启动的。打开发布页面以手动安装。

zh-Hans.source: Automatic restart failed: {0} Close and reopen SrvSurvey manually; the verified import is safe.
zh-Hans.translation: 自动重启失败：{0}手动关闭并重新打开SrvSurvey；经验证的进口是安全的。

zh-Hans.source: Automatic rollback was incomplete; use the before-restore files to recover the previous data.
zh-Hans.translation: 自动回滚不完全；使用恢复前的文件恢复之前的数据。

zh-Hans.source: Automatic ship cargo publishing is off.
zh-Hans.translation: 自动船舶货物发布已关闭。

zh-Hans.source: Automatic ship cargo publishing, Fleet Carrier publishing, system updates, and Green Gas Giant publication each have their own gates.
zh-Hans.translation: 自动船舶货物发布、舰队承运人发布、系统更新和绿色气体巨人发布各有其自己的大门。

zh-Hans.source: Automatic updates are supported only on Windows and Linux.
zh-Hans.translation: 仅 Windows 和 Linux 支持自动更新。

zh-Hans.source: Automatically clear saved rigs when you board your own ship or dock the Rhino. Send --- in game chat to clear all bookmarks and rigs on the current body at any time.
zh-Hans.translation: 当您登上自己的船或停靠犀牛时，自动清除已保存的装备。在游戏聊天中发送---可以随时清除当前机体上的所有书签和装备。

zh-Hans.source: Automatically track rigs from the Rhino HUD
zh-Hans.translation: 从 Rhino HUD 自动跟踪装备

zh-Hans.source: Back up and replace Elite's VisitedStarsCache.dat with the 3,500 closest known systems from EDGalaxy.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用 EDGalaxy 中 3,500 个最接近的已知系统备份并替换 Elite 的 VisitedStarsCache.dat。

zh-Hans.source: Back up commander mining history, missions, settings, local discoveries, shared bookmarks and attached screenshots in one ZIP. Restore replaces mining data and shared bookmarks with the backup contents, retaining the previous files for recovery.
zh-Hans.translation: 在一个 ZIP 中备份指挥官采矿历史、任务、设置、本地发现、共享书签和附加屏幕截图。恢复将挖掘数据和共享书签替换为备份内容，并保留以前的文件进行恢复。

zh-Hans.source: Background and alignment changes preview immediately on the map. They remain part of this draft until the complete map catalog is saved.
zh-Hans.translation: 背景和路线更改会立即在地图上预览。它们仍然是该草稿的一部分，直到保存完整的地图目录。

zh-Hans.source: Before creation, SrvSurvey reads the Raven system sites and records the persisted ID of the first site.
zh-Hans.translation: 在创建之前，SrvSurvey 读取 Raven 系统站点并记录第一个站点的持久 ID。
生物信号半径（生物体样本范围）
生物信号和生物学预测

zh-Hans.source: Bio signals and biology system overlays
zh-Hans.translation: 生物信号和生物系统叠加
生物信号和未解决的生物学
生物确认潜力细​​分边缘
生物银河区域潜力段边缘

zh-Hans.source: Biological signal cannot be identified from current data.
zh-Hans.translation: 无法从当前数据中识别生物信号。

zh-Hans.source: Biological targets not listed by route
zh-Hans.translation: 未按路线列出的生物目标
生物系统和身体细节叠加

zh-Hans.source: Biology, Guardian, body and system rows
zh-Hans.translation: 生物、守护者、身体和系统行

zh-Hans.source: Biology, culture, history, language, and technology records
zh-Hans.translation: 生物、文化、历史、语言和技术记录

zh-Hans.source: Blank shared-map draft started. Choose a background image before saving.
zh-Hans.translation: 空白共享地图草稿已开始。保存前选择背景图像。
蓝色财富公司|无政府状态
蓝色财富公司 · 无政府状态

zh-Hans.source: Body availability follows the Surface Hunt location reference. Sell prices retain the community snapshot and can change.
zh-Hans.translation: 车身可用性遵循 Surface Hunt 位置参考。销售价格保留社区快照并且可以更改。

zh-Hans.source: Body count for that type ÷ systems recorded
zh-Hans.translation: 该类型的死亡人数 ÷ 记录的系统数

zh-Hans.source: Body destination progress could not be saved: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法保存正文目标进度：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Body import cancelled; Raven Colonial was not changed.
zh-Hans.translation: 车身进口取消； Raven Colonial 未更改。

zh-Hans.source: Body information combines the scan, orbit, atmosphere, gravity, temperature, volcanism, materials, and reward details known so far.
zh-Hans.translation: 身体信息结合了目前已知的扫描、轨道、大气、重力、温度、火山、材料和奖励细节。

zh-Hans.source: Body is required for the selected site's catalog details.
zh-Hans.translation: 所选站点的目录详细信息需要正文。

zh-Hans.source: Body number must be -1 for unknown or a non-negative integer.
zh-Hans.translation: 对于未知或非负整数，主体编号必须为 -1。
书签已导入；保留现有地点。

zh-Hans.source: Borderless or windowed Elite modes provide the most predictable desktop overlay stacking. Exclusive fullscreen behavior depends on the operating system and compositor.
zh-Hans.translation: 无边框或窗口精英模式提供最可预测的桌面叠加堆叠。独占全屏行为取决于操作系统和合成器。

zh-Hans.source: Bounds must have a positive size.
Boxel Stats summarizes the Commander data SrvSurvey has actually recorded; it does not estimate unvisited systems from a configured search size.
zh-Hans.translation: Boxel Stats 总结了实际记录的指挥官数据SrvSurvey；它不会根据配置的搜索大小来估计未访问的系统。

zh-Hans.source: Boxel auto-copy was disabled because another Galaxy Map auto-copy setting was selected.
zh-Hans.translation: Boxel 自动复制被禁用，因为选择了另一个 Galaxy Map 自动复制设置。

zh-Hans.source: Boxel search disabled; its progress was retained.
zh-Hans.translation: Boxel 搜索已禁用；其进展被保留。

zh-Hans.source: Bring settings, commander state, surveys, routes, journeys, caches, and every other legacy profile file into the cross-platform application.
zh-Hans.translation: 将设置、指挥官状态、调查、路线、旅程、缓存和所有其他旧配置文件引入跨平台应用程序。

zh-Hans.source: Browse history, inspect every visited system, and keep the active expedition current.
zh-Hans.translation: 浏览历史记录，检查每个访问过的系统，并保持活动探险最新。

zh-Hans.source: Browse visited cubes by mass code, then open a cube for helium, body classes, and value.
zh-Hans.translation: 按质量代码浏览访问的立方体，然后打开氦气、主体类别和值的立方体。

zh-Hans.source: Build a named reference configuration from your ship's equipped modules. This does not set controls in Elite. The settings icon beside Firegroups in the sidebar opens its dedicated overlay window with enable/disable, hotkey and Overlay Exceptions. The panel follows your ship and active A–H group.
zh-Hans.translation: 从船舶配备的模块构建命名参考配置。这不会在 Elite 中设置控件。侧栏中 Firegroups 旁边的设置图标可打开其专用覆盖窗口，其中包含启用/禁用、热键和覆盖例外。该小组跟随您的舰船和活跃的 A-H 小组。

zh-Hans.source: Build a replacement shared map from scratch for this site type. Choose a background, align it, then add measured master points and group labels.
zh-Hans.translation: 为此站点类型从头开始构建替换共享地图。选择背景，对齐它，然后添加测量的主点和组标签。

zh-Hans.source: Built-in presets fill the editor without changing theme.json until you apply them. Your named states remain stored separately from the active in-game overlay palette.
zh-Hans.translation: 内置预设会填充编辑器，而不会更改 theme.json，直到您应用它们为止。您的命名状态与活动的游戏内叠加调色板分开存储。

zh-Hans.source: But keep it hidden when in the bubble near Sol
zh-Hans.translation: 但在太阳附近的气泡中时请将其隐藏

zh-Hans.source: But not if that organism has already been analyzed.
zh-Hans.translation: 但如果该生物体已经被分析过，则不然。

zh-Hans.source: By default, returning to your own ship on foot or docking the Rhino automatically clears all six rig locations because the game destroys deployed rigs then. Turn off Clear rigs automatically when boarding your ship in Surface Mining overlay settings to keep your saved markers; this preference persists between sessions. Re-entering the Rhino on foot keeps the locations; boarding a taxi or another Commander's ship does not clear them.
zh-Hans.translation: 默认情况下，步行返回自己的船或停靠犀牛会自动清除所有六个装备位置，因为游戏会销毁已部署的装备。在地表采矿覆盖设置中登船时自动关闭清除钻机，以保留保存的标记；这种偏好在会话之间持续存在。步行重新进入犀牛可以保留位置；登上出租车或其他指挥官的船并不能清除它们。
三坐标测量机复合材料

zh-Hans.source: COLLECT uses cyan when within 5 meters of a saved rig. TOO CLOSE uses red inside the 78-meter deployment exclusion distance. TRACKED means outside that distance; NOT SET means the slot has no saved location.
zh-Hans.translation: 当距已保存装备 5 米以内时，COLLECT 使用青色。 “太近”在 78 米部署排除距离内使用红色。 TRACKED 表示超出该距离； NOT SET 表示该插槽没有保存位置。
当前系统·下一个不完整的系统

zh-Hans.source: Calibration Test is a preview and never changes saved trackers. Use the editor's save button and close the editor before automatic tracking takes effect, or cancel to discard calibration changes. Start automatic tracking before deploying rigs so each position is recorded at deployment. During normal play the frame is invisible; detection results appear in Mining settings and directly below the overlay's rig trackers.
zh-Hans.translation: 校准测试是预览，永远不会更改已保存的跟踪器。使用编辑器的保存按钮并在自动跟踪生效之前关闭编辑器，或取消以放弃校准更改。在部署装备之前启动自动跟踪，以便在部署时记录每个位置。在正常播放期间，框架是不可见的；检测结果显示在采矿设置中，并位于叠加层的钻机跟踪器正下方。

zh-Hans.source: Calibration follows the game viewport when resolution changes. Check alignment after changing aspect ratio, field of view or HUD layout; update the selected color after changing HUD colors. Only calibration and the selected color are saved; screen captures are processed in memory and discarded. Audio is not captured.
zh-Hans.translation: 当分辨率改变时，校准会跟随游戏视口。更改纵横比、视野或 HUD 布局后检查对齐情况；更改 HUD 颜色后更新所选颜色。仅保存校准和所选颜色；屏幕截图在内存中处理并丢弃。未捕获音频。

zh-Hans.source: Calibration preview — saved trackers are unchanged.
zh-Hans.translation: 校准预览 - 保存的跟踪器未更改。

zh-Hans.source: Calls out the next action, selected destination, active target, route note, or focused row.
zh-Hans.translation: 调出下一个操作、选定的目的地、活动目标、路线注释或焦点行。

zh-Hans.source: Cancel audit safely retains the partial work already applied. Linked library progress and its modified date update automatically as audit results are applied.
zh-Hans.translation: 取消审核可以安全地保留已应用的部分工作。应用审核结果时，链接库进度及其修改日期会自动更新。

zh-Hans.source: Cancel overlay position, opacity, and scale changes
zh-Hans.translation: 取消叠加位置、不透明度和比例更改

zh-Hans.source: Cancelling the full-area audit after the current request…
zh-Hans.translation: 正在取消当前请求后的全区域审核...

zh-Hans.translation: Canonn 已知该身体的生物信号

zh-Hans.translation: Canonn 已知该身体的生物信号。

zh-Hans.translation: Canonn 匹配 {0} 条目并添加 {1}； {2} 名称不在本法典参考文献中。
Canonn 之前的扫描不可用：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Canonn prior scans · last sync 2 m ago
zh-Hans.translation: Canonn 先前扫描·上次同步 2 m 前
Canonn 沉降几何形状不可用：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Captured and copied the {0} cockpit offset for this session.
zh-Hans.translation: 捕获并复制了此会话的 {0} 驾驶舱偏移。

zh-Hans.source: Captured the current headset yaw as the overlay origin.
zh-Hans.translation: 捕获当前耳机偏航作为叠加原点。

zh-Hans.source: Cargo capture is paused while multiple Elite windows are running because Cargo.json cannot be attributed safely.
zh-Hans.translation: 当多个 Elite 窗口运行时，货物捕获会暂停，因为 Cargo.json 无法安全归属。

zh-Hans.source: Cargo full reminder after one minute idle
zh-Hans.translation: 闲置一分钟货物已满提醒

zh-Hans.source: Cargo is allocated to active missions in acceptance order. Delivered counts are cumulative. Completion, failure and abandonment follow journal events.
zh-Hans.translation: 货物按照验收顺序分配给现役特派团。交付的数量是累积的。完成、失败和放弃遵循日记事件。

zh-Hans.source: Cargo is full. End the session when ready.
zh-Hans.translation: 货物已满。准备好后结束会话。

zh-Hans.source: Cargo transfers and purchases do not count as mining production. Mission cargo is allocated once across active mining missions.
zh-Hans.translation: 货物转移和购买不算作采矿生产。任务货物在活跃的采矿任务中分配一次。
赶上了 {0} 旅程日志事件。
世纪哥特式、Segoe UI、无衬线体

zh-Hans.source: Changes only the displayed FSS-complete statistic. It does not affect boxel-search completion, next targets, body counts, or values.
zh-Hans.translation: 仅更改显示的 FSS 完整统计数据。它不会影响框搜索完成、下一个目标、主体计数或值。

zh-Hans.source: Changes preview live in OpenVR. Save is atomic and preserves desktop placement plus unknown overlays.
zh-Hans.translation: 更改 OpenVR 中的实时预览。保存是原子性的，保留桌面位置以及未知的覆盖层。
更改已保存。下一个系统：{0}。

zh-Hans.source: Changes were undone to the route's last saved state.
zh-Hans.translation: 对路线上次保存状态的更改已撤消。

zh-Hans.source: Changing Blue light, Blue dark, Orange dark, Green light, or Green dark for the application never rewrites theme.json or a named overlay state.
zh-Hans.translation: 更改应用程序的蓝光、蓝暗、橙暗、绿光或绿暗永远不会重写 theme.json 或指定的覆盖状态。

zh-Hans.source: Check application and reference-data releases without changing profile data.
zh-Hans.translation: 在不更改配置文件数据的情况下检查应用程序和参考数据版本。
复选框检查字形前景选中已按下
复选框检查字形前景不确定
复选框检查字形前景不确定指针上方
复选框检查字形前景不确定按下

zh-Hans.source: Checking and validating published reference data...
zh-Hans.translation: 检查并验证已发布的参考数据...

zh-Hans.source: Checking for other running SrvSurvey instances...
zh-Hans.translation: 正在检查其他正在运行的 SrvSurvey 实例...

zh-Hans.source: Checking whether another SrvSurvey instance must close before the update.
zh-Hans.translation: 检查更新之前是否必须关闭另一个 SrvSurvey 实例。
正在检查 {0} 市场货物...

zh-Hans.source: Checks checksum-indexed SrvSurvey-XP packages. The check never installs files or changes profile data.
zh-Hans.translation: 检查校验和索引的 SrvSurvey-XP 软件包。该检查不会安装文件或更改配置文件数据。

zh-Hans.source: Checks saved system history, the current NavRoute, empty-boxel records, and Spansh across all {0} boxels. Network requests run sequentially; cancellation keeps completed audit progress.
zh-Hans.translation: 检查已保存的系统历史记录、当前 NavRoute、空框记录以及所有 {0} 框中的 Spansh。网络请求按顺序运行；取消会保留已完成的审核进度。

zh-Hans.source: Choose Application, Desktop, Global overlays, Input, Privacy & sharing, Screenshots, or Data & migration from the Settings column.
zh-Hans.translation: 从“设置”列中选择“应用程序”、“桌面”、“全局覆盖”、“输入”、“隐私和共享”、“屏幕截图”或“数据和迁移”。

zh-Hans.source: Choose Confirm removal to permanently remove this quest progress. A local development quest is backed up first.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择确认删除以永久删除此任务进度。首先支持本地开发任务。

zh-Hans.source: Choose Edit Overlay Positions to load categorized previews from an isolated simulated game state. Elite does not need to be running.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择“编辑叠加位置”以从隔离的模拟游戏状态加载分类预览。精英不需要跑步。

zh-Hans.source: Choose Lowest mass code. Keeping it equal to the top system's mass code searches only that boxel; choosing a lower letter includes every nested child down to that level. Check the displayed boxel count before continuing.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择最低质量代码。保持它等于顶部系统的质量代码仅搜索该框；选择较小的字母包括该级别以下的每个嵌套子级。在继续之前检查显示的框元素计数。

zh-Hans.source: Choose Make primary on the intended project before focusing the shopping plan.
zh-Hans.translation: 在重点关注购物计划之前，选择“将主要项目放在预期项目上”。

zh-Hans.source: Choose Reinforce, Undermine or Acquire and your pledged Power. Powerplay journal events fill the pledge when available; you can select it manually. Reinforce matches known ownership by your Power; Undermine matches another known Power. Acquire shows explicitly unoccupied/expansion candidates, not unknown ownership.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择“强化”、“削弱”或“获取”以及您承诺的力量。 Powerplay 日记活动在可用时兑现了承诺；您可以手动选择它。强化您权力的已知所有权；破坏与另一种已知的力量相匹配。获取明确显示未占用/扩展候选者，而不是未知的所有权。

zh-Hans.source: Choose a PNG background image before saving a new map draft.
zh-Hans.translation: 在保存新地图草稿之前选择 PNG 背景图像。

zh-Hans.source: Choose a category from the selector at the top; only that group appears so the desktop is not overwhelmed.
zh-Hans.translation: 从顶部的选择器中选择一个类别；只有该组才会出现，这样桌面就不会被淹没。

zh-Hans.source: Choose a category or search every setting by name, purpose, and familiar alias.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择一个类别或按名称、用途和熟悉的别名搜索每个设置。

zh-Hans.source: Choose a commander, reference system, and VisitedStarsCache.dat file.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择指挥官、参考系统和 VisitedStarsCache.dat 文件。

zh-Hans.source: Choose a folder, then save both the JSON detail and CSV summary there.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择一个文件夹，然后将 JSON 详细信息和 CSV 摘要保存在其中。

zh-Hans.source: Choose a group and add its primary and secondary assignments. Add group stages it and advances to the next unused letter. Switching letters retains your draft; Save stores the whole named configuration.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择一个组并添加其主要和次要作业。添加小组阶段并前进到下一个未使用的字母。切换字母会保留您的草稿； Save 存储整个命名配置。

zh-Hans.source: Choose a journey from the history list or begin a new one.
zh-Hans.translation: 从历史列表中选择旅程或开始新的旅程。

zh-Hans.source: Choose a linked squadron carrier, or dock there to identify it automatically.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择链接的中队航母，或停靠在那里以自动识别它。

zh-Hans.source: Choose a local background image and adjust its X, Y, and scale values while reviewing the preview on the same map.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择本地背景图像并调整其 X、Y 和比例值，同时在同一地图上查看预览。

zh-Hans.source: Choose a preferred Commander when more than one profile appears in the same journal folder.

距自定义原点 {0} 的距离。

zh-Hans.source: Distances use Sol until a custom origin is selected.
zh-Hans.translation: 距离使用 Sol，直到选择自定义原点。

zh-Hans.source: Dock at a Fleet Carrier to publish and link it. Registration preserves Raven's existing cargo; a freshly opened market is reconciled afterward.
zh-Hans.translation: 停靠在舰队航母上以发布和链接它。注册保留 Raven 现有的货物；新开放的市场随后会得到协调。

zh-Hans.source: Dock at a colonization construction site first.
zh-Hans.translation: 首先停靠在殖民建筑工地。

zh-Hans.source: Dock at a construction site and open Construction Services.
zh-Hans.translation: 停靠在建筑工地并开放建筑服务。

zh-Hans.source: Dock at a market and refresh Frontier data.
zh-Hans.translation: 停靠在市场并刷新 Frontier 数据。

zh-Hans.source: Dock at a supported station and refresh Frontier data.
zh-Hans.translation: 停靠在支持的站点并刷新 Frontier 数据。

zh-Hans.source: Dock at the Fleet Carrier and reopen its commodity market before syncing.
zh-Hans.translation: 在同步之前停靠在舰队航母上并重新开放其商品市场。

zh-Hans.source: Dock at the Fleet Carrier you want to publish and link.
zh-Hans.translation: 停靠在您想要发布和链接的舰队航母上。
坞站到坞站 CSV 日志记录已关闭。
码头到码头的旅行日志

zh-Hans.source: Dots represent biological samples or bookmarks. Their surrounding circles show the organism colony radius.
zh-Hans.translation: 点代表生物样本或书签。它们周围的圆圈显示了生物体菌落半径。

zh-Hans.source: Double-click a PNG to open it with the operating system.
zh-Hans.translation: 双击 PNG 以使用操作系统将其打开。

zh-Hans.source: Download hash verified; validating archive files...
zh-Hans.translation: 下载哈希已验证；正在验证存档文件...

zh-Hans.source: Download star system, bodies and organic signals data from EDSM, Spansh and Canonn
zh-Hans.translation: 从 EDSM、Spansh 和 Canonn 下载恒星系统、天体和有机信号数据

zh-Hans.source: Download the AppImage from this release, make it executable, replace your existing AppImage file, and launch it again.
zh-Hans.translation: 从此版本下载 AppImage，使其可执行，替换现有的 AppImage 文件，然后再次启动。

zh-Hans.source: Downloaded catalogs are bounded, validated, checksummed, staged, and activated with health confirmation and rollback.
zh-Hans.translation: 下载的目录经过健康确认和回滚进行绑定、验证、校验和、暂存和激活。
已下载 {0} 字节，共 {1} 字节

zh-Hans.source: Downloading into the update cache. The installation and profile are still untouched.
zh-Hans.translation: 下载到更新缓存中。安装和配置文件仍然保持不变。

zh-Hans.source: Downloads are staged before shutdown; cancelled or failed pre-handoff attempts clean their candidates, stale plans are removed automatically, and failed startup can roll back safely.
zh-Hans.translation: 下载在关机前进行；取消或失败的预切换尝试会清理候选者，过时的计划会自动删除，失败的启动可以安全地回滚。

zh-Hans.source: Draft changes preview immediately but remain session-only until verified export. Starting a draft naturally unlocks the same selected-point form that was read only in reference mode.
zh-Hans.translation: 草稿更改会立即预览，但在验证导出之前仍保持会话状态。开始草稿自然会解锁在参考模式下只读的相同选定点表单。

zh-Hans.source: Draft points are previewed on the active settlement map. Nothing changes on disk until you choose an export destination.
zh-Hans.translation: 在活动的定居点地图上预览吃水点。在您选择导出目标之前，磁盘上不会发生任何变化。

zh-Hans.source: Drag dots onto circle centres. Drag empty space to move; lower-right corner to resize. {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 将点拖到圆心上。拖动空白处进行移动；右下角可以调整大小。 {0}

zh-Hans.source: Drag the bordered previews to the desired monitors and positions. Preview content comes from a false game state shaped like real overlay data.
zh-Hans.translation: 将带边框的预览拖动到所需的监视器和位置。预览内容来自形状像真实叠加数据的虚假游戏状态。

zh-Hans.source: Drag the frame over the six HUD circles. Resize it from the lower-right corner, leaving room for cockpit movement; resizing changes the capture area without stretching or moving the guides inside it. Drag each numbered red dot onto its matching circle centre. Keep all six circles and their complete bars inside the frame; the small numbers are not read.
zh-Hans.translation: 将框架拖到六个 HUD 圆圈上。从右下角开始调整大小，为驾驶舱移动留出空间；调整大小会更改捕获区域，而无需拉伸或移动其中的参考线。将每个编号的红点拖到其匹配的圆中心。将所有六个圆圈及其完整的条形保留在框架内；小数字不会被读取。

zh-Hans.source: Drive to a mining-location border, face its center, and send .mining <heading> <radius km> <number>, i.e. .mining 120 6.44 4.
zh-Hans.translation: 开车到采矿地点边界，面向其中心，发送.mining <heading> <radius km> <number>，即.mining 120 6.44 4。

zh-Hans.source: Drive to the orange location border, face the center marker, and send .mining <heading> <border radius km> <location number>. Example: .mining 120 6.44 4.
zh-Hans.translation: 行驶至橙色位置边界，面向中心标记，然后发送 .mining <heading> <border radius km> <location number>。示例：.mining 120 6.44 4。

zh-Hans.source: Drive to the orange mining-location border and face its center, then use .mining <heading> <radius km> <number>, i.e. .mining 120 6.44 4. Use .mining center here from the true center to correct it later.
zh-Hans.translation: 行驶到橙色采矿地点边界并面向其中心，然后使用.mining <heading> <radius km> <number>，即.mining 120 6.44 4。稍后使用.mining center here从真实中心进行校正。

zh-Hans.source: Drive to the orange mining-location border and face the center marker.
zh-Hans.translation: 开车到橙色采矿地点边界并面向中心标记。

zh-Hans.source: EDDN needs no personal account or API key. This release sends production-schema messages through the Live gateway.
zh-Hans.translation: EDDN不需要个人帐户或API密钥。此版本通过 Live 网关发送生产模式消息。

zh-Hans.source: EDDN processing was isolated from journal tracking: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: EDDN 处理与日志跟踪隔离：{0}

zh-Hans.source: EDDN publication, Inara publication, direct EDSM synchronization, human-settlement geometry, Green Gas Giant candidates, Raven cargo, Fleet Carrier data, system updates, and quest publication each require the corresponding setting, credential, or explicit confirmation.
zh-Hans.translation: EDDN 发布、Inara 发布、直接 EDSM 同步、人类住区几何、绿色气体巨人候选者、乌鸦货物、舰队航母数据、系统更新和任务发布均需要相应的设置、凭证或明确确认。

zh-Hans.source: EDDN reception opens a separate receive-only connection. Commodity observations expire after 24 hours; coverage grows while enabled.
zh-Hans.translation: EDDN 接收打开一个单独的仅接收连接。商品观察24小时后失效；启用后覆盖范围会增加。

zh-Hans.source: EDDN requires no account, personal API key, OAuth flow, access token, or Authorization header.
zh-Hans.translation: EDDN 不需要帐户、个人 API 密钥、OAuth 流程、访问令牌或授权标头。

zh-Hans.source: EDDN sharing is enabled for live Commander sessions.
zh-Hans.translation: EDDN 为实时 Commander 会话启用共享。

zh-Hans.source: EDDN sharing is installation-wide, disabled by default, and configured from Settings > Privacy & sharing.
zh-Hans.translation: EDDN 共享在安装范围内，默认禁用，并通过“设置”>“隐私和共享”进行配置。
EDDN · {0} 缓存的商品观察结果
编辑器预览 - 代表监护国
EDSM 接受了 {0} 日志事件。

zh-Hans.source: EDSM and Spansh body lookups wait for an active Elite session and a confirmed visit to the current system. If newly discovered body data is not indexed yet, SrvSurvey allows up to three retries after the initial lookup and remembers the current-visit budget across application restarts.
zh-Hans.translation: EDSM 和 Spansh 正文查找等待活动的 Elite 会话和对当前系统的确认访问。如果新发现的身体数据尚未建立索引，SrvSurvey 允许在初始查找后最多重试 3 次，并在应用程序重新启动时记住当前访问预算。

zh-Hans.source: EDSM processing was isolated from journal tracking: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: EDSM 处理与日志跟踪隔离：{0}

zh-Hans.source: EDSM processing was skipped without affecting journal tracking: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: EDSM 处理被跳过，但不影响日志跟踪：{0}
EDSM 已为 {0} 启用同步。

zh-Hans.source: Each PIP has the legacy translucent dotted outer frame plus a solid outline around every filled or possible-reward segment. Both border layers follow the PIP state and are independently configurable in Overlay appearance.
zh-Hans.translation: 每个 PIP 都具有传统的半透明点状外框以及围绕每个填充或可能的奖励部分的实心轮廓。两个边框层都遵循 PIP 状态，并且可以在叠加外观中独立配置。

zh-Hans.source: Each equipped module can appear only once per trigger. Use its slot to distinguish duplicate modules.
zh-Hans.translation: 每个装备的模块每次触发只能出现一次。使用其插槽来区分重复的模块。

zh-Hans.source: Each journal session uses that session's Commander name as EDDN's required uploader identifier. EDDN obfuscates the identifier before relaying the data. Changing Commanders creates a new isolated session; queued messages retain the Commander header captured when they were created.
zh-Hans.translation: 每个日志会话都使用该会话的指挥官名称作为 EDDN 所需的上传者标识符。 EDDN 在中继数据之前混淆标识符。更改指挥官会创建一个新的隔离会话；排队的消息保留创建时捕获的 Commander 标头。

zh-Hans.source: Each overlay has a specific game-state trigger and can also have a manual shortcut.
zh-Hans.translation: 每个叠加层都有一个特定的游戏状态触发器，也可以有一个手动快捷方式。

zh-Hans.source: Easy to bounce or flip if you tap down-thrust
zh-Hans.translation: 如果您点击向下推力，则很容易弹起或翻转

zh-Hans.source: Edit the first six shared bindings in Settings > Input or in Surface Mining overlay settings, where they retain the Mining rig labels. Both locations edit the same bindings, including any replacement keyboard or controller chords.
zh-Hans.translation: 在“设置”>“输入”或“露天采矿覆盖设置”中编辑前六个共享绑定，它们在其中保留采矿设备标签。两个位置都编辑相同的绑定，包括任何替换键盘或控制器和弦。

zh-Hans.source: Editing the selected commander survey. Save writes the legacy-compatible file atomically.
zh-Hans.translation: 编辑选定的指挥官调查。 Save 以原子方式写入旧版兼容文件。

zh-Hans.source: Editing {0}. Changes are saved only when you select Save.
zh-Hans.translation: 编辑 {0}。仅当您选择“保存”时才会保存更改。

zh-Hans.source: Editing {0}. Use the top ✓ to save all changes and close the editor.
zh-Hans.translation: 编辑 {0}。使用顶部 ✓ 保存所有更改并关闭编辑器。

zh-Hans.source: Eligible live events enter a bounded durable retry queue. Startup history and multicrew activity are not uploaded, and delivery pauses when multiple Elite windows make companion-file ownership ambiguous.
zh-Hans.translation: 符合条件的实时事件进入有界持久重试队列。不会上传启动历史记录和多人活动，并且当多个 Elite 窗口导致伴随文件所有权不明确时，传输会暂停。

zh-Hans.source: Elite Dangerous could not be focused after {0}; no matching game window was available.
zh-Hans.translation: Elite Dangerous 在 {0} 之后无法聚焦；没有可用的匹配游戏窗口。

zh-Hans.source: Elite Dangerous is not running; file operations are available.
zh-Hans.translation: Elite Dangerous 未运行；可以进行文件操作。

zh-Hans.source: Elite must remain visible and foreground while first-footfall notification detection is active.
zh-Hans.translation: 当首次脚步通知检测处于活动状态时，精英必须保持可见并位于前台。

zh-Hans.source: Elite session closed normally; waiting for the next journal session.
zh-Hans.translation: 精英时段正常关闭；等待下一次日记会议。
精英访问过的星星缓存

zh-Hans.source: Embed location details within image, if known
zh-Hans.translation: 在图像中嵌入位置详细信息（如果已知）

zh-Hans.source: Enable EDDN sharing for live Commander sessions
zh-Hans.translation: 启用 EDDN 实时 Commander 会话共享

zh-Hans.source: Enable EDDN uploads in only one application at a time; for example, SrvSurvey or EDMC. Using multiple uploaders can create duplicate submissions.
zh-Hans.translation: 一次仅在一个应用程序中启用EDDN上传；例如，SrvSurvey 或 EDMC。使用多个上传者可能会创建重复的提交。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Green Gas Giant uploads in Settings before publishing historical candidates.
zh-Hans.translation: 在发布历史候选人之前，请在“设置”中启用“绿色气体巨人”上传。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Inara uploads in only one application at a time to avoid duplicate Commander events.
zh-Hans.translation: 一次仅在一个应用程序中启用 Inara 上传，以避免重复的 Commander 事件。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Inara uploads in only one application at a time to avoid duplicate commander events.
zh-Hans.translation: 一次仅在一个应用程序中启用 Inara 上传，以避免重复的指挥官事件。

zh-Hans.source: Enable OpenVR overlays before resetting headset orientation.
zh-Hans.translation: 在重置耳机方向之前启用 OpenVR 叠加。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Raven Colonial before loading a system.
zh-Hans.translation: 在加载系统之前启用 Raven Colonial。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Raven Colonial before preparing a project.
zh-Hans.translation: 在准备项目之前启用 Raven Colonial。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Raven Colonial before publishing a Fleet Carrier.
zh-Hans.translation: 在发布舰队航母之前启用 Raven Colonial。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Raven Colonial before publishing ship cargo.
zh-Hans.translation: 在发布船舶货物之前启用 Raven Colonial。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Raven Colonial before syncing Fleet Carrier cargo.
zh-Hans.translation: 在同步舰队承运人货物之前启用 Raven Colonial。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Raven Colonial in Settings and save the API key for the active Commander.
zh-Hans.translation: 在“设置”中启用 Raven Colonial 并保存活动 Commander 的 API 密钥。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Require FSS to report all bodies when entering a new system is not enough and you want completion to wait for a full FSS identification. Enabled earlier-visit and older-Spansh completion rules remain explicit exceptions.
zh-Hans.translation: 当进入新系统时启用要求 FSS 报告所有机构还不够，并且您希望等待完整的 FSS 识别才能完成。启用的早期访问和较早的Spansh完成规则仍然是明确的例外。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Send Journal to VoxStellar for boxel surveying to upload new live Scan, FSDTarget, FSDJump, FSSDiscoveryScan, SAASignalsFound, ScanOrganic, ScanBaryCentre, and CodexEntry events with your Commander name.
zh-Hans.translation: 启用将日志发送到 VoxStellar 以进行 boxel 测量，以使用您的指挥官姓名上传新的实时 Scan、FSDTarget、FSDJump、FSSDiscoveryScan、SAASignalsFound、ScanOrganic、ScanBaryCentre 和 CodexEntry 事件。

zh-Hans.source: Enable Show flight warnings and choose a gravity threshold in Exploration overlay settings. The warning appears only when SrvSurvey can identify a nearby landable body in a supported ship, fighter, or SRV flight context.
zh-Hans.translation: 启用显示飞行警告并在探索叠加设置中选择重力阈值。仅当 SrvSurvey 可以在受支持的船舶、战斗机或 SRV 飞行环境中识别附近的可着陆物体时，才会出现该警告。
启用控制器/操纵杆键和弦

zh-Hans.source: Enable direct EDSM synchronization in only one application at a time to avoid duplicate requests.
zh-Hans.translation: 一次仅在一个应用程序中启用直接 EDSM 同步，以避免重复请求。

zh-Hans.source: Enable global keyboard input below, then use this shortcut to make existing live overlays clickable and draggable. Use it again to save positions and restore click-through mode; it never opens the full editor.
zh-Hans.translation: 启用下面的全局键盘输入，然后使用此快捷方式使现有的实时覆盖可单击和可拖动。再次使用它可以保存位置并恢复点击模式；它永远不会打开完整的编辑器。

zh-Hans.source: Enable journal and companion-data sharing in only one Elite Dangerous third-party application at a time. If another companion already publishes the same data, leave the equivalent SrvSurvey sharing feature disabled to prevent duplicate entries and conflicting updates.
zh-Hans.translation: 一次仅在一个 Elite Dangerous 第三方应用程序中启用日志和伴随数据共享。如果另一个合作伙伴已发布相同的数据，请禁用等效的 SrvSurvey 共享功能，以防止重复条目和更新冲突。

zh-Hans.source: Enable or disable data banners on future screenshots.
zh-Hans.translation: 在未来的屏幕截图中启用或禁用数据横幅。

zh-Hans.source: Enable the filename, folder, banner, or aerial-alignment options you want.
zh-Hans.translation: 启用所需的文件名、文件夹、横幅或空中对齐选项。

zh-Hans.source: Enable the limit to evaluate the current system
zh-Hans.translation: 启用限制以评估当前系统

zh-Hans.source: Enter a biological signal or missing variants to find nearby systems.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入生物信号或缺失的变体以查找附近的系统。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a firegroup configuration name before saving.
zh-Hans.translation: 保存前输入火组配置名称。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a generated system name, ordinary system name, or id64 in Top boxel or generated system. Select an EDSM suggestion when one appears so SrvSurvey retains the authoritative id64.
zh-Hans.translation: 在顶部框或生成的系统中输入生成的系统名称、普通系统名称或 id64。当 EDSM 建议出现时选择一项，以便 SrvSurvey 保留权威 id64。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a genus, species, and at least one variant color.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入属、种和至少一种变体颜色。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a keyboard shortcut or controller chord, or leave blank.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入键盘快捷键或控制器和弦，或留空。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a live Elite system before loading Raven sites.
zh-Hans.translation: 在加载 Raven 站点之前进入实时精英系统。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a mineral and 0–16 pending tons.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入一种矿物和 0–16 待定吨。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a name for this route. It will be stored in your commander route library.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入该路线的名称。它将存储在您的指挥官路线库中。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a name for this saved search.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入此已保存搜索的名称。
输入 0 到 100 之间的百分比。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a star-system name to set a custom origin.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入恒星系统名称以设置自定义原点。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a system name to search.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入系统名称进行搜索。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a system to browse biological Codex entries.
zh-Hans.translation: 进入系统浏览生物法典条目。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a system, optional body/ring and category; saving a new category makes it available to the category filter.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入系统，可选主体/环和类别；保存新类别使其可供类别过滤器使用。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a valid generated system and lower mass code.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入有效的生成系统和较低的质量代码。

zh-Hans.source: Enter a valid generated system or boxel name.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入有效的生成系统或 boxel 名称。

zh-Hans.source: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both blank for an unknown surface origin.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入纬度和经度，或者将两者留空以表示未知的表面原点。

zh-Hans.source: Enter coordinates in Travel or send .target here through the in-game chat journal to capture the current location.
zh-Hans.translation: 在“旅行”中输入坐标或通过游戏内聊天日志在此处发送 .target 以捕获当前位置。

zh-Hans.source: Enter galactic X, Y, and Z together, or leave all three blank.
zh-Hans.translation: 同时输入银河系 X、Y 和 Z，或将所有三个留空。
仅输入 0 到 99,999 之间的数字。

zh-Hans.source: Enter one or more terms in Search settings. Use Up and Down to move through grouped results, Enter to open the selected setting, or select a result directly.
zh-Hans.translation: 在搜索设置中输入一个或多个术语。使用“向上”和“向下”在分组结果中移动，按 Enter 键打开所选设置，或直接选择结果。

zh-Hans.source: Enter or scan a system with biological signals.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用生物信号输入或扫描系统。

zh-Hans.source: Enter the biological signal to find.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入生物信号进行查找。

zh-Hans.source: Enter the current route, boxel, or clipboard target in the Galaxy Map.
zh-Hans.translation: 在 Galaxy 地图中输入当前路线、方框或剪贴板目标。

zh-Hans.source: Enter {0} or higher; that suffix is already recorded.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入 {0} 或更高；该后缀已被记录。
整个已保存的搜索（不可用）
整个已保存的搜索 ({0} boxel{1})

zh-Hans.source: Entire saved search combines recorded systems and bodies from every boxel in that saved search before calculating the average.
zh-Hans.translation: 在计算平均值之前，整个保存的搜索会合并该保存的搜索中每个框的记录系统和主体。

zh-Hans.source: Entries remain visible in this session, but the log file could not be updated: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 条目在此会话中仍然可见，但无法更新日志文件：{0}

zh-Hans.translation: 保存个人 API 密钥可以实现活动指挥官的直接 EDSM 帐户同步。 SrvSurvey 发送此处显示的当前指挥官名称，该名称必须与通过 EDSM 注册的指挥官匹配。这与 EDDN 共享分开，并且不启用 EDDN。

zh-Hans.source: Saving a personal API key enables supported Inara uploads only for the commander shown. Removing that key disables uploads for that commander.
zh-Hans.translation: 保存个人 API 密钥只会为显示的指挥官启用受支持的 Inara 上传。删除该密钥将禁用该指挥官的上传。

zh-Hans.source: Saving project visibility to Raven Colonial...
zh-Hans.translation: 将项目可见性保存到 Raven Colonial...

zh-Hans.source: Scales the complete application interface. Oversized choices are reduced only as needed to fit the active monitor.
zh-Hans.translation: 扩展完整的应用程序界面。仅根据需要减少超大尺寸的选择以适应活动显示器。

zh-Hans.source: Scan a body in the FSS to populate this list.
zh-Hans.translation: 扫描 FSS 中的身体以填充此列表。

zh-Hans.source: Scan a system with biological signals to begin.
zh-Hans.translation: 开始使用生物信号扫描系统。

zh-Hans.source: Scan the first specimen with the Genetic Sampler.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用基因采样器扫描第一个样本。

zh-Hans.source: Scanned {0} journal(s) and {1} Codex event(s); merged {2} earlier global/regional first(s).{3}{4}
zh-Hans.translation: 已扫描 {0} 期刊和 {1} 法典事件；合并了 {2} 较早的全球/区域第一。{3}{4}

zh-Hans.source: Scanned {0} journals and {1} Codex events; added {2} global/regional firsts.{3}{4}
zh-Hans.translation: 已扫描 {0} 期刊和 {1} 法典事件；添加了{2}全球/区域第一。{3}{4}
已扫描 {0} 个尸体，共 {1} 个尸体

zh-Hans.source: Scanning historical journals without changing profile data...
zh-Hans.translation: 扫描历史期刊而不更改个人资料数据...

zh-Hans.source: Scanning, approaching, or docking can infer system/site data locally, but none of those actions alone publishes the system record.
zh-Hans.translation: 扫描、接近或对接可以在本地推断系统/站点数据，但这些操作都不会单独发布系统记录。

zh-Hans.source: Scans add local rings and hotspots. Shared Mining bookmarks add your overlap, RES and rating notes.
zh-Hans.translation: 扫描添加本地环和热点。共享采矿书签添加您的重叠、RES 和评级注释。

zh-Hans.source: Screenshot conversion has its own source, destination, naming, banner, and image-embedding controls. High-resolution naming is determined from the Elite game client dimensions rather than whichever desktop happens to be primary.
zh-Hans.translation: 屏幕截图转换有自己的源、目标、命名、横幅和图像嵌入控件。高分辨率命名是根据精英游戏客户端尺寸确定的，而不是根据哪个桌面恰好是主要的。
屏幕截图数据横幅已禁用。
屏幕截图数据横幅已启用。

zh-Hans.source: Screenshot file processing is unavailable during diagnostic replay.
zh-Hans.translation: 在诊断重放期间，屏幕截图文件处理不可用。

zh-Hans.source: Screenshot processing can convert new images, organize them, and embed useful site data without changing old captures.
zh-Hans.translation: 屏幕截图处理可以转换新图像、组织它们并嵌入有用的站点数据，而无需更改旧的捕获图像。
屏幕截图、通知、直播和 VR

zh-Hans.source: Search event, commander, system, file, or JSON
zh-Hans.translation: 搜索事件、指挥官、系统、文件或 JSON

zh-Hans.source: Search for a previously visited system.
zh-Hans.translation: 搜索以前访问过的系统。

zh-Hans.source: Search guides, settings, symbols, or workflows
zh-Hans.translation: 搜索指南、设置、符号或工作流程

zh-Hans.source: Search procedural boxels, track every generated system, and choose what counts as complete.
zh-Hans.translation: 搜索程序框，跟踪每个生成的系统，并选择什么算完整。

zh-Hans.source: Search the durable game journal record and export a bounded diagnostic replay package.
zh-Hans.translation: 搜索持久的游戏日志记录并导出有限的诊断重播包。
搜索、BoxelSearch 或路由处于活动状态

zh-Hans.source: Search−/Search+ adjust the movement search allowance in pixels. The readout and optional Search bounds outline show its extent; this does not move or rotate the guides. Keep the search area inside the capture frame. After changing size, height, rotation or alignment, select Test again. No label learning is required.
zh-Hans.translation: 搜索-/搜索+调整移动搜索余量（以像素为单位）。读数和可选的搜索边界轮廓显示其范围；这不会移动或旋转导轨。将搜索区域保持在捕获框内。更改大小、高度、旋转或对齐方式后，再次选择“测试”。不需要标签学习。

zh-Hans.source: Secure Frontier account storage is currently supported on Windows and Linux.
zh-Hans.translation: Windows 和 Linux 目前支持安全的 Frontier 帐户存储。

zh-Hans.source: Secure Frontier token storage is unavailable. Install the 'secret-tool' utility and unlock a Secret Service compatible keyring, then try again.
zh-Hans.translation: 安全 Frontier 令牌存储不可用。安装“秘密工具”实用程序并解锁与特勤局兼容的密钥环，然后重试。

zh-Hans.source: See your path from the search root, move between boxels at the same level, or open a smaller child boxel. This does not move between systems in the table.
zh-Hans.translation: 从搜索根查看您的路径，在同一级别的框格之间移动，或打开较小的子框格。这不会在表中的系统之间移动。

zh-Hans.source: Select Configure sharing, review the journal and companion-file data SrvSurvey can send, then enable live-session sharing and save.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择配置共享，查看可以发送的日志和配套文件数据 SrvSurvey，然后启用实时会话共享并保存。

zh-Hans.source: Select Confirm clear to remove all unclaimed organic rewards. Active sample progress will be kept.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择确认清除以删除所有无人认领的有机奖励。将保留活动样本进度。

zh-Hans.source: Select Confirm removal to remove local development progress. The state file is backed up first.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择确认删除以删除本地开发进度。首先备份状态文件。

zh-Hans.source: Select Confirm reset to clear all six exploration totals.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择确认重置以清除所有六个探索总数。

zh-Hans.source: Select Disable and confirm to remove the API key and cancel pending delivery for that Commander. Switching Commanders loads that profile's separate EDSM state.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择禁用并确认删除 API 密钥并取消该指挥官的待交付。切换命令加载该配置文件的单独 EDSM 状态。

zh-Hans.source: Select Open Library to browse saved searches by favorite, name, creation date, last modified date, completion, and notes. Resume Selected restores its tree, options, and completed systems.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择“打开库”可按收藏夹、名称、创建日期、上次修改日期、完成情况和注释浏览已保存的搜索。恢复所选恢复其树、选项和完整的系统。

zh-Hans.source: Select Refresh to scan commander profiles and the game state.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择“刷新”以扫描指挥官配置文件和游戏状态。

zh-Hans.source: Select Save to Library. The first save asks for a name and notes, preloading the top system as the name. Progress then syncs to that library entry automatically.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择保存到库。第一次保存要求提供名称和注释，并预加载顶部系统作为名称。然后进度会自动同步到该库条目。

zh-Hans.source: Select Start search. SrvSurvey opens the top boxel, merges local Commander history with available Spansh observations, and chooses the lowest incomplete suffix.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择开始搜索。 SrvSurvey 打开顶部框，将本地指挥官历史记录与可用的 Spansh 观察结果合并，并选择最低的不完整后缀。

zh-Hans.source: Select a Codex category or entry
Select a commander and confirm the all-history Codex merge first.
zh-Hans.translation: 首先选择一个指挥官并确认所有历史的 Codex 合并。

zh-Hans.source: Select a commander and confirm the verified historical system rebuild first.
zh-Hans.translation: 首先选择指挥官并确认已验证的历史系统重建。
首先选择一个已完成的会话。

zh-Hans.source: Select a completed session for notes, screenshots and exports. HTML reports work offline and can be printed or saved as PDF. Imported CSV summaries retain their original fields.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择一个已完成的会话以进行注释、屏幕截图和导出。 HTML 报告可以离线工作，并且可以打印或另存为 PDF。导入的 CSV 摘要保留其原始字段。

zh-Hans.source: Select a completed session to edit notes or attach screenshots. Export HTML for graphs, material breakdowns and the prospecting timeline; open it in a browser to print or save as PDF.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择已完成的会话以编辑注释或附加屏幕截图。导出图表、材料细目和勘探时间表的 HTML；在浏览器中打开它以打印或另存为 PDF。

zh-Hans.source: Select a controller before enabling controller input.
zh-Hans.translation: 在启用控制器输入之前选择控制器。
选择已发现的 Codex 条目

zh-Hans.source: Select a mapped Guardian ruins or structure survey to author its master template.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择映射的守护者遗址或结构调查来创作其主模板。

zh-Hans.source: Select a marker to update its survey status, relic heading when it is a relic tower, and component materials. Commander-specific raw points also expose angle, distance, and rotation controls with 0.1 increments.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择一个标记来更新其调查状态、文物标题（如果是文物塔）以及组件材料。特定于指挥官的原始点还以 0.1 的增量显示角度、距离和旋转控件。

zh-Hans.source: Select a row to copy it or inspect it on Canonn and Spansh.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择一行进行复制或在 Canonn 和 Spansh 上检查它。

zh-Hans.source: Select a saved configuration to remove.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择要删除的已保存配置。

zh-Hans.source: Select a system and choose Find rings in selected system. This switches to Rings and searches that exact system. Adjust mineral and ring type as needed. For acquisition, uncheck Only this system to compare surrounding rings; the chosen acquisition destination is retained separately. Select a ring and choose Selling stations to open Markets → Sell mined cargo. The plan context shows the mining origin and Powerplay destination.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择一个系统并选择在所选系统中查找环。这将切换到环并搜索该确切的系统。根据需要调整矿物和戒指类型。对于采集，取消选中仅此系统来比较周围的环；所选择的获取目的地将单独保留。选择一个环并选择销售站以打开市场→出售开采的货物。计划上下文显示了挖矿起点和 Powerplay 目的地。

zh-Hans.source: Select a system from the search results.
zh-Hans.translation: 从搜索结果中选择一个系统。

zh-Hans.source: Select an event and confirm that replay may change active quest progress.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择一个事件并确认重播可能会更改活动任务进度。

zh-Hans.source: Select an organism to begin sampling.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择一个生物体开始采样。

zh-Hans.source: Select an organism to load its reference image.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择一个生物体来加载其参考图像。

zh-Hans.source: Select folder containing quest definition files
zh-Hans.translation: 选择包含任务定义文件的文件夹

zh-Hans.source: Select the Active Commander card to open the current Frontier profile. Overview remains at the top of the sidebar.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择 Active Commander 卡以打开当前 Frontier 配置文件。概述仍然位于侧边栏的顶部。

zh-Hans.source: Select the ruins layout with the active fire group, then use the configured confirmation control twice.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择具有活动火力组的废墟布局，然后使用配置的确认控件两次。

zh-Hans.source: Select to open this survey map

zh-Hans.translation: 选择您链接的中队航母

zh-Hans.source: Selected boxel uses only the recorded systems and bodies in the boxel currently open.
zh-Hans.translation: 选定的 boxel 仅使用当前打开的 boxel 中记录的系统和主体。

zh-Hans.source: Selected projects appear in aggregate cargo requirements. Changes are sent only when you choose Save selection.
zh-Hans.translation: 选定的项目出现在总货运需求中。仅当您选择保存选择时才会发送更改。
选定的系统和路线智能

zh-Hans.source: Send --- in game chat to clear all rigs and surface bookmarks on the current body, including resource, biology, and regular tracker bookmarks. This works even when automatic rig clearing is disabled and does not erase scan history or bookmarks on other bodies.
zh-Hans.translation: 在游戏聊天中发送---可清除当前身体上的所有装备和表面书签，包括资源、生物和常规追踪器书签。即使自动装备清除被禁用并且不会删除其他物体上的扫描历史记录或书签，此功能仍然有效。

zh-Hans.source: Send -helium to remove the nearest helium bookmark, or --helium to remove all saved helium locations on this body. Use the matching name for other materials.
zh-Hans.translation: 发送 -helium 以删除最近的氦书签，或发送 --helium 以删除此实体上所有已保存的氦位置。使用其他材料的匹配名称。

zh-Hans.source: Send .alignment to toggle a red guide at the exact center of the Elite window. In the Rhino driving view, place a distant location circle under the guide before reading the visible compass heading for .mine. Turret mode does not show the required heading.
zh-Hans.translation: 发送 .alignment 以在 Elite 窗口的正中心切换红色参考线。在 Rhino 驾驶视图中，在读取可见指南针方向 .mine 之前，在指南下方放置一个远处位置圆圈。炮塔模式不显示所需的航向。

zh-Hans.source: Send .target off or clear the target in Travel when finished.
zh-Hans.translation: 完成后发送.target 或清除Travel 中的目标。

zh-Hans.source: Send Journal to VoxStellar for boxel surveying
zh-Hans.translation: 将日志发送至 VoxStellar 进行箱形测量

zh-Hans.source: Separate multiple colors with commas or semicolons.
zh-Hans.translation: 用逗号或分号分隔多种颜色。

zh-Hans.source: Session shows prospecting percentages, core discoveries, quality hits, refined tonnage, limpets, engineering materials and cargo. Manual count corrections retain the original observations.
zh-Hans.translation: 会议展示了勘探百分比、核心发现、质量命中、精炼吨位、帽贝、工程材料和货物。手动计数校正保留原始观察结果。

zh-Hans.source: Set Search start date, then decide whether earlier Commander visits and older Spansh body records should count as already complete.
zh-Hans.translation: 设置搜索开始日期，然后决定较早的指挥官访问和较旧的 Spansh 尸体记录是否应算作已完成。

zh-Hans.source: Set a target to begin guidance
Set focus on Elite Dangerous after each FSD jump.
zh-Hans.translation: 每次 FSD 跳转后将焦点设置在 Elite Dangerous 上。

zh-Hans.source: Set focus on Elite Dangerous when minimizing Srv Survey.
zh-Hans.translation: 最小化 Srv 调查时将焦点设置在 Elite Dangerous 上。

zh-Hans.source: Set focus on Elite Dangerous when starting Srv Survey.
zh-Hans.translation: 启动 Srv Survey 时将焦点设置在 Elite Dangerous 上。

zh-Hans.source: Set mineral thresholds for prospecting announcements. Remove all filters to announce all minerals.
zh-Hans.translation: 设定勘探公告的矿产门槛。拆下所有过滤器以公布所有矿物质。
设置或清除表面跟踪器 7.
设置或清除表面跟踪器 8.

zh-Hans.source: Set or clear tracker 1, or mining rig 1 while operating the Rhino.
zh-Hans.translation: 在操作 Rhino 时设置或清除跟踪器 1 或采矿设备 1。

zh-Hans.source: Set or clear tracker 2, or mining rig 2 while operating the Rhino.
zh-Hans.translation: 在操作 Rhino 时设置或清除跟踪器 2 或采矿设备 2。

zh-Hans.source: Set or clear tracker 3, or mining rig 3 while operating the Rhino.
zh-Hans.translation: 在操作 Rhino 时设置或清除跟踪器 3 或采矿设备 3。

zh-Hans.source: Set or clear tracker 4, or mining rig 4 while operating the Rhino.
zh-Hans.translation: 在操作 Rhino 时设置或清除跟踪器 4 或采矿设备 4。

zh-Hans.source: Set or clear tracker 5, or mining rig 5 while operating the Rhino.
zh-Hans.translation: 在操作 Rhino 时设置或清除跟踪器 5 或采矿设备 5。

zh-Hans.source: Set or clear tracker 6, or mining rig 6 while operating the Rhino.
zh-Hans.translation: 在操作 Rhino 时设置或清除跟踪器 6 或采矿设备 6。

zh-Hans.source: Set planetary coordinates and follow live distance, bearing, and approach guidance.
zh-Hans.translation: 设置行星坐标并遵循实时距离、方位和接近指导。

zh-Hans.source: Set surface targets, record journeys, follow routes, and search the galaxy by sphere or nearby-system criteria.
zh-Hans.translation: 设置表面目标、记录旅程、遵循路线并按球体或附近系统标准搜索星系。

zh-Hans.source: Set the Guardian site heading before opening its map.
zh-Hans.translation: 在打开地图之前设置 Guardian 站点标题。

zh-Hans.source: Setting {0} as the primary Raven Colonial project...
zh-Hans.translation: 将 {0} 设置为主 Raven Colonial 项目...

zh-Hans.source: Settings apply immediately. Rebuild is only needed to import historical journals.
zh-Hans.translation: 设置立即应用。仅导入历史期刊时需要重建。

zh-Hans.source: Settings is divided into Application, Desktop, Global overlays, Input, Privacy & sharing, Screenshots, and Data & migration. Search settings to jump directly to a matching control.
zh-Hans.translation: 设置分为应用程序、桌面、全局覆盖、输入、隐私和共享、屏幕截图以及数据和迁移。搜索设置直接跳转到匹配的控件。

zh-Hans.source: Settings uses focused categories and a searchable catalog so long configuration pages do not have to be scanned manually.
zh-Hans.translation: 设置使用重点类别和可搜索目录，因此无需手动扫描长配置页面。

zh-Hans.source: Settings → Announcements controls collected/refined/prospecting notices, mineral thresholds, core/non-core filters and named announcement presets. Optional speech uses locally installed Windows voices.
zh-Hans.translation: 设置→公告控制收集/精炼/勘探通知、矿物阈值、核心/非核心过滤器和命名公告预设。可选语音使用本地安装的 Windows 语音。

zh-Hans.source: Settings → Backup exports a ZIP with commander mining data, named Firegroups configurations and cached loadouts, shared bookmarks and local screenshot attachments. Restore applies the backed-up contents and keeps previous files for recovery. Older ZIPs without Firegroups leave current named configurations intact.
zh-Hans.translation: 设置 → 备份导出包含指挥官挖掘数据、名为 Firegroups 配置和缓存加载、共享书签和本地屏幕截图附件的 ZIP。恢复应用备份内容并保留以前的文件以进行恢复。没有 Firegroup 的旧版 ZIP 会保持当前命名配置不变。

zh-Hans.source: Settlement geometry could not be loaded: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法加载沉降几何图形：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Settlement geometry could not be saved: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法保存沉降几何图形：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Settlement geometry could not be uploaded to Canonn: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 沉降几何图形无法上传到 Canonn：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Settlement geometry was not uploaded because the active vehicle was unavailable.
zh-Hans.translation: 由于活动车辆不可用，因此未上传沉降几何图形。

zh-Hans.source: Settlement material survey could not be completed: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法完成定居点材料调查：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Settlement material survey could not be loaded: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法加载定居点材料调查：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Settlement material survey could not be saved: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法保存定居点材料调查：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Settlement offset comparison was written to the application log.
zh-Hans.translation: 结算偏移比较已写入应用程序日志。

zh-Hans.source: Settlement offset comparison: alternate {0} vs direct {1}
zh-Hans.translation: 结算偏移比较：替代 {0} 与直接 {1}

zh-Hans.source: Settlement threat level could not be saved: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法保存定居点威胁等级：{0}
定居点威胁等级设置为{0}。
已保存沉降类型和路线。
定居点类型和方向未知

zh-Hans.source: Settlement visit recorded; alignment is still unknown.
zh-Hans.translation: 定居点走访记录；对齐方式仍然未知。

zh-Hans.source: Settlement-map settings could not be saved: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法保存定居点地图设置：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Shape conveys the object or state; color adds live context and follows the saved in-game overlay palette.
zh-Hans.translation: 形状传达物体或状态；颜色添加实时上下文并遵循保存的游戏内叠加调色板。

zh-Hans.source: Share column with ship cargo counts
zh-Hans.translation: 与船舶货物数量共享栏

zh-Hans.source: Share data packages meaningful Commander discoveries for review without changing published reference data.
zh-Hans.translation: 共享数据包有意义的 Commander 发现以供审核，而无需更改已发布的参考数据。

zh-Hans.source: Share supported live journal and companion-file data with the Elite Dangerous Data Network.
zh-Hans.translation: 与 Elite Dangerous 数据网络共享支持的实时日志和伴随文件数据。

zh-Hans.source: Shared tools are available outside Mining.
zh-Hans.translation: 共享工具可在 Mining 之外使用。
护盾切换捕获的多边形点 {0}。

zh-Hans.source: Ship cargo is paused while multiple Elite windows are running because Cargo.json cannot be attributed safely.

zh-Hans.source: The terminology and naming model follow community research documented by Elite Dangerous Astrometrics, Marx's Guide to Boxels, and the IGAU system-identifier notes.
zh-Hans.translation: 术语和命名模型遵循 Elite Dangerous Astrometrics、Marx's Guide to Boxels 和 IGAU 系统标识符注释记录的社区研究。

zh-Hans.translation: 此会话的主题已更改，但无法保存：{0}

zh-Hans.source: The token is not a controller input.
The top Current system is where the Commander actually is; it is not the first system in the sequence. Next incomplete system is the next work item calculated from saved completion state.
zh-Hans.translation: 当前系统的顶层是指挥官实际所在的位置；它不是序列中的第一个系统。下一个不完整系统是根据保存的完成状态计算出的下一个工作项。

zh-Hans.source: The top row maps left to right to rigs 1, 2, and 3; the bottom row maps to rigs 4, 5, and 6. A bar adds its tracker immediately; clearing requires three continuous seconds of empty readings. Missing frames and uncertain readings do not clear your trackers. Symbols and counters inside circles do not determine deployment.
zh-Hans.translation: 顶行从左到右映射到装备 1、2 和 3；底行映射到装备 4、5 和 6。条形立即添加其跟踪器；清除需要连续三秒的空读数。丢失的帧和不确定的读数不会清除您的跟踪器。圆圈内的符号和计数器并不决定部署。

zh-Hans.source: The unhealthy replacement process did not exit for rollback.
zh-Hans.translation: 不健康的替换进程没有退出回滚。

zh-Hans.source: The update check was unavailable: {0} The installation and profile were not changed.
zh-Hans.translation: 更新检查不可用：{0} 安装和配置文件未更改。

zh-Hans.source: The update helper aborted the installation.
The update helper does not accept application arguments.
zh-Hans.translation: 更新助手不接受应用程序参数。

zh-Hans.source: The update helper started, but its status could not be confirmed. Close SrvSurvey before retrying; do not start another update.
zh-Hans.translation: 更新助手已启动，但无法确认其状态。重试前关闭SrvSurvey；不要开始另一个更新。

zh-Hans.source: The update helper stopped because SrvSurvey did not close. The prepared update was removed and no installation files were changed. Confirm again to retry.
zh-Hans.translation: 由于 SrvSurvey 未关闭，更新助手已停止。准备好的更新已被删除，并且安装文件没有更改。再次确认后重试。

zh-Hans.source: The update outcome was not opened by its installation directory.
zh-Hans.translation: 更新结果未由其安装目录打开。

zh-Hans.source: The update stopped, but its prepared files could not be cleaned up safely. Restart SrvSurvey or inspect Update Diagnostics before retrying. {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 更新已停止，但其准备的文件无法安全清理。重新启动 SrvSurvey 或在重试之前检查更新诊断。 {0}

zh-Hans.source: The update workflow could not complete: {0} Review Update Diagnostics before retrying.
zh-Hans.translation: 更新工作流程无法完成：{0} 在重试之前查看更新诊断。

zh-Hans.source: The updater merges live discoveries, local edits, and the latest Raven copy before publishing.
zh-Hans.translation: 更新程序在发布之前合并实时发现、本地编辑和最新的 Raven 副本。

zh-Hans.source: The upload protocol was adapted from the VoxStellar plugin for EDMC. Copyright © 2023 Sven Ziereis. The plugin's MIT License permits use and modification with its copyright and permission notice and provides the software without warranty. This implementation remains distributed under SrvSurvey's GPL-3.0 license.
zh-Hans.translation: 上传协议改编自 EDMC 的 VoxStellar 插件。版权所有 © 2023 斯文·齐雷斯。该插件的 MIT 许可证允许使用和修改其版权和许可声明，并提供无担保的软件。此实现仍然根据 SrvSurvey 的 GPL-3.0 许可证进行分发。

zh-Hans.source: The verified update helper is waiting. Close SrvSurvey to continue the update; the current installation remains available for rollback.
zh-Hans.translation: 已验证的更新助手正在等待。关闭SrvSurvey继续更新；当前安装仍然可以回滚。

zh-Hans.source: The warning is hidden when you leave the Rhino. Flight warnings are also hidden on foot and in ground vehicles, with the Nomad retaining its flight warnings.
zh-Hans.translation: 当您离开 Rhino 时，该警告将被隐藏。飞行警告也隐藏在步行和地面车辆中，Nomad 保留其飞行警告。

zh-Hans.source: The white or separately themed PIP means external candidate data has no reported discovery for this predicted organism in the current Galactic region. It is advisory until an in-game journal event confirms the result; hatching remains because the organism is predicted.
zh-Hans.translation: 白色或单独主题的 PIP 意味着外部候选数据在当前银河区域没有报告发现这种预测的生物体。在游戏内日志活动确认结果之前，此信息仅供参考；孵化仍然存在，因为有机体是被预测的。

zh-Hans.source: The written overlay theme did not verify.
zh-Hans.translation: 所写的覆盖主题未验证。

zh-Hans.source: The written overlay theme states did not verify.
zh-Hans.translation: 书面覆盖主题状态未验证。

zh-Hans.source: The xdg-mime protocol registration process did not start.
zh-Hans.translation: xdg-mime 协议注册过程未启动。

zh-Hans.source: The {0} guide could not be opened: {1}
The {0} is not available to copy.
Theme owns both application palettes and in-game overlay appearance, while Guides can search workflows, settings, and map symbols.
zh-Hans.translation: 主题拥有应用程序调色板和游戏内叠加外观，而指南可以搜索工作流程、设置和地图符号。

zh-Hans.source: Theme workspace: application versus overlay appearance
zh-Hans.translation: 主题工作区：应用程序与覆盖外观

zh-Hans.source: There are no Raven site changes to publish.
zh-Hans.translation: Raven 网站没有任何要发布的更改。

zh-Hans.source: There are no active or recently completed Community Goals associated with this commander right now.
zh-Hans.translation: 目前没有与该指挥官相关的活动或最近完成的社区目标。

zh-Hans.source: There is no active next hop to copy.
zh-Hans.translation: 没有要复制的活动下一跃点。

zh-Hans.source: These are bodies per recorded system, not the percentage of systems containing that body. A system containing four high-metal-content worlds adds four to the body count. The Nav Beacon setting affects only FSS-complete statistics and does not change averages.
zh-Hans.translation: 这些是每个记录系统的主体，而不是包含该主体的系统的百分比。包含四个高金属含量世界的系统会导致死亡人数增加四个。导航信标设置仅影响 FSS 完整统计数据，不会更改平均值。

zh-Hans.source: These are planning filters, not a merit calculator. Check current Powerplay assignments, system eligibility and acquisition support range in the game before mining or selling. Commodity prices and Powerplay observations may be stale; no reward is guaranteed. Unknown Power ownership is never counted as an enemy or an acquisition target.
zh-Hans.translation: 这些是计划过滤器，而不是绩效计算器。在挖矿或出售之前，检查游戏中当前的 Powerplay 分配、系统资格和获取支持范围。商品价格和 Powerplay 观察可能已过时；不保证奖励。未知的权力所有权永远不会被视为敌人或收购目标。

zh-Hans.source: These choices style only the Avalonia application shell and native light/dark controls. They never change the in-game overlay palette.
zh-Hans.translation: 这些选择仅设置 Avalonia 应用程序外壳和本机明/暗控件的样式。他们从不改变游戏内的叠加调色板。

zh-Hans.source: These filters only hide overlays; enabling a vehicle does not bypass the panel’s normal game-state trigger, visibility switch or focus rules. Editor previews remain available.
zh-Hans.translation: 这些过滤器仅隐藏覆盖层；启用车辆不会绕过面板的正常游戏状态触发器、可见性开关或焦点规则。编辑器预览仍然可用。

zh-Hans.source: These master switches control whether each panel may render. Existing auto-show and context settings still decide when an enabled panel appears. Shortcut fields are optional and have no default binding.
zh-Hans.translation: 这些主开关控制每个面板是否可以渲染。现有的自动显示和上下文设置仍然决定启用的面板何时出现。快捷方式字段是可选的，并且没有默认绑定。

zh-Hans.source: These shortcuts record or clear locations; they do not deploy or collect rigs in the game.
zh-Hans.translation: 这些快捷方式记录或清除位置；他们不会在游戏中部署或收集装备。

zh-Hans.source: These values belong only to the selected site: its type, origin, headings, notes, observed states, and local raw points. Save this survey separately from shared map changes.
zh-Hans.translation: 这些值仅属于选定的站点：其类型、起源、标题、注释、观察到的状态和本地原始点。将此调查与共享地图更改分开保存。

zh-Hans.source: These values identify this particular site in the systems table. They are autofilled from the journal when available and are saved to this commander survey, separately from the shared map geometry.
zh-Hans.translation: 这些值标识系统表中的这个特定站点。它们会在可用时从日志中自动填充，并保存到此指挥官调查中，与共享地图几何图形分开。

zh-Hans.source: This AppImage is mounted read-only and cannot replace itself; open the selected release and install its AppImage manually.
zh-Hans.translation: 此AppImage以只读方式安装，无法替换自身；打开所选版本并手动安装其 AppImage。

zh-Hans.source: This Elite Dangerous journal folder is available.
zh-Hans.translation: 此 Elite Dangerous 日志文件夹可用。

zh-Hans.source: This Frontier authorization was started by an older application version. Return to SrvSurvey and connect the active commander again.
zh-Hans.translation: 此 Frontier 授权是由较旧的应用程序版本启动的。返回 SrvSurvey 并再次连接活动指挥官。

zh-Hans.source: This boxel is recorded as empty.
This boxel search is already saved to the library.
zh-Hans.translation: 此框搜索已保存到库中。

zh-Hans.source: This construction site is not in the active project list.
zh-Hans.translation: 该建筑工地不在活动项目列表中。

zh-Hans.source: This development or unpackaged build cannot replace itself; use Open releases.
zh-Hans.translation: 此开发或未打包的构建无法自行替换；使用开放版本。

zh-Hans.source: This folder is unavailable on the current platform. Choose the journal folder used by this Elite installation.
zh-Hans.translation: 该文件夹在当前平台上不可用。选择此 Elite 安装使用的日志文件夹。

zh-Hans.source: This is an explicit completion rule when Spansh has body records older than the search start date, even when full-FSS completion is required.
zh-Hans.translation: 当 Spansh 的正文记录早于搜索开始日期时，这是一个显式完成规则，即使需要完整 FSS 完成也是如此。

zh-Hans.source: This key belongs to {0}, not {1}. The saved key was not changed.
zh-Hans.translation: 该密钥属于 {0}，而不是 {1}。保存的密钥未更改。

zh-Hans.source: This mapped obelisk is not active at the current site.
zh-Hans.translation: 该映射方尖碑在当前站点未激活。

zh-Hans.source: This merge never deletes existing firsts and does not upload historical events. Completed files remain valid if you stop early.
zh-Hans.translation: 此合并永远不会删除现有的第一个，也不会上传历史事件。如果您提早停止，已完成的文件仍然有效。

zh-Hans.source: This overlay panel is sharing the combined native overlay window.
zh-Hans.translation: 该覆盖面板共享组合的本机覆盖窗口。

zh-Hans.source: This platform does not provide a folder picker for exports.
zh-Hans.translation: 该平台不提供用于导出的文件夹选择器。

zh-Hans.source: This publishes the ship name, type, capacity, and Cargo.json counts only while visible colonization projects are active.
zh-Hans.translation: 仅当可见殖民项目处于活动状态时，才会发布船舶名称、类型、容量和 Cargo.json 计数。

zh-Hans.source: This rebuilds all visit statistics from the starting journal. Legacy note and screenshot tags in the journey timeline are removed, while the underlying system notes and PNG files remain untouched.
zh-Hans.translation: 这会从起始日志重建所有访问统计数据。旅程时间线中的旧注释和屏幕截图标签将被删除，而底层系统注释和 PNG 文件保持不变。

zh-Hans.source: This release uses EDDN's Live upload gateway with production schema references fixed internally.
zh-Hans.translation: 此版本使用 EDDN 的实时上传网关，并在内部修复了生产模式引用。

zh-Hans.source: This removes the 101-log checklist state but does not change the journal mission status.
zh-Hans.translation: 这会删除 101 日志清单状态，但不会更改日志任务状态。

zh-Hans.source: This removes the 28-log checklist state but does not change the journal mission status.
zh-Hans.translation: 这会删除 28 日志清单状态，但不会更改日志任务状态。

zh-Hans.source: This removes the saved configuration and its groups from SrvSurvey. It does not change your controls in Elite.
zh-Hans.translation: 这将从 SrvSurvey 中删除已保存的配置及其组。它不会改变您在 Elite 中的控制。

zh-Hans.source: This secured system can only be edited by its architect.
zh-Hans.translation: 该安全系统只能由其架构师进行编辑。

zh-Hans.source: This shortcut does not open simulated previews or change which overlays are visible.
zh-Hans.translation: 此快捷方式不会打开模拟预览或更改可见的叠加层。

zh-Hans.source: To correct a marker, stand at its true position and send .mine move <commodity> here. The nearest marker matching that commodity must be within 200 m. Example: .mine move haematite here.
zh-Hans.translation: 要纠正标记，请站在其真实位置并发送 .mine move <commodity> here。与该商品匹配的最近标记必须在 200 m 以内。示例：.mine move haematite here。

zh-Hans.source: To move an existing marker, clear it first, drive to the new position, and press its chord again to set it there.
zh-Hans.translation: 要移动现有标记，请先将其清除，移动到新位置，然后再次按下其和弦将其设置在那里。
切换驾驶舱模式 2 次以确认。

zh-Hans.source: Toggle first-footfall state for the current body.
zh-Hans.translation: 切换当前身体的首次落地状态。

zh-Hans.source: Toggles a thin red vertical guide at the exact center of the Elite window. Use the Rhino driving view, place a distant mining-location circle under the guide, then read the visible game compass heading for the .mine command. Turret mode does not show the required heading. Run the command again to hide the guide.
zh-Hans.translation: 切换精英窗口正中心的细红色垂直参考线。使用 Rhino 驾驶视图，在指南下放置一个远处的采矿位置圆圈，然后读取 .mine 命令的可见游戏罗盘标题。炮塔模式不显示所需的航向。再次运行该命令以隐藏指南。

zh-Hans.source: Totals changed for this session but could not be saved: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 此会话的总计已更改但无法保存：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Track Odyssey ground conflict-zone bonds and active ship massacre missions with the same journal rules as the original application.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用与原始应用程序相同的日志规则跟踪奥德赛地面冲突地区债券和活跃的船舶屠杀任务。

zh-Hans.source: Track active builds, choose which projects feed the cargo list, and inspect live construction requirements.
zh-Hans.translation: 跟踪活跃的构建，选择哪些项目满足货物清单，并检查实时构建需求。

zh-Hans.source: Track and publish cargo on ship (Needs API Key)
zh-Hans.translation: 跟踪和发布船上货物（需要 API 密钥）

zh-Hans.source: Track the six rigs automatically from their HUD bars. Detection adds a missing tracker immediately and clears its location only after three continuous seconds of empty readings.
zh-Hans.translation: 从 HUD 栏自动跟踪六个钻机。检测会立即添加丢失的跟踪器，并仅在连续三秒的空读数后清除其位置。

zh-Hans.source: Trailblazers cargo - before: {0:N0} bought / {1:N0} sold / {2:N0} transferred; after: {3:N0} / {4:N0} / {5:N0}.
Transferred update ownership has no installation plan.
zh-Hans.translation: 转移的更新所有权没有安装计划。
已翻译的 {0} 旧版 UI 首选项。

zh-Hans.source: Travel → Distance follows FC Routes. Calculate distances and save a home system there.
zh-Hans.translation: 行程 → 距离遵循 FC 路线。计算距离并在那里保存家庭系统。
旅行、搜索、守护、殖民、消息

zh-Hans.source: Treat systems visited before the start date as complete
zh-Hans.translation: 将开始日期之前访问的系统视为完整

zh-Hans.source: Treat systems whose Spansh body data predates the start date as complete
zh-Hans.translation: 将 Spansh 主体数据早于开始日期的系统视为完整
将导航信标视为已完全扫描

zh-Hans.source: Try a workspace name, overlay title, icon, journal event, setting, or task such as scanning, importing, or plotting a route.
zh-Hans.translation: 尝试使用工作区名称、叠加标题、图标、日志事件、设置或任务（例如扫描、导入或绘制路线）。

zh-Hans.source: Tune the FSS to a planet
zh-Hans.translation: 将 FSS 调整到行星

zh-Hans.source: Two vehicle columns sit above the rig chevrons, with cargo capacity below them.
zh-Hans.translation: 两个车辆列位于钻机 V 字形上方，下方具有载货能力。

zh-Hans.source: Type .add followed by a valid Guardian point type while at the point.
zh-Hans.translation: 键入 .add，然后在该点键入有效的 Guardian 点类型。

zh-Hans.source: Type .note followed by text to append a site note.
zh-Hans.translation: 键入 .note，后跟文本以附加站点注释。

zh-Hans.source: Type .site <type> to select the mapped Guardian layout.
zh-Hans.translation: 键入 .site <type> 以选择映射的 Guardian 布局。

zh-Hans.source: Type A, B, or G for common ruins layouts, or send .site followed by a supported layout name.
zh-Hans.translation: 对于常见的废墟布局，请键入 A、B 或 G，或者发送 .site 后跟受支持的布局名称。

zh-Hans.source: Type A, B, or G for ruins, or .site <type> for any mapped Guardian layout.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入 A、B 或 G 表示废墟，或输入 .site <type> 表示任何映射的 Guardian 布局。

zh-Hans.source: Type at least 3 characters for system suggestions.
zh-Hans.translation: 输入至少 3 个字符以获取系统建议。

zh-Hans.source: Type more words to narrow the results
zh-Hans.translation: 输入更多单词以缩小结果范围
未扫描的 RAM TAH 日志：3
未扫描的 RAM TAH 日志：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Understand procedural boxels, run bounded system surveys, navigate nested search trees, and preserve multiple research projects.
zh-Hans.translation: 了解程序框、运行有界系统调查、导航嵌套搜索树以及保存多个研究项目。

zh-Hans.source: Understand the live Commander state, multi-Commander selection, and the difference between current-session and historical data.
zh-Hans.translation: 了解实时 Commander 状态、多 Commander 选择以及当前会话和历史数据之间的差异。

zh-Hans.source: Unknown compatible JSON fields are preserved where the modern store supports lossless merging. Incompatible reference catalogs are ignored safely and reported in logs.
zh-Hans.translation: 现代存储支持无损合并时，会保留未知的兼容 JSON 字段。不兼容的参考目录将被安全地忽略并在日志中报告。

zh-Hans.source: Unknown coordinates are not treated as nearby. Bundled observations are historical; multiple hotspots alone do not establish an overlap. Local searches show at most 500 rings.
zh-Hans.translation: 未知坐标不会被视为附近。捆绑观察是历史性的；多个热点本身并不能建立重叠。本地搜索最多显示 500 个响铃。

zh-Hans.source: Unknown points use the cyan dotted survey treatment, absent points use translucent gray, present points use their POI-specific legacy color, and empty puddles use gold with a yellow edge.
zh-Hans.translation: 未知点使用青色点状测量处理，缺失点使用半透明灰色，存在点使用其 POI 特定的旧颜色，空水坑使用带有黄色边缘的金色。
未知奖励 PIP 外边框

zh-Hans.source: Unread message counts are shown in the application and the compact quest indicator.
zh-Hans.translation: 未读消息计数显示在应用程序和紧凑任务指示器中。
未保存的旅程更改已被丢弃。
保留未保存的路线编辑。
不支持的屏幕截图格式。

zh-Hans.source: Update cache cleanup retained an inaccessible directory: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 更新缓存清理保留了无法访问的目录：{0}

zh-Hans.translation: 安装移交之前更新已取消。准备好的候选人被删除，并且没有更改任何文件。

zh-Hans.source: Update canceled. The other SrvSurvey instances remain open and no files were changed.
zh-Hans.translation: 更新已取消。其他 SrvSurvey 实例保持打开状态，并且没有文件发生更改。
更新候选清理需要注意。

zh-Hans.translation: 更新运行状况确认并非来自已安装的替代品。

zh-Hans.translation: 更新助手结果对于 {1} 内的请求 {0} 不可用。
更新助手所有权尚未解决。

zh-Hans.translation: 更新历史记录清理无法运行：{0}

zh-Hans.translation: 更新历史记录清理保留了无法访问的目录：{0}

zh-Hans.translation: 更新实例注册不可用；继续进程名称和可执行文件路径发现。 {0}

更新替换运行状况确认失败：{0}

Update {0} was aborted before completion; the active installation was preserved.{1}
zh-Hans.translation: 更新 {0} 在完成之前被中止；保留活动安装。{1}

zh-Hans.translation: 更新 {0} 已回滚；之前的安装已恢复。{1}

zh-Hans.translation: 更新了 {0} 来自 {1} 的链接舰队承运商货物条目。

zh-Hans.translation: 更新了船舶货物差异中的 {0} 链接中队舰队航母货物条目。

zh-Hans.translation: 更新了{0}。保留经过验证的状态备份。
