zh-Hans.source: Upload newly calculated settlement geometry to Canonn
zh-Hans.translation: 将新计算的沉降几何形状上传到 Canonn

zh-Hans.source: Uploaded a {0} Green Gas Giant candidate.
zh-Hans.translation: 上传了 {0} 绿色气体巨星候选者。

zh-Hans.source: Uploaded newly calculated settlement geometry to Canonn.
zh-Hans.translation: 已将新计算的沉降几何形状上传至 Canonn。

zh-Hans.source: Uploaded settlement geometry for {0} to Canonn.
zh-Hans.translation: 已将 {0} 的沉降几何形状上传至 Canonn。
已上传 {0} 绿色气体巨星候选者。

zh-Hans.source: Use .tower to record the nearest relic tower state, .empty for an empty puddle, and .note followed by text to append a site note.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用 .tower 记录最近的遗迹塔状态，.empty 表示空水坑，.note 后跟文本以附加站点注释。

zh-Hans.source: Use Add measured point only while the selected survey is the active site and valid surface position, body radius, site heading, and Commander position agree.
zh-Hans.translation: 仅当所选测量是活动站点且有效表面位置、主体半径、站点航向和指挥官位置一致时，才使用“添加测量点”。

zh-Hans.source: Use Audit all boxels when you need every branch refreshed against local history and Spansh rather than only the current boxel. Large audits require explicit confirmation because they can make more than 1,000 requests.
zh-Hans.translation: 当您需要根据本地历史记录和 Spansh 而不仅仅是当前 boxel 刷新每个分支时，请使用审核所有 boxel。大型审核需要明确确认，因为它们可能会提出 1,000 多个请求。

zh-Hans.source: Use Check All or Uncheck All, then select the allowed entries under Small, Medium, Large and Vessel / Vehicle. Changes save immediately.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用“全部选中”或“取消全部选中”，然后选择“小型”、“中型”、“大型”和“船舶/车辆”下允许的条目。更改立即保存。

zh-Hans.source: Use Clear primary only when you intentionally want aggregate planning across visible projects.
zh-Hans.translation: 仅当您有意希望跨可见项目进行聚合规划时，才使用“清除主要”。

zh-Hans.source: Use Copy next, or enable Auto-copy next system in Galaxy Map, then paste the name into the Galaxy Map. Boxel, Route Manager, and FC Route auto-copy are mutually exclusive.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用复制下一个系统，或在 Galaxy Map 中启用自动复制下一个系统，然后将名称粘贴到 Galaxy Map 中。 Boxel、Route Manager 和 FC Route 自动复制是互斥的。

zh-Hans.source: Use FSS, body, system, route, and screenshot tools without losing the familiar original-overlay cues.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用 FSS、主体、系统、路线和屏幕截图工具，而不会丢失熟悉的原始叠加提示。

zh-Hans.source: Use Local discoveries / import journals to review your own scans and import earlier journals. Search destinations returns to online/local combined searching. Provider page starts at 0; station searches use 20 results per page.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用本地发现/导入期刊来查看您自己的扫描并导入早期期刊。搜索目的地返回在线/本地组合搜索。提供者页面从0开始；电台搜索每页使用 20 个结果。

zh-Hans.source: Use Mark Next Empty only when the Galaxy Map confirms that the next incomplete system does not exist. The marker is retained and the search skips to the following target.
zh-Hans.translation: 仅当 Galaxy Map 确认下一个不完整系统不存在时才使用“Mark Next Empty”。标记被保留，搜索跳至下一个目标。

zh-Hans.source: Use Next Elite window when several game clients are open and an overlay needs to follow a different window.
zh-Hans.translation: 当打开多个游戏客户端并且覆盖层需要遵循不同的窗口时，请使用“Next Elite”窗口。

zh-Hans.source: Use Refresh boxel to merge systems from the local Commander profile, the active route, and Spansh. Community databases contain only submitted observations, so an unknown system is not proof that it does not exist.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用刷新框合并本地指挥官配置文件、活动路线和 Spansh 中的系统。社区数据库仅包含提交的观察结果，因此未知系统并不能证明它不存在。

zh-Hans.source: Use Settings > Overlay behavior and layout to disable individual overlays or change their triggers.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用“设置”>“叠加层行为和布局”来禁用各个叠加层或更改其触发器。

zh-Hans.source: Use Show system notes to edit notes for the current system without leaving the game context.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用“显示系统注释”可以在不离开游戏上下文的情况下编辑当前系统的注释。

zh-Hans.source: Use Size−/Size+ for circle diameter, Height−/Height+ for oval proportions, and R−/R+ for outline rotation. Gap−/Gap+ move the cyan bar curves closer to or farther below the circles without changing the outlines. Align them with the middle of the deployed rig's segmented bar. The curves show the expected bar shape; detection groups matching colored segments and ignores neutral circle outlines. Each circle centre can be positioned independently to match the sloping cockpit HUD.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用 Size−/Size+ 表示圆形直径，使用 Height−/Height+ 表示椭圆比例，使用 R−/R+ 表示轮廓旋转。 Gap−/Gap+ 将青色条形曲线移近或移至圆圈下方，而不改变轮廓。将它们与已部署装备的分段杆的中间对齐。曲线显示了预期的条形形状；检测组匹配彩色片段并忽略中性圆圈轮廓。每个圆心都可以独立定位，以匹配倾斜的驾驶舱 HUD。
使用 SrvSurvey-XP 开发版本

zh-Hans.source: Use Stop search when you want the live Boxel workflow inactive while retaining both its current profile state and its linked library progress.
zh-Hans.translation: 当您希望实时 Boxel 工作流程处于非活动状态，同时保留其当前配置文件状态及其链接库进度时，请使用停止搜索。

zh-Hans.source: Use Track location 1 through 8 shortcuts to toggle reusable surface bookmarks.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用轨道位置 1 至 8 快捷方式切换可重复使用的表面书签。

zh-Hans.source: Use Up and Down to move, Enter to open the selected setting, or Escape to clear the search.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用向上和向下移动，使用 Enter 打开所选设置，或使用 Esc 清除搜索。

zh-Hans.source: Use a persisted folder for non-default Windows installations, Proton prefixes, and copied profiles.
zh-Hans.translation: 对非默认 Windows 安装、Proton 前缀和复制的配置文件使用持久文件夹。

zh-Hans.source: Use body type, geology, and stellar clues to narrow the search for a surface-mining commodity. Prices are a community snapshot and can change.
zh-Hans.translation: 利用体型、地质和恒星线索来缩小对露天采矿商品的搜索范围。价格是社区快照，可能会发生变化。
在 B → C 上使用升压

zh-Hans.source: Use current restores the active Commander system as the distance origin.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用电流将活动 Commander 系统恢复为距离原点。

zh-Hans.source: Use downloaded bio data from Canonn and Spansh
zh-Hans.translation: 使用从 Canonn 和 Spansh 下载的生物数据

zh-Hans.source: Use last updated time from Spansh not EDSM
zh-Hans.translation: 使用 Spansh 的上次更新时间，而不是 EDSM

zh-Hans.source: Use one of the five original Guardian plotter sizes.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用五种原始 Guardian 绘图仪尺寸之一。

zh-Hans.source: Use only one EDDN uploader at a time. Disable sharing in SrvSurvey when EDMC or another application already publishes the same events.
zh-Hans.translation: 一次仅使用一个 EDDN 上传器。当 EDMC 或其他应用程序已发布相同事件时，禁用 SrvSurvey 中的共享。

zh-Hans.source: Use the Boxel workspace after choosing a procedurally generated system whose surrounding sequence you want to survey.
zh-Hans.translation: 选择要调查其周围序列的程序生成的系统后，使用 Boxel 工作区。

zh-Hans.source: Use the Composition Scanner to identify organisms.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用成分扫描仪来识别生物体。

zh-Hans.source: Use the Multiple commanders card on Overview to launch an isolated SrvSurvey process for another saved profile.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用概述上的多个指挥官卡为另一个保存的配置文件启动独立的 SrvSurvey 进程。

zh-Hans.source: Use the Raven links when you need to review a project or system in the website.
zh-Hans.translation: 当您需要查看网站中的项目或系统时，请使用 Raven 链接。

zh-Hans.source: Use the Rhino mining radar, rig key chords, vehicle guidance, and cargo display while working on a planetary surface.
zh-Hans.translation: 在行星表面工作时使用 Rhino 采矿雷达、装备键、车辆引导和货物显示。

zh-Hans.source: Use the check button to save every staged position, or X to close and restore the original layout.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用复选按钮保存每个舞台位置，或使用 X 关闭并恢复原始布局。

zh-Hans.source: Use the configurable jump-information shortcut to show or hide the route overlay manually.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用可配置的跳转信息快捷方式手动显示或隐藏路线叠加。

zh-Hans.source: Use the global overlay visibility shortcut when you need to hide or restore every detached overlay at once.
zh-Hans.translation: 当您需要一次隐藏或恢复每个分离的叠加层时，请使用全局叠加层可见性快捷方式。

zh-Hans.source: Use the most recent visit to {0}.
Use the mouse wheel or − / + controls to zoom. Drag the map to pan after zooming in. Right-click to place or remove a 4.5 km planning circle; hold the right button and drag to move it.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用鼠标滚轮或 - / + 控件进行缩放。地图放大后拖动平移。右键放置或删除4.5公里规划圈；按住右键并拖动以移动它。

zh-Hans.source: Use the origin guidance to align an aerial screenshot. Type .map to return.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用原点引导来对齐航拍屏幕截图。输入 .map 返回。

zh-Hans.source: Use the original SrvSurvey shortcuts while either this application or Elite Dangerous has focus.
zh-Hans.translation: 当此应用程序或 Elite Dangerous 具有焦点时，使用原始 SrvSurvey 快捷方式。

zh-Hans.source: Use the original local-flora naming contract, retain an imported image cache, or download biology references for offline browsing.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用原始的本地植物区系命名合同，保留导入的图像缓存，或下载生物学参考文献以供离线浏览。

zh-Hans.source: Use the overlay color and warning text to distinguish valid in-radius destinations, out-of-radius systems, low mass codes, and already-surveyed systems.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用覆盖颜色和警告文本来区分有效的半径内目的地、半径外系统、低质量代码和已调查的系统。

zh-Hans.source: Use the overlay position editor to move or resize the panel. Its colors follow the selected overlay theme, including Monochrome Companion.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用叠加位置编辑器移动面板或调整面板大小。其颜色遵循所选的叠加主题，包括 Monochrome Companion。

zh-Hans.source: Use the overlay-settings icon beside a supported navigation category to open only that activity's overlay controls. The main Settings workspace remains the complete view.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用支持的导航类别旁边的覆盖设置图标仅打开该活动的覆盖控件。主设置工作区仍然是完整视图。

zh-Hans.source: Use the quest communications shortcut to show or hide the overlay without stopping the quest.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用任务通信快捷方式显示或隐藏覆盖层，而无需停止任务。

zh-Hans.source: Use the screenshot-data shortcut to enable or disable banners for future images.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用屏幕截图数据快捷方式启用或禁用未来图像的横幅。

zh-Hans.source: Use the sidebar icon at the top-right of the navigation column to collapse it into a narrow strip and give the current workspace more room. The same icon restores navigation; your selected workspace stays open and the window keeps its size.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用导航栏右上角的侧边栏图标将其折叠成窄条，并为当前工作区提供更多空间。相同的图标恢复导航；您选择的工作区保持打开状态，窗口保持其大小。

zh-Hans.source: Use the smallest targeted recovery before considering a profile import or reset.
zh-Hans.translation: 在考虑配置文件导入或重置之前，请使用最小的目标恢复。

zh-Hans.source: Useful actions include overlay visibility, live interaction, map zoom, jump/FSS/body/station panels, colony shopping, system notes, boxel copy/paste, quest communications, VR adjustment, surface bookmarks, and screenshot data.
zh-Hans.translation: 有用的操作包括覆盖可见性、实时交互、地图缩放、跳跃/FSS/主体/站面板、殖民地购物、系统注释、boxel复制/粘贴、任务通信、VR调整、表面书签和屏幕截图数据。

zh-Hans.source: Uses carriers linked in RavenColonial. Cargo updates follow the existing colonization sync settings.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用 RavenColonial 中链接的运营商。货物更新遵循现有的殖民同步设置。

zh-Hans.source: Uses current Spansh station data for pads, economies, faction, relevant services, and prohibited commodities. Alt+I toggles the overlay manually.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用当前的 Spansh 站点数据来获取 pad、经济体、派系、相关服务和违禁商品。 Alt+I 手动切换覆盖。

zh-Hans.source: Uses the Spansh system timestamp instead of the newest EDSM body timestamp in Jump Info and Galaxy Map summaries. This is a read-only lookup and does not publish journal data.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用 Spansh 系统时间戳而不是跳转信息和银河地图摘要中最新的 EDSM 正文时间戳。这是只读查找，不会发布期刊数据。

zh-Hans.source: Uses the original SrvSurvey translations where available. New port-only text falls back to English.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用原始的 SrvSurvey 翻译（如果有）。新的仅端口文本回落为英语。

zh-Hans.source: Uses the same body-class, terraformability, discovery, mapping, Odyssey, and probe-efficiency formula as the WinForms application.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用与 WinForms 应用程序相同的主体等级、地形适应性、发现、绘图、Odyssey 和探测效率公式。

zh-Hans.source: Using separate native overlay windows for the current desktop host.
zh-Hans.translation: 为当前桌面主机使用单独的本机覆盖窗口。

zh-Hans.source: Using {0} validated catalog(s) from the imported legacy profile; all others use embedded defaults.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用导入的旧配置文件中的 {0} 经验证的目录；所有其他都使用嵌入式默认值。
使用 {0} {1} 作为距离原点。

zh-Hans.source: VR calibration '{0}' must be a string.
zh-Hans.translation: VR 校准“{0}”必须是字符串。

zh-Hans.source: VR calibrations could not be loaded: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法加载 VR 校准：{0}

zh-Hans.source: VR overlay adjustment captures and resets orientation through dedicated actions; capability and status are reported when the runtime is unavailable.
zh-Hans.translation: VR叠加调整通过专用动作捕捉和重置方向；当运行时不可用时，会报告功能和状态。

zh-Hans.source: VR override '{0}/{1}' could not be verified before saving.
zh-Hans.translation: VR 覆盖“{0}/{1}”在保存前无法验证。

zh-Hans.source: VR scale must be from 0.1 to 50 and all coordinates must be finite.
zh-Hans.translation: VR 比例必须在 0.1 到 50 之间，并且所有坐标必须是有限的。

zh-Hans.source: Validated embedded reference catalogs are active.
zh-Hans.translation: 经过验证的嵌入参考目录处于活动状态。
正在验证和导入开发任务...

zh-Hans.source: Validating the Raven API key without saving it...
zh-Hans.translation: 正在验证 Raven API 密钥而不保存它...

zh-Hans.source: Verification complete; restarting SrvSurvey with the migrated profile...
zh-Hans.translation: 验证完成；正在使用迁移的配置文件重新启动 SrvSurvey...

zh-Hans.source: Verified update replacement startup with the handoff helper.
zh-Hans.translation: 使用切换助手验证更新替换启动。
已验证的 {0} 暂存文件；准备回滚...

zh-Hans.source: Very unforgiving; small mistakes = hull damage or death
zh-Hans.translation: 非常不宽容；小错误=船体损坏或死亡

zh-Hans.source: Visible live overlays are clickable and can be dragged. Use the shortcut again to save and restore click-through mode.
zh-Hans.translation: 可见的实时叠加层可点击且可拖动。再次使用快捷方式保存并恢复点击模式。

zh-Hans.source: Visit the selected site before editing its commander survey.
zh-Hans.translation: 在编辑其指挥官调查之前访问所选站点。
访问过的星星参考缓存

zh-Hans.source: Visited-star cache swap/restore is blocked while Elite is running, uses a persistent original backup, validates responses, and rolls back failed activation.
zh-Hans.translation: 当 Elite 运行时，访问之星缓存交换/恢复会被阻止，使用持久的原始备份，验证响应，并回滚失败的激活。

zh-Hans.source: Visited-stars cache replacement is unavailable during diagnostic replay.
zh-Hans.translation: 在诊断重放期间，访问明星缓存替换不可用。

zh-Hans.source: Visited-stars restore failed without discarding the current cache: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 访问过的星星恢复失败，未丢弃当前缓存：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Visited-stars setup could not be refreshed: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 无法刷新访问明星设置：{0}

zh-Hans.source: Visited-stars swap failed without replacing the original cache: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: 访问过的星星交换失败，未替换原始缓存：{0}

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar is an independent boxel-surveying service. SrvSurvey can send selected new exploration journal events to it only after you opt in from the top of the Boxel workspace.
zh-Hans.translation: VoxStellar 是一项独立的 boxel 测量服务。仅当您从 Boxel 工作区顶部选择加入后，SrvSurvey 才可以向其发送选定的新探索日志事件。

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar maintains its own database and says it does not forward these submissions to EDDN. Use a separate EDDN-capable tool when you also want to contribute discoveries to the wider community database.
zh-Hans.translation: VoxStellar 维护自己的数据库，并表示不会将这些提交转发给 EDDN。当您还想将发现贡献给更广泛的社区数据库时，请使用独立的 EDDN 功能工具。

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar processing was isolated from journal tracking: {0}
zh-Hans.translation: VoxStellar 处理与日志跟踪隔离：{0}

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar says it stores system names and coordinates, stars, planets and moons, exobiology discoveries, boxel classifications and metadata, discovery timestamps, and commander attribution for survey tracking, analysis, dashboards, and team collaboration.
zh-Hans.translation: VoxStellar 表示它存储系统名称和坐标、恒星、行星和卫星、外星生物学发现、boxel 分类和元数据、发现时间戳以及用于调查跟踪、分析、仪表板和团队协作的指挥官归因。

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar upload cannot be enabled because this build does not include its integration signing key.
zh-Hans.translation: 无法启用 VoxStellar 上传，因为此版本不包含其集成签名密钥。

zh-Hans.source: VoxStellar upload is unavailable in this build because its integration signing key is not configured.
zh-Hans.translation: VoxStellar 上传在此版本中不可用，因为未配置其集成签名密钥。

ps.source: A Codex image cache directory is required.
ps.translation: * A CODEX IMAGE CACHE DIRECTORY IS REQUIRED. >>>!

ps.source: A DSS scan is required before genus and species rows are available.
ps.translation: * A DSS SCAN IS REQUIRED BEFORE GENUS AND SPECIES ROWS ARE AVAILABLE. >>>!

ps.source: A Frontier connection is already waiting for browser authorization.
ps.translation: * A FRONTIER CONNECTION IS ALREADY WAITING FOR BROWSER AUTHORIZATION. >>>!

ps.source: A Guardian beacon scan could not be recorded.
ps.translation: * A GUARDIAN BEACON SCAN COULD NOT BE RECORDED. >>>!

ps.source: A Guardian beacon scan was detected without a system address.
ps.translation: * A GUARDIAN BEACON SCAN WAS DETECTED WITHOUT A SYSTEM ADDRESS. >>>!

ps.source: A Guardian beacon scan was detected without a system name.
ps.translation: * A GUARDIAN BEACON SCAN WAS DETECTED WITHOUT A SYSTEM NAME. >>>!

ps.source: A Raven API key is saved for this commander.
ps.translation: * A RAVEN API KEY IS SAVED FOR THIS COMMANDER. >>>!

ps.source: A SHA-256 manifest records the imported files so partial copies and silent corruption can be detected.
ps.translation: * A SHA-256 MANIFEST RECORDS THE IMPORTED FILES SO PARTIAL COPIES AND SILENT CORRUPTION CAN BE DETECTED. >>>!

ps.source: A VR override must contain only a calibration block.
ps.translation: * A VR OVERRIDE MUST CONTAIN ONLY A CALIBRATION BLOCK. >>>!

ps.source: A binding is reported as unavailable when the current operating system cannot provide the required global input capability.
ps.translation: * A BINDING IS REPORTED AS UNAVAILABLE WHEN THE CURRENT OPERATING SYSTEM CANNOT PROVIDE THE REQUIRED GLOBAL INPUT CAPABILITY. >>>!

ps.source: A blue neutron-star marker identifies a route waypoint that uses or approaches a neutron-star FSD boost.
ps.translation: * A BLUE NEUTRON-STAR MARKER IDENTIFIES A ROUTE WAYPOINT THAT USES OR APPROACHES A NEUTRON-STAR FSD BOOST. >>>!

ps.source: A body count of zero displays —. Changing the minimum setting re-formats the current results immediately.
ps.translation: * A BODY COUNT OF ZERO DISPLAYS —. CHANGING THE MINIMUM SETTING RE-FORMATS THE CURRENT RESULTS IMMEDIATELY. >>>!

ps.source: A body row can contain more prediction PIPs than its reported biological-signal count when several genera remain plausible. Those additional hatched PIPs are alternative candidates, not extra signals or additive rewards.
ps.translation: * A BODY ROW CAN CONTAIN MORE PREDICTION PIPS THAN ITS REPORTED BIOLOGICAL-SIGNAL COUNT WHEN SEVERAL GENERA REMAIN PLAUSIBLE. THOSE ADDITIONAL HATCHED PIPS ARE ALTERNATIVE CANDIDATES, NOT EXTRA SIGNALS OR ADDITIVE REWARDS. >>>!

ps.source: A bookmarked map loads automatically when your live surface position enters its saved border and unloads when you leave the area.
ps.translation: * A BOOKMARKED MAP LOADS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN YOUR LIVE SURFACE POSITION ENTERS ITS SAVED BORDER AND UNLOADS WHEN YOU LEAVE THE AREA. >>>!

ps.source: A boxel is a cubic subsector of procedurally generated space. Systems in one boxel share the same generated-name prefix and use a numeric suffix as their sequence within that boxel.
ps.translation: * A BOXEL IS A CUBIC SUBSECTOR OF PROCEDURALLY GENERATED SPACE. SYSTEMS IN ONE BOXEL SHARE THE SAME GENERATED-NAME PREFIX AND USE A NUMERIC SUFFIX AS THEIR SEQUENCE WITHIN THAT BOXEL. >>>!

ps.source: A cache-write failure does not repeat a successful server mutation in the same session.
ps.translation: * A CACHE-WRITE FAILURE DOES NOT REPEAT A SUCCESSFUL SERVER MUTATION IN THE SAME SESSION. >>>!

ps.source: A check beside value means the detailed surface scan is complete.
ps.translation: * A CHECK BESIDE VALUE MEANS THE DETAILED SURFACE SCAN IS COMPLETE. >>>!

ps.source: A check means that source has enough for the row. A direction marker calls out the next useful item or focused project. Dimmed rows are unavailable or already satisfied.
ps.translation: * A CHECK MEANS THAT SOURCE HAS ENOUGH FOR THE ROW. A DIRECTION MARKER CALLS OUT THE NEXT USEFUL ITEM OR FOCUSED PROJECT. DIMMED ROWS ARE UNAVAILABLE OR ALREADY SATISFIED. >>>!

ps.source: A circle with a heading stalk shows the Commander's position and facing on the settlement map.
ps.translation: * A CIRCLE WITH A HEADING STALK SHOWS THE COMMANDER'S POSITION AND FACING ON THE SETTLEMENT MAP. >>>!

ps.source: A circle with a lightning stroke marks a power post.
ps.translation: * A CIRCLE WITH A LIGHTNING STROKE MARKS A POWER POST. >>>!

ps.source: A command-line Frontier ID controls this instance. Remove it to use a saved preference.
ps.translation: * A COMMAND-LINE FRONTIER ID CONTROLS THIS INSTANCE. REMOVE IT TO USE A SAVED PREFERENCE. >>>!

ps.source: A commander profile is required before sharing survey data.
ps.translation: * A COMMANDER PROFILE IS REQUIRED BEFORE SHARING SURVEY DATA. >>>!

ps.source: A commander profile is required before this setting can be saved.
ps.translation: * A COMMANDER PROFILE IS REQUIRED BEFORE THIS SETTING CAN BE SAVED. >>>!

ps.source: A commander profile is required to change mission progress.
ps.translation: * A COMMANDER PROFILE IS REQUIRED TO CHANGE MISSION PROGRESS. >>>!

ps.source: A compatible live construction depot is ready.
ps.translation: * A COMPATIBLE LIVE CONSTRUCTION DEPOT IS READY. >>>!

ps.source: A cooperative instance shutdown request failed: {0}
ps.translation: * A COOPERATIVE INSTANCE SHUTDOWN REQUEST FAILED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: A correct site type and heading make the projected map line up with the ruins or structure.
ps.translation: * A CORRECT SITE TYPE AND HEADING MAKE THE PROJECTED MAP LINE UP WITH THE RUINS OR STRUCTURE. >>>!

ps.source: A current journal system is required, or search for a prior system.
ps.translation: * A CURRENT JOURNAL SYSTEM IS REQUIRED, OR SEARCH FOR A PRIOR SYSTEM. >>>!

ps.source: A current ship and surface position are required to calibrate its cockpit offset.
ps.translation: * A CURRENT SHIP AND SURFACE POSITION ARE REQUIRED TO CALIBRATE ITS COCKPIT OFFSET. >>>!

ps.source: A cyan obelisk with a 90-degree radial glow is active. The glow center is cyan when its log is needed for the active Ram Tah mission, orange when scanned, and light gray when active but neither needed nor scanned.
ps.translation: * A CYAN OBELISK WITH A 90-DEGREE RADIAL GLOW IS ACTIVE. THE GLOW CENTER IS CYAN WHEN ITS LOG IS NEEDED FOR THE ACTIVE RAM TAH MISSION, ORANGE WHEN SCANNED, AND LIGHT GRAY WHEN ACTIVE BUT NEITHER NEEDED NOR SCANNED. >>>!

ps.source: A dashed dark-red line through site center is the recorded site alignment heading and rotates with the live Commander view.
ps.translation: * A DASHED DARK-RED LINE THROUGH SITE CENTER IS THE RECORDED SITE ALIGNMENT HEADING AND ROTATES WITH THE LIVE COMMANDER VIEW. >>>!

ps.source: A default Codex image cache directory is required.
ps.translation: * A DEFAULT CODEX IMAGE CACHE DIRECTORY IS REQUIRED. >>>!

ps.source: A dimmed PIP means that organism has already been analyzed for the current body. Its reward band remains visible for reference, but it is no longer an outstanding sample.
ps.translation: * A DIMMED PIP MEANS THAT ORGANISM HAS ALREADY BEEN ANALYZED FOR THE CURRENT BODY. ITS REWARD BAND REMAINS VISIBLE FOR REFERENCE, BUT IT IS NO LONGER AN OUTSTANDING SAMPLE. >>>!

ps.source: A dot and radius mark one of the eight reusable tracked surface locations. Inactive bookmarks are dimmed.
ps.translation: * A DOT AND RADIUS MARK ONE OF THE EIGHT REUSABLE TRACKED SURFACE LOCATIONS. INACTIVE BOOKMARKS ARE DIMMED. >>>!

ps.source: A dotted ring marks a point or site state that still needs survey data.
ps.translation: * A DOTTED RING MARKS A POINT OR SITE STATE THAT STILL NEEDS SURVEY DATA. >>>!

ps.source: A filled discovery flag is a Commander first; an outline flag is a regional first. Highlighting regional firsts is optional.
ps.translation: * A FILLED DISCOVERY FLAG IS A COMMANDER FIRST; AN OUTLINE FLAG IS A REGIONAL FIRST. HIGHLIGHTING REGIONAL FIRSTS IS OPTIONAL. >>>!

ps.source: A filled flag marks a Commander first, an outline flag marks a Commander regional first, and a sun marks a potential Galactic-region first from external candidate data.
ps.translation: * A FILLED FLAG MARKS A COMMANDER FIRST, AN OUTLINE FLAG MARKS A COMMANDER REGIONAL FIRST, AND A SUN MARKS A POTENTIAL GALACTIC-REGION FIRST FROM EXTERNAL CANDIDATE DATA. >>>!

ps.source: A first-discovery flag means the body was not previously discovered according to the journal data.
ps.translation: * A FIRST-DISCOVERY FLAG MEANS THE BODY WAS NOT PREVIOUSLY DISCOVERED ACCORDING TO THE JOURNAL DATA. >>>!

ps.source: A gold target circle means the Commander is outside the objective radius; the accent color means the Commander is inside it.
ps.translation: * A GOLD TARGET CIRCLE MEANS THE COMMANDER IS OUTSIDE THE OBJECTIVE RADIUS; THE ACCENT COLOR MEANS THE COMMANDER IS INSIDE IT. >>>!

ps.source: A gold-filled, yellow-edged circle identifies a surveyed artifact puddle with no object present.
ps.translation: * A GOLD-FILLED, YELLOW-EDGED CIRCLE IDENTIFIES A SURVEYED ARTIFACT PUDDLE WITH NO OBJECT PRESENT. >>>!

ps.source: A ground target stores latitude and longitude for the current body and turns them into bearing, distance, and approach guidance.
ps.translation: * A GROUND TARGET STORES LATITUDE AND LONGITUDE FOR THE CURRENT BODY AND TURNS THEM INTO BEARING, DISTANCE, AND APPROACH GUIDANCE. >>>!

ps.source: A hatched reward PIP is a prediction. A solid PIP is a confirmed organism. A trailing question mark means that organism is still predicted rather than identified; hover it for the exact state.
ps.translation: * A HATCHED REWARD PIP IS A PREDICTION. A SOLID PIP IS A CONFIRMED ORGANISM. A TRAILING QUESTION MARK MEANS THAT ORGANISM IS STILL PREDICTED RATHER THAN IDENTIFIED; HOVER IT FOR THE EXACT STATE. >>>!

ps.source: A hosted overlay requires a positive polling interval.
ps.translation: * A HOSTED OVERLAY REQUIRES A POSITIVE POLLING INTERVAL. >>>!

ps.source: A journal folder is required to replay quest events.
ps.translation: * A JOURNAL FOLDER IS REQUIRED TO REPLAY QUEST EVENTS. >>>!

ps.source: A known battery or energy-cell location in a human settlement.
ps.translation: * A KNOWN BATTERY OR ENERGY-CELL LOCATION IN A HUMAN SETTLEMENT. >>>!

ps.source: A known medical-kit location in a human settlement.
ps.translation: * A KNOWN MEDICAL-KIT LOCATION IN A HUMAN SETTLEMENT. >>>!

ps.source: A labeled circle marks a frontline checkpoint. The local checkpoint uses the configured local/success color.
ps.translation: * A LABELED CIRCLE MARKS A FRONTLINE CHECKPOINT. THE LOCAL CHECKPOINT USES THE CONFIGURED LOCAL/SUCCESS COLOR. >>>!

ps.source: A large circle labeled SHIP marks the current or departed ship. A dashed boundary can show the dismissal distance.
ps.translation: * A LARGE CIRCLE LABELED SHIP MARKS THE CURRENT OR DEPARTED SHIP. A DASHED BOUNDARY CAN SHOW THE DISMISSAL DISTANCE. >>>!

ps.source: A live Commander survey unlocks the same point form used by the reference preview and adds survey-specific controls below the map.
ps.translation: * A LIVE COMMANDER SURVEY UNLOCKS THE SAME POINT FORM USED BY THE REFERENCE PREVIEW AND ADDS SURVEY-SPECIFIC CONTROLS BELOW THE MAP. >>>!

ps.source: A live commander measurement at the selected active site is required.
ps.translation: * A LIVE COMMANDER MEASUREMENT AT THE SELECTED ACTIVE SITE IS REQUIRED. >>>!

ps.source: A live construction depot is required before a project can be created.
ps.translation: * A LIVE CONSTRUCTION DEPOT IS REQUIRED BEFORE A PROJECT CAN BE CREATED. >>>!

ps.source: A loaded route is required when reporting arrival status.
ps.translation: * A LOADED ROUTE IS REQUIRED WHEN REPORTING ARRIVAL STATUS. >>>!

ps.source: A muted dot is a prior scan location. A danger-colored radius means the Commander is currently too close to reuse that colony area.
ps.translation: * A MUTED DOT IS A PRIOR SCAN LOCATION. A DANGER-COLORED RADIUS MEANS THE COMMANDER IS CURRENTLY TOO CLOSE TO REUSE THAT COLONY AREA. >>>!

ps.source: A named atmospheric-control point in a human settlement.
ps.translation: * A NAMED ATMOSPHERIC-CONTROL POINT IN A HUMAN SETTLEMENT. >>>!

ps.source: A named power-control point in a human settlement.
ps.translation: * A NAMED POWER-CONTROL POINT IN A HUMAN SETTLEMENT. >>>!

ps.source: A new route could not be started: {0}
ps.translation: * A NEW ROUTE COULD NOT BE STARTED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: A no-carrier response is cached normally and does not trigger repeated refreshes.
ps.translation: * A NO-CARRIER RESPONSE IS CACHED NORMALLY AND DOES NOT TRIGGER REPEATED REFRESHES. >>>!

ps.source: A parent contains eight child cubes at the next lower mass code. This nested layout explains why systems with different prefixes can be close together and systems sharing a large high-mass boxel can be far apart.
ps.translation: * A PARENT CONTAINS EIGHT CHILD CUBES AT THE NEXT LOWER MASS CODE. THIS NESTED LAYOUT EXPLAINS WHY SYSTEMS WITH DIFFERENT PREFIXES CAN BE CLOSE TOGETHER AND SYSTEMS SHARING A LARGE HIGH-MASS BOXEL CAN BE FAR APART. >>>!

ps.source: A passive overlay is click-through. The live-interaction shortcut temporarily makes existing live overlays draggable without opening the full position editor.
ps.translation: * A PASSIVE OVERLAY IS CLICK-THROUGH. THE LIVE-INTERACTION SHORTCUT TEMPORARILY MAKES EXISTING LIVE OVERLAYS DRAGGABLE WITHOUT OPENING THE FULL POSITION EDITOR. >>>!

ps.source: A positive Codex entry ID is required.
ps.translation: * A POSITIVE CODEX ENTRY ID IS REQUIRED. >>>!

ps.source: A quest objective exists but the Commander is not yet within its required target area.
ps.translation: * A QUEST OBJECTIVE EXISTS BUT THE COMMANDER IS NOT YET WITHIN ITS REQUIRED TARGET AREA. >>>!

ps.source: A question mark inside the unknown-color frame means there is not enough dependable organism or reward data to calculate a band yet.
ps.translation: * A QUESTION MARK INSIDE THE UNKNOWN-COLOR FRAME MEANS THERE IS NOT ENOUGH DEPENDABLE ORGANISM OR REWARD DATA TO CALCULATE A BAND YET. >>>!

ps.source: A recovered session opens paused. Check the system and ring, then resume when ready.
ps.translation: * A RECOVERED SESSION OPENS PAUSED. CHECK THE SYSTEM AND RING, THEN RESUME WHEN READY. >>>!

ps.source: A reward range appears when unresolved signals could match organisms with different values.
ps.translation: * A REWARD RANGE APPEARS WHEN UNRESOLVED SIGNALS COULD MATCH ORGANISMS WITH DIFFERENT VALUES. >>>!

ps.source: A ring with a center dot marks the Commander's live position on the Guardian site projection.
ps.translation: * A RING WITH A CENTER DOT MARKS THE COMMANDER'S LIVE POSITION ON THE GUARDIAN SITE PROJECTION. >>>!

ps.source: A rotated rectangular outline and pad number show a settlement landing pad and its orientation.
ps.translation: * A ROTATED RECTANGULAR OUTLINE AND PAD NUMBER SHOW A SETTLEMENT LANDING PAD AND ITS ORIENTATION. >>>!

ps.source: A rounded rectangle marks the Surface Recon Vehicle.
ps.translation: * A ROUNDED RECTANGLE MARKS THE SURFACE RECON VEHICLE. >>>!

ps.source: A rounded square labeled SRV marks the vehicle on the settlement map.
ps.translation: * A ROUNDED SQUARE LABELED SRV MARKS THE VEHICLE ON THE SETTLEMENT MAP. >>>!

ps.source: A rounded square with a center line marks a data terminal. A dim/processed color means it has already been handled.
ps.translation: * A ROUNDED SQUARE WITH A CENTER LINE MARKS A DATA TERMINAL. A DIM/PROCESSED COLOR MEANS IT HAS ALREADY BEEN HANDLED. >>>!

ps.source: A saved overlay theme name must contain 1 to 80 characters.
ps.translation: * A SAVED OVERLAY THEME NAME MUST CONTAIN 1 TO 80 CHARACTERS. >>>!

ps.source: A saved standard route can include body destinations for each system. Route bodies shows their body icon, arrival distance, exploration and biology values, and completion state; arriving at the matching body marks that destination complete.
ps.translation: * A SAVED STANDARD ROUTE CAN INCLUDE BODY DESTINATIONS FOR EACH SYSTEM. ROUTE BODIES SHOWS THEIR BODY ICON, ARRIVAL DISTANCE, EXPLORATION AND BIOLOGY VALUES, AND COMPLETION STATE; ARRIVING AT THE MATCHING BODY MARKS THAT DESTINATION COMPLETE. >>>!

ps.source: A scanned body and live surface coordinates are required to toggle a quick tracker.
ps.translation: * A SCANNED BODY AND LIVE SURFACE COORDINATES ARE REQUIRED TO TOGGLE A QUICK TRACKER. >>>!

ps.source: A scanned body is required before trackers can be cleared.
ps.translation: * A SCANNED BODY IS REQUIRED BEFORE TRACKERS CAN BE CLEARED. >>>!

ps.source: A short filled bar marks a secure door. Green, cyan, gold, and danger colors correspond to increasing security levels.
ps.translation: * A SHORT FILLED BAR MARKS A SECURE DOOR. GREEN, CYAN, GOLD, AND DANGER COLORS CORRESPOND TO INCREASING SECURITY LEVELS. >>>!

ps.source: A small outlined dot marks material already collected at that settlement position.
ps.translation: * A SMALL OUTLINED DOT MARKS MATERIAL ALREADY COLLECTED AT THAT SETTLEMENT POSITION. >>>!

ps.source: A spherical search finds candidate systems inside a radius around a central coordinate.
ps.translation: * A SPHERICAL SEARCH FINDS CANDIDATE SYSTEMS INSIDE A RADIUS AROUND A CENTRAL COORDINATE. >>>!

ps.source: A standalone question mark means the signal, organism, site detail, or reward cannot yet be identified reliably from current data.
ps.translation: * A STANDALONE QUESTION MARK MEANS THE SIGNAL, ORGANISM, SITE DETAIL, OR REWARD CANNOT YET BE IDENTIFIED RELIABLY FROM CURRENT DATA. >>>!

ps.source: A started update handoff has no installation plan.
ps.translation: * A STARTED UPDATE HANDOFF HAS NO INSTALLATION PLAN. >>>!

ps.source: A successful import restarts SrvSurvey automatically so no pre-import in-memory state can overwrite migrated data.
ps.translation: * A SUCCESSFUL IMPORT RESTARTS SRVSURVEY AUTOMATICALLY SO NO PRE-IMPORT IN-MEMORY STATE CAN OVERWRITE MIGRATED DATA. >>>!

ps.source: A target-radius circle marks quest geometry. Gold means outside the target; the active accent means within it.
ps.translation: * A TARGET-RADIUS CIRCLE MARKS QUEST GEOMETRY. GOLD MEANS OUTSIDE THE TARGET; THE ACTIVE ACCENT MEANS WITHIN IT. >>>!

ps.source: A trailing question mark means the body criteria predict the colored species, but a DSS or organic scan has not confirmed it. Hover the marker in the overlay for its state description.
ps.translation: * A TRAILING QUESTION MARK MEANS THE BODY CRITERIA PREDICT THE COLORED SPECIES, BUT A DSS OR ORGANIC SCAN HAS NOT CONFIRMED IT. HOVER THE MARKER IN THE OVERLAY FOR ITS STATE DESCRIPTION. >>>!

ps.source: A translucent blue line through site center is the general relic-tower heading. A wider, fainter line through one relic records that tower's individual heading.
ps.translation: * A TRANSLUCENT BLUE LINE THROUGH SITE CENTER IS THE GENERAL RELIC-TOWER HEADING. A WIDER, FAINTER LINE THROUGH ONE RELIC RECORDS THAT TOWER'S INDIVIDUAL HEADING. >>>!

ps.source: A triangle marks the current ship. A dim triangle marks a former ship position.
ps.translation: * A TRIANGLE MARKS THE CURRENT SHIP. A DIM TRIANGLE MARKS A FORMER SHIP POSITION. >>>!

ps.source: A visual reference for route and body artwork, text symbols, biology reward PIPs, surface-radar markers, Guardian points, and human-settlement map icons.
ps.translation: * A VISUAL REFERENCE FOR ROUTE AND BODY ARTWORK, TEXT SYMBOLS, BIOLOGY REWARD PIPS, SURFACE-RADAR MARKERS, GUARDIAN POINTS, AND HUMAN-SETTLEMENT MAP ICONS. >>>!

ps.source: Aboard the Rhino, the Mining warning appears beyond 4 km from the farthest saved rig and clears when every rig is back within range.
ps.translation: * ABOARD THE RHINO, THE MINING WARNING APPEARS BEYOND 4 KM FROM THE FARTHEST SAVED RIG AND CLEARS WHEN EVERY RIG IS BACK WITHIN RANGE. >>>!

ps.source: Accepted a verified shutdown request from another SrvSurvey instance.
ps.translation: * ACCEPTED A VERIFIED SHUTDOWN REQUEST FROM ANOTHER SRVSURVEY INSTANCE. >>>!

ps.source: Acquire the required Raven system-update permission and API key.
ps.translation: * ACQUIRE THE REQUIRED RAVEN SYSTEM-UPDATE PERMISSION AND API KEY. >>>!

ps.source: Activate a boxel search before auditing its full area.
ps.translation: * ACTIVATE A BOXEL SEARCH BEFORE AUDITING ITS FULL AREA. >>>!

ps.source: Activate a boxel search to audit its full area.
ps.translation: * ACTIVATE A BOXEL SEARCH TO AUDIT ITS FULL AREA. >>>!

ps.source: Activate a saved route before changing next-hop auto-copy.
ps.translation: * ACTIVATE A SAVED ROUTE BEFORE CHANGING NEXT-HOP AUTO-COPY. >>>!

ps.source: Activated {0} verified reference update(s). Restart SrvSurvey to use them.
ps.translation: * ACTIVATED {0} VERIFIED REFERENCE UPDATE(S). RESTART SRVSURVEY TO USE THEM. >>>!

ps.source: Active quest geometry can add routes and target radii to a human-settlement map, while massacre missions track credited kills by mission giver.
ps.translation: * ACTIVE QUEST GEOMETRY CAN ADD ROUTES AND TARGET RADII TO A HUMAN-SETTLEMENT MAP, WHILE MASSACRE MISSIONS TRACK CREDITED KILLS BY MISSION GIVER. >>>!

ps.source: Active sample belongs to another body
ps.translation: * ACTIVE SAMPLE BELONGS TO ANOTHER BODY >>>!

ps.source: Active-obelisk names, log codes, and artifact codes cannot be blank where required or contain legacy delimiters (-, !, or commas inside a code).
ps.translation: * ACTIVE-OBELISK NAMES, LOG CODES, AND ARTIFACT CODES CANNOT BE BLANK WHERE REQUIRED OR CONTAIN LEGACY DELIMITERS (-, !, OR COMMAS INSIDE A CODE). >>>!

ps.source: Activities → Mining combines ship mining tools with the existing cargo and journal feed.
ps.translation: * ACTIVITIES → MINING COMBINES SHIP MINING TOOLS WITH THE EXISTING CARGO AND JOURNAL FEED. >>>!

ps.source: Activity-by-activity reference for the chat messages SrvSurvey currently recognizes, including examples, requirements, and clearing behavior.
ps.translation: * ACTIVITY-BY-ACTIVITY REFERENCE FOR THE CHAT MESSAGES SRVSURVEY CURRENTLY RECOGNIZES, INCLUDING EXAMPLES, REQUIREMENTS, AND CLEARING BEHAVIOR. >>>!

ps.source: Add anything useful about this system...
ps.translation: * ADD ANYTHING USEFUL ABOUT THIS SYSTEM... >>>!

ps.source: Add at least one configured group before saving.
ps.translation: * ADD AT LEAST ONE CONFIGURED GROUP BEFORE SAVING. >>>!

ps.source: Add or remove saved search favorite
ps.translation: * ADD OR REMOVE SAVED SEARCH FAVORITE >>>!

ps.source: Add planning notes, reminders, or a description for this route.
ps.translation: * ADD PLANNING NOTES, REMINDERS, OR A DESCRIPTION FOR THIS ROUTE. >>>!

ps.source: Add the steps or game activity that led to this error.
ps.translation: * ADD THE STEPS OR GAME ACTIVITY THAT LED TO THIS ERROR. >>>!

ps.source: Add, select, edit, scan or unscan, and delete active obelisks with their map-marker name, Ram Tah log code, and required artifact codes.
ps.translation: * ADD, SELECT, EDIT, SCAN OR UNSCAN, AND DELETE ACTIVE OBELISKS WITH THEIR MAP-MARKER NAME, RAM TAH LOG CODE, AND REQUIRED ARTIFACT CODES. >>>!

ps.source: Added a data terminal to the local draft.
ps.translation: * ADDED A DATA TERMINAL TO THE LOCAL DRAFT. >>>!

ps.source: Added a local raw {0} point to the Guardian survey.
ps.translation: * ADDED A LOCAL RAW {0} POINT TO THE GUARDIAN SURVEY. >>>!

ps.source: Added a secure door with the current relative heading.
ps.translation: * ADDED A SECURE DOOR WITH THE CURRENT RELATIVE HEADING. >>>!

ps.source: Added a {0} m circle to the pending building.
ps.translation: * ADDED A {0} M CIRCLE TO THE PENDING BUILDING. >>>!

ps.source: Added an active-obelisk draft. Enter its map name, log code, and artifact codes, then save.
ps.translation: * ADDED AN ACTIVE-OBELISK DRAFT. ENTER ITS MAP NAME, LOG CODE, AND ARTIFACT CODES, THEN SAVE. >>>!

ps.source: Added building '{0}' to the local draft.
ps.translation: * ADDED BUILDING '{0}' TO THE LOCAL DRAFT. >>>!

ps.source: Added path {0} to the pending building.
ps.translation: * ADDED PATH {0} TO THE PENDING BUILDING. >>>!

ps.source: Added {0} as a local raw {1} point. Save the survey to persist it.
ps.translation: * ADDED {0} AS A LOCAL RAW {1} POINT. SAVE THE SURVEY TO PERSIST IT. >>>!

ps.source: Adding embedded banner to future screenshots
ps.translation: * ADDING EMBEDDED BANNER TO FUTURE SCREENSHOTS >>>!

ps.source: Adds a listed Hotspot List commodity at a bearing and distance from your live position anywhere inside the saved map border, followed by that deposit's mineral amount and density. A same-commodity marker within 100 m is declined as a likely duplicate. Example: .mine 15 ruby 1.24 high/medium
ps.translation: * ADDS A LISTED HOTSPOT LIST COMMODITY AT A BEARING AND DISTANCE FROM YOUR LIVE POSITION ANYWHERE INSIDE THE SAVED MAP BORDER, FOLLOWED BY THAT DEPOSIT'S MINERAL AMOUNT AND DENSITY. A SAME-COMMODITY MARKER WITHIN 100 M IS DECLINED AS A LIKELY DUPLICATE. EXAMPLE: .MINE 15 RUBY 1.24 HIGH/MEDIUM >>>!

ps.source: Adds a listed commodity and its mineral amount and density at your current surface coordinates. This precise placement may overlap an existing marker. Example: .mine monazite medium/high here
ps.translation: * ADDS A LISTED COMMODITY AND ITS MINERAL AMOUNT AND DENSITY AT YOUR CURRENT SURFACE COORDINATES. THIS PRECISE PLACEMENT MAY OVERLAP AN EXISTING MARKER. EXAMPLE: .MINE MONAZITE MEDIUM/HIGH HERE >>>!

ps.source: Adjust Header, Title, Value, Body, Detail, and Caption font sizes in half-point increments. These shared roles keep related overlays consistent instead of resizing individual labels independently.
ps.translation: * ADJUST HEADER, TITLE, VALUE, BODY, DETAIL, AND CAPTION FONT SIZES IN HALF-POINT INCREMENTS. THESE SHARED ROLES KEEP RELATED OVERLAYS CONSISTENT INSTEAD OF RESIZING INDIVIDUAL LABELS INDEPENDENTLY. >>>!

ps.source: Adjust the existing shared map. Its background, alignment, master points, and group labels are copied into this draft.
ps.translation: * ADJUST THE EXISTING SHARED MAP. ITS BACKGROUND, ALIGNMENT, MASTER POINTS, AND GROUP LABELS ARE COPIED INTO THIS DRAFT. >>>!

ps.source: Adjustment mode is active. Save creates a verified plotters.json backup.
ps.translation: * ADJUSTMENT MODE IS ACTIVE. SAVE CREATES A VERIFIED PLOTTERS.JSON BACKUP. >>>!

ps.source: Aerial copies need to be within 50 m of site origin, altitude 500–2000 m (e.g. 'Aerial alpha'). Alt+Ctrl+I toggles data banners for future screenshots.
ps.translation: * AERIAL COPIES NEED TO BE WITHIN 50 M OF SITE ORIGIN, ALTITUDE 500–2000 M (E.G. 'AERIAL ALPHA'). ALT+CTRL+I TOGGLES DATA BANNERS FOR FUTURE SCREENSHOTS. >>>!

ps.source: After creation, SrvSurvey reads the sites again. If the new project displaced the original first site, it sends an order-only correction with the original site first.
ps.translation: * AFTER CREATION, SRVSURVEY READS THE SITES AGAIN. IF THE NEW PROJECT DISPLACED THE ORIGINAL FIRST SITE, IT SENDS AN ORDER-ONLY CORRECTION WITH THE ORIGINAL SITE FIRST. >>>!

ps.source: Align with the survey origin and rise to {0} m.
ps.translation: * ALIGN WITH THE SURVEY ORIGIN AND RISE TO {0} M. >>>!

ps.source: Alignment helper shown at the center of the Elite window.
ps.translation: * ALIGNMENT HELPER SHOWN AT THE CENTER OF THE ELITE WINDOW. >>>!

ps.source: All dates and times use UTC.
ps.translation: * ALL DATES AND TIMES USE UTC. >>>!

ps.source: All entries start checked. Other / unknown controls unrecognized ship types, unavailable boarded status and taxi/multicrew rides where the current vessel is not identified.
ps.translation: * ALL ENTRIES START CHECKED. OTHER / UNKNOWN CONTROLS UNRECOGNIZED SHIP TYPES, UNAVAILABLE BOARDED STATUS AND TAXI/MULTICREW RIDES WHERE THE CURRENT VESSEL IS NOT IDENTIFIED. >>>!

ps.source: All publication remains off unless you explicitly enable it. Imported profiles retain the original choices.
ps.translation: * ALL PUBLICATION REMAINS OFF UNLESS YOU EXPLICITLY ENABLE IT. IMPORTED PROFILES RETAIN THE ORIGINAL CHOICES. >>>!

ps.source: All signals analyzed with the first-footfall bonus applied.
ps.translation: * ALL SIGNALS ANALYZED WITH THE FIRST-FOOTFALL BONUS APPLIED. >>>!

ps.source: All surface trackers for the current body were cleared.
ps.translation: * ALL SURFACE TRACKERS FOR THE CURRENT BODY WERE CLEARED. >>>!

ps.source: Allow this category's overlays for the ship or vehicle you are currently aboard. Checked entries permit the normal overlay rules; unchecked entries hide them. On foot is separate from your parked ship. Editor previews are unaffected.
ps.translation: * ALLOW THIS CATEGORY'S OVERLAYS FOR THE SHIP OR VEHICLE YOU ARE CURRENTLY ABOARD. CHECKED ENTRIES PERMIT THE NORMAL OVERLAY RULES; UNCHECKED ENTRIES HIDE THEM. ON FOOT IS SEPARATE FROM YOUR PARKED SHIP. EDITOR PREVIEWS ARE UNAFFECTED. >>>!

ps.source: Also displays the overlay in supercruise when the navigation destination matches the next followed-route system.
ps.translation: * ALSO DISPLAYS THE OVERLAY IN SUPERCRUISE WHEN THE NAVIGATION DESTINATION MATCHES THE NEXT FOLLOWED-ROUTE SYSTEM. >>>!

ps.source: Alt+B toggles details for the current or selected body. With the bubble rule enabled, the panel stays hidden within the configured Sol radius (upstream default <200 ly).
ps.translation: * ALT+B TOGGLES DETAILS FOR THE CURRENT OR SELECTED BODY. WITH THE BUBBLE RULE ENABLED, THE PANEL STAYS HIDDEN WITHIN THE CONFIGURED SOL RADIUS (UPSTREAM DEFAULT <200 LY). >>>!

ps.source: Alt+Ctrl+O toggles this capture window. Its enabled state is restored at startup.
ps.translation: * ALT+CTRL+O TOGGLES THIS CAPTURE WINDOW. ITS ENABLED STATE IS RESTORED AT STARTUP. >>>!

ps.source: Ambiguous or missing matches are not changed and remain retryable.
ps.translation: * AMBIGUOUS OR MISSING MATCHES ARE NOT CHANGED AND REMAIN RETRYABLE. >>>!

ps.source: Ambiguous shared Cargo.json data is suppressed while multiple Elite windows are detected. A fresh unambiguous cargo write is required before cargo can re-enter plans or publishing.
ps.translation: * AMBIGUOUS SHARED CARGO.JSON DATA IS SUPPRESSED WHILE MULTIPLE ELITE WINDOWS ARE DETECTED. A FRESH UNAMBIGUOUS CARGO WRITE IS REQUIRED BEFORE CARGO CAN RE-ENTER PLANS OR PUBLISHING. >>>!

ps.source: An Inara API key is saved for {0}.
ps.translation: * AN INARA API KEY IS SAVED FOR {0}. >>>!

ps.source: An active commander Guardian survey is required for that command.
ps.translation: * AN ACTIVE COMMANDER GUARDIAN SURVEY IS REQUIRED FOR THAT COMMAND. >>>!

ps.source: An active commander profile is required.
ps.translation: * AN ACTIVE COMMANDER PROFILE IS REQUIRED. >>>!

ps.source: An active obelisk receives an emphasized ring; a scanned obelisk is filled with the success color.
ps.translation: * AN ACTIVE OBELISK RECEIVES AN EMPHASIZED RING; A SCANNED OBELISK IS FILLED WITH THE SUCCESS COLOR. >>>!

ps.source: An alarm-control point in a human settlement. Its color reflects access/security context.
ps.translation: * AN ALARM-CONTROL POINT IN A HUMAN SETTLEMENT. ITS COLOR REFLECTS ACCESS/SECURITY CONTEXT. >>>!

ps.source: An aligned settlement and current surface position are required for this measurement.
ps.translation: * AN ALIGNED SETTLEMENT AND CURRENT SURFACE POSITION ARE REQUIRED FOR THIS MEASUREMENT. >>>!

ps.source: An application-owned window requires a monitor session.
ps.translation: * AN APPLICATION-OWNED WINDOW REQUIRES A MONITOR SESSION. >>>!

ps.source: An authorization or security-clearance point in a human settlement.
ps.translation: * AN AUTHORIZATION OR SECURITY-CLEARANCE POINT IN A HUMAN SETTLEMENT. >>>!

ps.source: An open chevron points toward a near or standard target. A double chevron marks a target beyond its defined far threshold; markers without one use 1 km.
ps.translation: * AN OPEN CHEVRON POINTS TOWARD A NEAR OR STANDARD TARGET. A DOUBLE CHEVRON MARKS A TARGET BEYOND ITS DEFINED FAR THRESHOLD; MARKERS WITHOUT ONE USE 1 KM. >>>!

ps.source: An orange star containing a fuel droplet marks a route waypoint where the ship should refuel by fuel scooping.
ps.translation: * AN ORANGE STAR CONTAINING A FUEL DROPLET MARKS A ROUTE WAYPOINT WHERE THE SHIP SHOULD REFUEL BY FUEL SCOOPING. >>>!

ps.source: An overlay colour name cannot be empty.
ps.translation: * AN OVERLAY COLOUR NAME CANNOT BE EMPTY. >>>!

ps.source: An overlay theme state is not a JSON object.
ps.translation: * AN OVERLAY THEME STATE IS NOT A JSON OBJECT. >>>!

ps.source: An overlay timer requires a positive interval.
ps.translation: * AN OVERLAY TIMER REQUIRES A POSITIVE INTERVAL. >>>!

ps.source: An unhatched PIP means the organism and its reward are confirmed. Each filled segment clears one reward threshold; black empty slots show thresholds the reward does not reach. The dotted outer frame and solid segment outlines are independently themeable.
ps.translation: * AN UNHATCHED PIP MEANS THE ORGANISM AND ITS REWARD ARE CONFIRMED. EACH FILLED SEGMENT CLEARS ONE REWARD THRESHOLD; BLACK EMPTY SLOTS SHOW THRESHOLDS THE REWARD DOES NOT REACH. THE DOTTED OUTER FRAME AND SOLID SEGMENT OUTLINES ARE INDEPENDENTLY THEMEABLE. >>>!

ps.source: Analysis, previews, imports, and historical reconstruction do not imply network publication.
ps.translation: * ANALYSIS, PREVIEWS, IMPORTS, AND HISTORICAL RECONSTRUCTION DO NOT IMPLY NETWORK PUBLICATION. >>>!

ps.source: Analyze journals to find historical Green Gas Giant candidates. Analysis never publishes them.
ps.translation: * ANALYZE JOURNALS TO FIND HISTORICAL GREEN GAS GIANT CANDIDATES. ANALYSIS NEVER PUBLISHES THEM. >>>!

ps.source: Analyze journals, review the candidate count, and confirm historical publication first.
ps.translation: * ANALYZE JOURNALS, REVIEW THE CANDIDATE COUNT, AND CONFIRM HISTORICAL PUBLICATION FIRST. >>>!

ps.source: Another SrvSurvey instance is running. Confirm whether all instances should close before updating.
ps.translation: * ANOTHER SRVSURVEY INSTANCE IS RUNNING. CONFIRM WHETHER ALL INSTANCES SHOULD CLOSE BEFORE UPDATING. >>>!

ps.source: Another update operation is already active.
ps.translation: * ANOTHER UPDATE OPERATION IS ALREADY ACTIVE. >>>!

ps.source: Appears below 100 m while on foot or in an SRV at a settlement whose faction is at war or civil war.
ps.translation: * APPEARS BELOW 100 M WHILE ON FOOT OR IN AN SRV AT A SETTLEMENT WHOSE FACTION IS AT WAR OR CIVIL WAR. >>>!

ps.source: Appears in supercruise, the navigation panel, or the system map and marks the selected destination.
ps.translation: * APPEARS IN SUPERCRUISE, THE NAVIGATION PANEL, OR THE SYSTEM MAP AND MARKS THE SELECTED DESTINATION. >>>!

ps.source: Application theme changes the main Avalonia windows. Choose Blue light/dark, Orange dark, Green light/dark, or the low-glare Monochrome dark palette.
ps.translation: * APPLICATION THEME CHANGES THE MAIN AVALONIA WINDOWS. CHOOSE BLUE LIGHT/DARK, ORANGE DARK, GREEN LIGHT/DARK, OR THE LOW-GLARE MONOCHROME DARK PALETTE. >>>!

ps.source: Application update checks verify checksum-indexed packages, prevent overlapping installations, and confirm before handing off when other SrvSurvey instances are running.
ps.translation: * APPLICATION UPDATE CHECKS VERIFY CHECKSUM-INDEXED PACKAGES, PREVENT OVERLAPPING INSTALLATIONS, AND CONFIRM BEFORE HANDING OFF WHEN OTHER SRVSURVEY INSTANCES ARE RUNNING. >>>!

ps.source: Application window scale changes the complete shell and is reduced only when the selected size would not fit the active monitor.
ps.translation: * APPLICATION WINDOW SCALE CHANGES THE COMPLETE SHELL AND IS REDUCED ONLY WHEN THE SELECTED SIZE WOULD NOT FIT THE ACTIVE MONITOR. >>>!

ps.source: Applied overlay colours and typography to theme.json and all open overlays.{0}
ps.translation: * APPLIED OVERLAY COLOURS AND TYPOGRAPHY TO THEME.JSON AND ALL OPEN OVERLAYS.{0} >>>!

ps.source: Apply the original focus and Odyssey suit rules consistently to every passive overlay.
ps.translation: * APPLY THE ORIGINAL FOCUS AND ODYSSEY SUIT RULES CONSISTENTLY TO EVERY PASSIVE OVERLAY. >>>!

ps.source: Approach a Guardian point before marking it empty.
ps.translation: * APPROACH A GUARDIAN POINT BEFORE MARKING IT EMPTY. >>>!

ps.source: Approach a Guardian ruins or structure settlement to activate its survey.
ps.translation: * APPROACH A GUARDIAN RUINS OR STRUCTURE SETTLEMENT TO ACTIVATE ITS SURVEY. >>>!

ps.source: Approach a Guardian site to begin proximity tracking.
ps.translation: * APPROACH A GUARDIAN SITE TO BEGIN PROXIMITY TRACKING. >>>!

ps.source: Approach a local raw Guardian point before removing it.
ps.translation: * APPROACH A LOCAL RAW GUARDIAN POINT BEFORE REMOVING IT. >>>!

ps.source: Approach a relic tower before setting its heading.
ps.translation: * APPROACH A RELIC TOWER BEFORE SETTING ITS HEADING. >>>!

ps.source: Approach a relic tower to begin its heading survey.
ps.translation: * APPROACH A RELIC TOWER TO BEGIN ITS HEADING SURVEY. >>>!

ps.source: Approach a relic tower to record its heading.
ps.translation: * APPROACH A RELIC TOWER TO RECORD ITS HEADING. >>>!

ps.source: Approach an active Guardian obelisk before changing its scan state.
ps.translation: * APPROACH AN ACTIVE GUARDIAN OBELISK BEFORE CHANGING ITS SCAN STATE. >>>!

ps.source: Approach an aligned settlement to author its template.
ps.translation: * APPROACH AN ALIGNED SETTLEMENT TO AUTHOR ITS TEMPLATE. >>>!

ps.source: Approach the nearest relic tower on foot.
ps.translation: * APPROACH THE NEAREST RELIC TOWER ON FOOT. >>>!

ps.source: Are you sure you want to proceed? Doing so will close all instances.
ps.translation: * ARE YOU SURE YOU WANT TO PROCEED? DOING SO WILL CLOSE ALL INSTANCES. >>>!

ps.source: Are you sure? Unsaved changes in the workspace will be lost. Saved route files will not be deleted.
ps.translation: * ARE YOU SURE? UNSAVED CHANGES IN THE WORKSPACE WILL BE LOST. SAVED ROUTE FILES WILL NOT BE DELETED. >>>!

ps.source: Arrival distance LS cannot be negative.
ps.translation: * ARRIVAL DISTANCE LS CANNOT BE NEGATIVE. >>>!

ps.source: Artifact requirements are unavailable for an inactive obelisk.
ps.translation: * ARTIFACT REQUIREMENTS ARE UNAVAILABLE FOR AN INACTIVE OBELISK. >>>!

ps.source: At a deposit, send .mine <commodity> <low|medium|high>/<low|medium|high> here. Precise here placement may overlap an existing marker. Example: .mine ruby medium/low here. Remove the nearest mapped deposit within 0.5 km with .mine delete here.
ps.translation: * AT A DEPOSIT, SEND .MINE <COMMODITY> <LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH>/<LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH> HERE. PRECISE HERE PLACEMENT MAY OVERLAP AN EXISTING MARKER. EXAMPLE: .MINE RUBY MEDIUM/LOW HERE. REMOVE THE NEAREST MAPPED DEPOSIT WITHIN 0.5 KM WITH .MINE DELETE HERE. >>>!

ps.source: At a resource location, send +helium or +thortveitite in game chat to save your current position under that name. These are manual bookmarks; the overlay does not automatically detect mineral deposits.
ps.translation: * AT A RESOURCE LOCATION, SEND +HELIUM OR +THORTVEITITE IN GAME CHAT TO SAVE YOUR CURRENT POSITION UNDER THAT NAME. THESE ARE MANUAL BOOKMARKS; THE OVERLAY DOES NOT AUTOMATICALLY DETECT MINERAL DEPOSITS. >>>!

ps.source: At an active ruins or structure, lists incomplete logs, matching obelisks, and available artifact counts.
ps.translation: * AT AN ACTIVE RUINS OR STRUCTURE, LISTS INCOMPLETE LOGS, MATCHING OBELISKS, AND AVAILABLE ARTIFACT COUNTS. >>>!

ps.source: At least one guide category is required.
ps.translation: * AT LEAST ONE GUIDE CATEGORY IS REQUIRED. >>>!

ps.source: At least one overlay placement or a global opacity change is required.
ps.translation: * AT LEAST ONE OVERLAY PLACEMENT OR A GLOBAL OPACITY CHANGE IS REQUIRED. >>>!

ps.source: At startup, SrvSurvey checks the published version index and downloads only catalogs whose version changed.
ps.translation: * AT STARTUP, SRVSURVEY CHECKS THE PUBLISHED VERSION INDEX AND DOWNLOADS ONLY CATALOGS WHOSE VERSION CHANGED. >>>!

ps.source: At the active in-game site, the Commander position is mirrored onto the Survey map. It is a passive marker and cannot block selection of an overlapping survey point.
ps.translation: * AT THE ACTIVE IN-GAME SITE, THE COMMANDER POSITION IS MIRRORED ONTO THE SURVEY MAP. IT IS A PASSIVE MARKER AND CANNOT BLOCK SELECTION OF AN OVERLAPPING SURVEY POINT. >>>!

ps.source: Audit cancelled after {0} of {1} boxels; partial progress was saved.
ps.translation: * AUDIT CANCELLED AFTER {0} OF {1} BOXELS; PARTIAL PROGRESS WAS SAVED. >>>!

ps.source: Audited all {0} boxels and saved the refreshed progress.
ps.translation: * AUDITED ALL {0} BOXELS AND SAVED THE REFRESHED PROGRESS. >>>!

ps.source: Author the scanned obelisk, log, and required artifact metadata used when publishing an unpublished site survey.
ps.translation: * AUTHOR THE SCANNED OBELISK, LOG, AND REQUIRED ARTIFACT METADATA USED WHEN PUBLISHING AN UNPUBLISHED SITE SURVEY. >>>!

ps.source: Auto add tracker location when Composition scanning organisms.
ps.translation: * AUTO ADD TRACKER LOCATION WHEN COMPOSITION SCANNING ORGANISMS. >>>!

ps.source: Auto remove tracker location when sampling an organism within 250 m.
ps.translation: * AUTO REMOVE TRACKER LOCATION WHEN SAMPLING AN ORGANISM WITHIN 250 M. >>>!

ps.source: Auto remove tracker locations upon final scan
ps.translation: * AUTO REMOVE TRACKER LOCATIONS UPON FINAL SCAN >>>!

ps.source: Auto zoom map if within 30 m of obelisks
ps.translation: * AUTO ZOOM MAP IF WITHIN 30 M OF OBELISKS >>>!

ps.source: Auto-copy is mutually exclusive with Route Manager and FC Routes so only one Galaxy Map destination source can control the clipboard.
ps.translation: * AUTO-COPY IS MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE WITH ROUTE MANAGER AND FC ROUTES SO ONLY ONE GALAXY MAP DESTINATION SOURCE CAN CONTROL THE CLIPBOARD. >>>!

ps.source: Auto-copy next system in Galaxy Map
ps.translation: * AUTO-COPY NEXT SYSTEM IN GALAXY MAP >>>!

ps.source: Automatic Fleet Carrier cargo sync is off.
ps.translation: * AUTOMATIC FLEET CARRIER CARGO SYNC IS OFF. >>>!

ps.source: Automatic detection is available on Windows. Use Choose folder for copied profiles, older installs, or migration on Linux.
ps.translation: * AUTOMATIC DETECTION IS AVAILABLE ON WINDOWS. USE CHOOSE FOLDER FOR COPIED PROFILES, OLDER INSTALLS, OR MIGRATION ON LINUX. >>>!

ps.source: Automatic replacement is disabled because this copy was not launched from a checksum-indexed release package. Open the releases page to install manually.
ps.translation: * AUTOMATIC REPLACEMENT IS DISABLED BECAUSE THIS COPY WAS NOT LAUNCHED FROM A CHECKSUM-INDEXED RELEASE PACKAGE. OPEN THE RELEASES PAGE TO INSTALL MANUALLY. >>>!

ps.source: Automatic restart failed: {0} Close and reopen SrvSurvey manually; the verified import is safe.
ps.translation: * AUTOMATIC RESTART FAILED: {0} CLOSE AND REOPEN SRVSURVEY MANUALLY; THE VERIFIED IMPORT IS SAFE. >>>!

ps.source: Automatic rollback was incomplete; use the before-restore files to recover the previous data.
ps.translation: * AUTOMATIC ROLLBACK WAS INCOMPLETE; USE THE BEFORE-RESTORE FILES TO RECOVER THE PREVIOUS DATA. >>>!

ps.source: Automatic ship cargo publishing is off.
ps.translation: * AUTOMATIC SHIP CARGO PUBLISHING IS OFF. >>>!

ps.source: Automatic ship cargo publishing, Fleet Carrier publishing, system updates, and Green Gas Giant publication each have their own gates.
ps.translation: * AUTOMATIC SHIP CARGO PUBLISHING, FLEET CARRIER PUBLISHING, SYSTEM UPDATES, AND GREEN GAS GIANT PUBLICATION EACH HAVE THEIR OWN GATES. >>>!

ps.source: Automatic updates are supported only on Windows and Linux.
ps.translation: * AUTOMATIC UPDATES ARE SUPPORTED ONLY ON WINDOWS AND LINUX. >>>!

ps.source: Automatically clear saved rigs when you board your own ship or dock the Rhino. Send --- in game chat to clear all bookmarks and rigs on the current body at any time.
ps.translation: * AUTOMATICALLY CLEAR SAVED RIGS WHEN YOU BOARD YOUR OWN SHIP OR DOCK THE RHINO. SEND --- IN GAME CHAT TO CLEAR ALL BOOKMARKS AND RIGS ON THE CURRENT BODY AT ANY TIME. >>>!

ps.source: Automatically track rigs from the Rhino HUD
ps.translation: * AUTOMATICALLY TRACK RIGS FROM THE RHINO HUD >>>!

ps.source: Back up and replace Elite's VisitedStarsCache.dat with the 3,500 closest known systems from EDGalaxy.
ps.translation: * BACK UP AND REPLACE ELITE'S VISITEDSTARSCACHE.DAT WITH THE 3,500 CLOSEST KNOWN SYSTEMS FROM EDGALAXY. >>>!

ps.source: Back up commander mining history, missions, settings, local discoveries, shared bookmarks and attached screenshots in one ZIP. Restore replaces mining data and shared bookmarks with the backup contents, retaining the previous files for recovery.
ps.translation: * BACK UP COMMANDER MINING HISTORY, MISSIONS, SETTINGS, LOCAL DISCOVERIES, SHARED BOOKMARKS AND ATTACHED SCREENSHOTS IN ONE ZIP. RESTORE REPLACES MINING DATA AND SHARED BOOKMARKS WITH THE BACKUP CONTENTS, RETAINING THE PREVIOUS FILES FOR RECOVERY. >>>!

ps.source: Background and alignment changes preview immediately on the map. They remain part of this draft until the complete map catalog is saved.
ps.translation: * BACKGROUND AND ALIGNMENT CHANGES PREVIEW IMMEDIATELY ON THE MAP. THEY REMAIN PART OF THIS DRAFT UNTIL THE COMPLETE MAP CATALOG IS SAVED. >>>!

ps.source: Before creation, SrvSurvey reads the Raven system sites and records the persisted ID of the first site.
ps.translation: * BEFORE CREATION, SRVSURVEY READS THE RAVEN SYSTEM SITES AND RECORDS THE PERSISTED ID OF THE FIRST SITE. >>>!

ps.source: Bio signals and biology system overlays
ps.translation: * BIO SIGNALS AND BIOLOGY SYSTEM OVERLAYS >>>!

ps.source: Biological signal cannot be identified from current data.
ps.translation: * BIOLOGICAL SIGNAL CANNOT BE IDENTIFIED FROM CURRENT DATA. >>>!

ps.source: Biological targets not listed by route
ps.translation: * BIOLOGICAL TARGETS NOT LISTED BY ROUTE >>>!

ps.source: Biology, Guardian, body and system rows
ps.translation: * BIOLOGY, GUARDIAN, BODY AND SYSTEM ROWS >>>!

ps.source: Biology, culture, history, language, and technology records
ps.translation: * BIOLOGY, CULTURE, HISTORY, LANGUAGE, AND TECHNOLOGY RECORDS >>>!

ps.source: Blank shared-map draft started. Choose a background image before saving.
ps.translation: * BLANK SHARED-MAP DRAFT STARTED. CHOOSE A BACKGROUND IMAGE BEFORE SAVING. >>>!

ps.source: Body availability follows the Surface Hunt location reference. Sell prices retain the community snapshot and can change.
ps.translation: * BODY AVAILABILITY FOLLOWS THE SURFACE HUNT LOCATION REFERENCE. SELL PRICES RETAIN THE COMMUNITY SNAPSHOT AND CAN CHANGE. >>>!

ps.source: Body count for that type ÷ systems recorded
ps.translation: * BODY COUNT FOR THAT TYPE ÷ SYSTEMS RECORDED >>>!

ps.source: Body destination progress could not be saved: {0}
ps.translation: * BODY DESTINATION PROGRESS COULD NOT BE SAVED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Body import cancelled; Raven Colonial was not changed.
ps.translation: * BODY IMPORT CANCELLED; RAVEN COLONIAL WAS NOT CHANGED. >>>!

ps.source: Body information combines the scan, orbit, atmosphere, gravity, temperature, volcanism, materials, and reward details known so far.
ps.translation: * BODY INFORMATION COMBINES THE SCAN, ORBIT, ATMOSPHERE, GRAVITY, TEMPERATURE, VOLCANISM, MATERIALS, AND REWARD DETAILS KNOWN SO FAR. >>>!

ps.source: Body is required for the selected site's catalog details.
ps.translation: * BODY IS REQUIRED FOR THE SELECTED SITE'S CATALOG DETAILS. >>>!

ps.source: Body number must be -1 for unknown or a non-negative integer.
ps.translation: * BODY NUMBER MUST BE -1 FOR UNKNOWN OR A NON-NEGATIVE INTEGER. >>>!

ps.source: Borderless or windowed Elite modes provide the most predictable desktop overlay stacking. Exclusive fullscreen behavior depends on the operating system and compositor.
ps.translation: * BORDERLESS OR WINDOWED ELITE MODES PROVIDE THE MOST PREDICTABLE DESKTOP OVERLAY STACKING. EXCLUSIVE FULLSCREEN BEHAVIOR DEPENDS ON THE OPERATING SYSTEM AND COMPOSITOR. >>>!

ps.source: Bounds must have a positive size.
ps.translation: * BOUNDS MUST HAVE A POSITIVE SIZE. >>>!

ps.source: Boxel Stats summarizes the Commander data SrvSurvey has actually recorded; it does not estimate unvisited systems from a configured search size.
ps.translation: * BOXEL STATS SUMMARIZES THE COMMANDER DATA SRVSURVEY HAS ACTUALLY RECORDED; IT DOES NOT ESTIMATE UNVISITED SYSTEMS FROM A CONFIGURED SEARCH SIZE. >>>!

ps.source: Boxel auto-copy was disabled because another Galaxy Map auto-copy setting was selected.
ps.translation: * BOXEL AUTO-COPY WAS DISABLED BECAUSE ANOTHER GALAXY MAP AUTO-COPY SETTING WAS SELECTED. >>>!

ps.source: Boxel search disabled; its progress was retained.
ps.translation: * BOXEL SEARCH DISABLED; ITS PROGRESS WAS RETAINED. >>>!

ps.source: Bring settings, commander state, surveys, routes, journeys, caches, and every other legacy profile file into the cross-platform application.
