ps.source: Depot contribution, completion, docking, beacon architect, and market events update the matching project only when the identity is unambiguous.
ps.translation: * DEPOT CONTRIBUTION, COMPLETION, DOCKING, BEACON ARCHITECT, AND MARKET EVENTS UPDATE THE MATCHING PROJECT ONLY WHEN THE IDENTITY IS UNAMBIGUOUS. >>>!

ps.source: Desktop behavior changed for this session but could not be saved: {0}
ps.translation: * DESKTOP BEHAVIOR CHANGED FOR THIS SESSION BUT COULD NOT BE SAVED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Desktop behavior controls where the main application returns, how large it appears, and whether focus is handed back to Elite Dangerous.
ps.translation: * DESKTOP BEHAVIOR CONTROLS WHERE THE MAIN APPLICATION RETURNS, HOW LARGE IT APPEARS, AND WHETHER FOCUS IS HANDED BACK TO ELITE DANGEROUS. >>>!

ps.source: Detached overlays are unavailable on this platform.
ps.translation: * DETACHED OVERLAYS ARE UNAVAILABLE ON THIS PLATFORM. >>>!

ps.source: Detect FSS tuning completion from the game display
ps.translation: * DETECT FSS TUNING COMPLETION FROM THE GAME DISPLAY >>>!

ps.source: Detection groups bright segments matching the selected bar color, allowing for shading and small hue differences. Gray, white, black and dark pixels do not count as a deployment bar. Gaps separate rig groups; calibrated positions and the established anchor determine their numbers. Unreadable or ambiguous groups remain uncertain instead of being renumbered. Low brightness, changed HUD geometry, head look, or obscuring windows can prevent recognition.
ps.translation: * DETECTION GROUPS BRIGHT SEGMENTS MATCHING THE SELECTED BAR COLOR, ALLOWING FOR SHADING AND SMALL HUE DIFFERENCES. GRAY, WHITE, BLACK AND DARK PIXELS DO NOT COUNT AS A DEPLOYMENT BAR. GAPS SEPARATE RIG GROUPS; CALIBRATED POSITIONS AND THE ESTABLISHED ANCHOR DETERMINE THEIR NUMBERS. UNREADABLE OR AMBIGUOUS GROUPS REMAIN UNCERTAIN INSTEAD OF BEING RENUMBERED. LOW BRIGHTNESS, CHANGED HUD GEOMETRY, HEAD LOOK, OR OBSCURING WINDOWS CAN PREVENT RECOGNITION. >>>!

ps.source: Detection settings could not be saved: {0}
ps.translation: * DETECTION SETTINGS COULD NOT BE SAVED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Developer file formats are summarized as player tasks here; Diagnostics and repository documentation retain the lower-level evidence.
ps.translation: * DEVELOPER FILE FORMATS ARE SUMMARIZED AS PLAYER TASKS HERE; DIAGNOSTICS AND REPOSITORY DOCUMENTATION RETAIN THE LOWER-LEVEL EVIDENCE. >>>!

ps.source: Developer tools for capturing live Odyssey settlement geometry.
ps.translation: * DEVELOPER TOOLS FOR CAPTURING LIVE ODYSSEY SETTLEMENT GEOMETRY. >>>!

ps.source: Development releases are read from Fenris159/SrvSurvey, including RC builds.
ps.translation: * DEVELOPMENT RELEASES ARE READ FROM FENRIS159/SRVSURVEY, INCLUDING RC BUILDS. >>>!

ps.source: Development state could not be loaded: {0}
ps.translation: * DEVELOPMENT STATE COULD NOT BE LOADED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Diagnostic replay is waiting for commander identity from the imported journal.
ps.translation: * DIAGNOSTIC REPLAY IS WAITING FOR COMMANDER IDENTITY FROM THE IMPORTED JOURNAL. >>>!

ps.source: Diagnostic replay mode: external effects disabled; commander will be established by {0} ({1}).
ps.translation: * DIAGNOSTIC REPLAY MODE: EXTERNAL EFFECTS DISABLED; COMMANDER WILL BE ESTABLISHED BY {0} ({1}). >>>!

ps.source: Diagnostics can analyze older journals by Commander and date without changing profile data.
ps.translation: * DIAGNOSTICS CAN ANALYZE OLDER JOURNALS BY COMMANDER AND DATE WITHOUT CHANGING PROFILE DATA. >>>!

ps.source: Diagnostics can refresh the catalogs manually and reports when a restart is required.
ps.translation: * DIAGNOSTICS CAN REFRESH THE CATALOGS MANUALLY AND REPORTS WHEN A RESTART IS REQUIRED. >>>!

ps.source: Diagnostics exposes persisted application logs and the non-destructive crash-report workflow.
ps.translation: * DIAGNOSTICS EXPOSES PERSISTED APPLICATION LOGS AND THE NON-DESTRUCTIVE CRASH-REPORT WORKFLOW. >>>!

ps.source: Diagnostics, Settings, Theme, and Guides remain in the utility area. The small overlay-settings button beside supported activities opens only that activity's overlay controls.
ps.translation: * DIAGNOSTICS, SETTINGS, THEME, AND GUIDES REMAIN IN THE UTILITY AREA. THE SMALL OVERLAY-SETTINGS BUTTON BESIDE SUPPORTED ACTIVITIES OPENS ONLY THAT ACTIVITY'S OVERLAY CONTROLS. >>>!

ps.source: Diagonal hatching marks a predicted organism or reward. Solid prediction segments show the dependable lower band; the darker possible segment shows how high the reward range may extend. Each segment retains its legacy solid outline. The dotted group frame spans the body's reported biological signal count; additional PIPs outside it are alternative genus candidates, not additive rewards.
ps.translation: * DIAGONAL HATCHING MARKS A PREDICTED ORGANISM OR REWARD. SOLID PREDICTION SEGMENTS SHOW THE DEPENDABLE LOWER BAND; THE DARKER POSSIBLE SEGMENT SHOWS HOW HIGH THE REWARD RANGE MAY EXTEND. EACH SEGMENT RETAINS ITS LEGACY SOLID OUTLINE. THE DOTTED GROUP FRAME SPANS THE BODY'S REPORTED BIOLOGICAL SIGNAL COUNT; ADDITIONAL PIPS OUTSIDE IT ARE ALTERNATIVE GENUS CANDIDATES, NOT ADDITIVE REWARDS. >>>!

ps.source: Direct EDSM synchronization follows the active Commander and is enabled by saving that profile's personal API key.
ps.translation: * DIRECT EDSM SYNCHRONIZATION FOLLOWS THE ACTIVE COMMANDER AND IS ENABLED BY SAVING THAT PROFILE'S PERSONAL API KEY. >>>!

ps.source: Disable EDSM synchronization for this Commander?
ps.translation: * DISABLE EDSM SYNCHRONIZATION FOR THIS COMMANDER? >>>!

ps.source: Disable overlays when on foot in:
ps.translation: * DISABLE OVERLAYS WHEN ON FOOT IN: >>>!

ps.source: Discovered by CMDR Raven · 2 m ago
ps.translation: * DISCOVERED BY CMDR RAVEN · 2 M AGO >>>!

ps.source: Displays target, route progress, discovery, traffic, services, Guardian sites, and followed-route notes while the FSD is charging or jumping.
ps.translation: * DISPLAYS TARGET, ROUTE PROGRESS, DISCOVERY, TRAFFIC, SERVICES, GUARDIAN SITES, AND FOLLOWED-ROUTE NOTES WHILE THE FSD IS CHARGING OR JUMPING. >>>!

ps.source: Distance LY cannot establish a direction from the origin. Enter galactic X, Y, and Z first.
ps.translation: * DISTANCE LY CANNOT ESTABLISH A DIRECTION FROM THE ORIGIN. ENTER GALACTIC X, Y, AND Z FIRST. >>>!

ps.source: Distance LY is measured from {0}. Editing it preserves the journal-derived galactic bearing while correcting the stored distance.
ps.translation: * DISTANCE LY IS MEASURED FROM {0}. EDITING IT PRESERVES THE JOURNAL-DERIVED GALACTIC BEARING WHILE CORRECTING THE STORED DISTANCE. >>>!

ps.source: Distance LY is unavailable until the journal or a custom origin supplies galactic coordinates.
ps.translation: * DISTANCE LY IS UNAVAILABLE UNTIL THE JOURNAL OR A CUSTOM ORIGIN SUPPLIES GALACTIC COORDINATES. >>>!

ps.source: Distances use Sol until a custom origin is selected.
ps.translation: * DISTANCES USE SOL UNTIL A CUSTOM ORIGIN IS SELECTED. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at a Fleet Carrier to publish and link it. Registration preserves Raven's existing cargo; a freshly opened market is reconciled afterward.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT A FLEET CARRIER TO PUBLISH AND LINK IT. REGISTRATION PRESERVES RAVEN'S EXISTING CARGO; A FRESHLY OPENED MARKET IS RECONCILED AFTERWARD. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at a colonization construction site first.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT A COLONIZATION CONSTRUCTION SITE FIRST. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at a construction site and open Construction Services.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT A CONSTRUCTION SITE AND OPEN CONSTRUCTION SERVICES. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at a market and refresh Frontier data.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT A MARKET AND REFRESH FRONTIER DATA. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at a supported station and refresh Frontier data.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT A SUPPORTED STATION AND REFRESH FRONTIER DATA. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at the Fleet Carrier and reopen its commodity market before syncing.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT THE FLEET CARRIER AND REOPEN ITS COMMODITY MARKET BEFORE SYNCING. >>>!

ps.source: Dock at the Fleet Carrier you want to publish and link.
ps.translation: * DOCK AT THE FLEET CARRIER YOU WANT TO PUBLISH AND LINK. >>>!

ps.source: Dots represent biological samples or bookmarks. Their surrounding circles show the organism colony radius.
ps.translation: * DOTS REPRESENT BIOLOGICAL SAMPLES OR BOOKMARKS. THEIR SURROUNDING CIRCLES SHOW THE ORGANISM COLONY RADIUS. >>>!

ps.source: Double-click a PNG to open it with the operating system.
ps.translation: * DOUBLE-CLICK A PNG TO OPEN IT WITH THE OPERATING SYSTEM. >>>!

ps.source: Download hash verified; validating archive files...
ps.translation: * DOWNLOAD HASH VERIFIED; VALIDATING ARCHIVE FILES... >>>!

ps.source: Download star system, bodies and organic signals data from EDSM, Spansh and Canonn
ps.translation: * DOWNLOAD STAR SYSTEM, BODIES AND ORGANIC SIGNALS DATA FROM EDSM, SPANSH AND CANONN >>>!

ps.source: Download the AppImage from this release, make it executable, replace your existing AppImage file, and launch it again.
ps.translation: * DOWNLOAD THE APPIMAGE FROM THIS RELEASE, MAKE IT EXECUTABLE, REPLACE YOUR EXISTING APPIMAGE FILE, AND LAUNCH IT AGAIN. >>>!

ps.source: Downloaded catalogs are bounded, validated, checksummed, staged, and activated with health confirmation and rollback.
ps.translation: * DOWNLOADED CATALOGS ARE BOUNDED, VALIDATED, CHECKSUMMED, STAGED, AND ACTIVATED WITH HEALTH CONFIRMATION AND ROLLBACK. >>>!

ps.source: Downloading into the update cache. The installation and profile are still untouched.
ps.translation: * DOWNLOADING INTO THE UPDATE CACHE. THE INSTALLATION AND PROFILE ARE STILL UNTOUCHED. >>>!

ps.source: Downloads are staged before shutdown; cancelled or failed pre-handoff attempts clean their candidates, stale plans are removed automatically, and failed startup can roll back safely.
ps.translation: * DOWNLOADS ARE STAGED BEFORE SHUTDOWN; CANCELLED OR FAILED PRE-HANDOFF ATTEMPTS CLEAN THEIR CANDIDATES, STALE PLANS ARE REMOVED AUTOMATICALLY, AND FAILED STARTUP CAN ROLL BACK SAFELY. >>>!

ps.source: Draft changes preview immediately but remain session-only until verified export. Starting a draft naturally unlocks the same selected-point form that was read only in reference mode.
ps.translation: * DRAFT CHANGES PREVIEW IMMEDIATELY BUT REMAIN SESSION-ONLY UNTIL VERIFIED EXPORT. STARTING A DRAFT NATURALLY UNLOCKS THE SAME SELECTED-POINT FORM THAT WAS READ ONLY IN REFERENCE MODE. >>>!

ps.source: Draft points are previewed on the active settlement map. Nothing changes on disk until you choose an export destination.
ps.translation: * DRAFT POINTS ARE PREVIEWED ON THE ACTIVE SETTLEMENT MAP. NOTHING CHANGES ON DISK UNTIL YOU CHOOSE AN EXPORT DESTINATION. >>>!

ps.source: Drag dots onto circle centres. Drag empty space to move; lower-right corner to resize. {0}
ps.translation: * DRAG DOTS ONTO CIRCLE CENTRES. DRAG EMPTY SPACE TO MOVE; LOWER-RIGHT CORNER TO RESIZE. {0} >>>!

ps.source: Drag the bordered previews to the desired monitors and positions. Preview content comes from a false game state shaped like real overlay data.
ps.translation: * DRAG THE BORDERED PREVIEWS TO THE DESIRED MONITORS AND POSITIONS. PREVIEW CONTENT COMES FROM A FALSE GAME STATE SHAPED LIKE REAL OVERLAY DATA. >>>!

ps.source: Drag the frame over the six HUD circles. Resize it from the lower-right corner, leaving room for cockpit movement; resizing changes the capture area without stretching or moving the guides inside it. Drag each numbered red dot onto its matching circle centre. Keep all six circles and their complete bars inside the frame; the small numbers are not read.
ps.translation: * DRAG THE FRAME OVER THE SIX HUD CIRCLES. RESIZE IT FROM THE LOWER-RIGHT CORNER, LEAVING ROOM FOR COCKPIT MOVEMENT; RESIZING CHANGES THE CAPTURE AREA WITHOUT STRETCHING OR MOVING THE GUIDES INSIDE IT. DRAG EACH NUMBERED RED DOT ONTO ITS MATCHING CIRCLE CENTRE. KEEP ALL SIX CIRCLES AND THEIR COMPLETE BARS INSIDE THE FRAME; THE SMALL NUMBERS ARE NOT READ. >>>!

ps.source: Drive to a mining-location border, face its center, and send .mining <heading> <radius km> <number>, i.e. .mining 120 6.44 4.
ps.translation: * DRIVE TO A MINING-LOCATION BORDER, FACE ITS CENTER, AND SEND .MINING <HEADING> <RADIUS KM> <NUMBER>, I.E. .MINING 120 6.44 4. >>>!

ps.source: Drive to the orange location border, face the center marker, and send .mining <heading> <border radius km> <location number>. Example: .mining 120 6.44 4.
ps.translation: * DRIVE TO THE ORANGE LOCATION BORDER, FACE THE CENTER MARKER, AND SEND .MINING <HEADING> <BORDER RADIUS KM> <LOCATION NUMBER>. EXAMPLE: .MINING 120 6.44 4. >>>!

ps.source: Drive to the orange mining-location border and face its center, then use .mining <heading> <radius km> <number>, i.e. .mining 120 6.44 4. Use .mining center here from the true center to correct it later.
ps.translation: * DRIVE TO THE ORANGE MINING-LOCATION BORDER AND FACE ITS CENTER, THEN USE .MINING <HEADING> <RADIUS KM> <NUMBER>, I.E. .MINING 120 6.44 4. USE .MINING CENTER HERE FROM THE TRUE CENTER TO CORRECT IT LATER. >>>!

ps.source: Drive to the orange mining-location border and face the center marker.
ps.translation: * DRIVE TO THE ORANGE MINING-LOCATION BORDER AND FACE THE CENTER MARKER. >>>!

ps.source: EDDN needs no personal account or API key. This release sends production-schema messages through the Live gateway.
ps.translation: * EDDN NEEDS NO PERSONAL ACCOUNT OR API KEY. THIS RELEASE SENDS PRODUCTION-SCHEMA MESSAGES THROUGH THE LIVE GATEWAY. >>>!

ps.source: EDDN processing was isolated from journal tracking: {0}
ps.translation: * EDDN PROCESSING WAS ISOLATED FROM JOURNAL TRACKING: {0} >>>!

ps.source: EDDN publication, Inara publication, direct EDSM synchronization, human-settlement geometry, Green Gas Giant candidates, Raven cargo, Fleet Carrier data, system updates, and quest publication each require the corresponding setting, credential, or explicit confirmation.
ps.translation: * EDDN PUBLICATION, INARA PUBLICATION, DIRECT EDSM SYNCHRONIZATION, HUMAN-SETTLEMENT GEOMETRY, GREEN GAS GIANT CANDIDATES, RAVEN CARGO, FLEET CARRIER DATA, SYSTEM UPDATES, AND QUEST PUBLICATION EACH REQUIRE THE CORRESPONDING SETTING, CREDENTIAL, OR EXPLICIT CONFIRMATION. >>>!

ps.source: EDDN reception opens a separate receive-only connection. Commodity observations expire after 24 hours; coverage grows while enabled.
ps.translation: * EDDN RECEPTION OPENS A SEPARATE RECEIVE-ONLY CONNECTION. COMMODITY OBSERVATIONS EXPIRE AFTER 24 HOURS; COVERAGE GROWS WHILE ENABLED. >>>!

ps.source: EDDN requires no account, personal API key, OAuth flow, access token, or Authorization header.
ps.translation: * EDDN REQUIRES NO ACCOUNT, PERSONAL API KEY, OAUTH FLOW, ACCESS TOKEN, OR AUTHORIZATION HEADER. >>>!

ps.source: EDDN sharing is enabled for live Commander sessions.
ps.translation: * EDDN SHARING IS ENABLED FOR LIVE COMMANDER SESSIONS. >>>!

ps.source: EDDN sharing is installation-wide, disabled by default, and configured from Settings > Privacy & sharing.
ps.translation: * EDDN SHARING IS INSTALLATION-WIDE, DISABLED BY DEFAULT, AND CONFIGURED FROM SETTINGS > PRIVACY & SHARING. >>>!

ps.source: EDSM and Spansh body lookups wait for an active Elite session and a confirmed visit to the current system. If newly discovered body data is not indexed yet, SrvSurvey allows up to three retries after the initial lookup and remembers the current-visit budget across application restarts.
ps.translation: * EDSM AND SPANSH BODY LOOKUPS WAIT FOR AN ACTIVE ELITE SESSION AND A CONFIRMED VISIT TO THE CURRENT SYSTEM. IF NEWLY DISCOVERED BODY DATA IS NOT INDEXED YET, SRVSURVEY ALLOWS UP TO THREE RETRIES AFTER THE INITIAL LOOKUP AND REMEMBERS THE CURRENT-VISIT BUDGET ACROSS APPLICATION RESTARTS. >>>!

ps.source: EDSM processing was isolated from journal tracking: {0}
ps.translation: * EDSM PROCESSING WAS ISOLATED FROM JOURNAL TRACKING: {0} >>>!

ps.source: EDSM processing was skipped without affecting journal tracking: {0}
ps.translation: * EDSM PROCESSING WAS SKIPPED WITHOUT AFFECTING JOURNAL TRACKING: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Each PIP has the legacy translucent dotted outer frame plus a solid outline around every filled or possible-reward segment. Both border layers follow the PIP state and are independently configurable in Overlay appearance.
ps.translation: * EACH PIP HAS THE LEGACY TRANSLUCENT DOTTED OUTER FRAME PLUS A SOLID OUTLINE AROUND EVERY FILLED OR POSSIBLE-REWARD SEGMENT. BOTH BORDER LAYERS FOLLOW THE PIP STATE AND ARE INDEPENDENTLY CONFIGURABLE IN OVERLAY APPEARANCE. >>>!

ps.source: Each equipped module can appear only once per trigger. Use its slot to distinguish duplicate modules.
ps.translation: * EACH EQUIPPED MODULE CAN APPEAR ONLY ONCE PER TRIGGER. USE ITS SLOT TO DISTINGUISH DUPLICATE MODULES. >>>!

ps.source: Each journal session uses that session's Commander name as EDDN's required uploader identifier. EDDN obfuscates the identifier before relaying the data. Changing Commanders creates a new isolated session; queued messages retain the Commander header captured when they were created.
ps.translation: * EACH JOURNAL SESSION USES THAT SESSION'S COMMANDER NAME AS EDDN'S REQUIRED UPLOADER IDENTIFIER. EDDN OBFUSCATES THE IDENTIFIER BEFORE RELAYING THE DATA. CHANGING COMMANDERS CREATES A NEW ISOLATED SESSION; QUEUED MESSAGES RETAIN THE COMMANDER HEADER CAPTURED WHEN THEY WERE CREATED. >>>!

ps.source: Each overlay has a specific game-state trigger and can also have a manual shortcut.
ps.translation: * EACH OVERLAY HAS A SPECIFIC GAME-STATE TRIGGER AND CAN ALSO HAVE A MANUAL SHORTCUT. >>>!

ps.source: Easy to bounce or flip if you tap down-thrust
ps.translation: * EASY TO BOUNCE OR FLIP IF YOU TAP DOWN-THRUST >>>!

ps.source: Edit the first six shared bindings in Settings > Input or in Surface Mining overlay settings, where they retain the Mining rig labels. Both locations edit the same bindings, including any replacement keyboard or controller chords.
ps.translation: * EDIT THE FIRST SIX SHARED BINDINGS IN SETTINGS > INPUT OR IN SURFACE MINING OVERLAY SETTINGS, WHERE THEY RETAIN THE MINING RIG LABELS. BOTH LOCATIONS EDIT THE SAME BINDINGS, INCLUDING ANY REPLACEMENT KEYBOARD OR CONTROLLER CHORDS. >>>!

ps.source: Editing the selected commander survey. Save writes the legacy-compatible file atomically.
ps.translation: * EDITING THE SELECTED COMMANDER SURVEY. SAVE WRITES THE LEGACY-COMPATIBLE FILE ATOMICALLY. >>>!

ps.source: Editing {0}. Changes are saved only when you select Save.
ps.translation: * EDITING {0}. CHANGES ARE SAVED ONLY WHEN YOU SELECT SAVE. >>>!

ps.source: Editing {0}. Use the top ✓ to save all changes and close the editor.
ps.translation: * EDITING {0}. USE THE TOP ✓ TO SAVE ALL CHANGES AND CLOSE THE EDITOR. >>>!

ps.source: Eligible live events enter a bounded durable retry queue. Startup history and multicrew activity are not uploaded, and delivery pauses when multiple Elite windows make companion-file ownership ambiguous.
ps.translation: * ELIGIBLE LIVE EVENTS ENTER A BOUNDED DURABLE RETRY QUEUE. STARTUP HISTORY AND MULTICREW ACTIVITY ARE NOT UPLOADED, AND DELIVERY PAUSES WHEN MULTIPLE ELITE WINDOWS MAKE COMPANION-FILE OWNERSHIP AMBIGUOUS. >>>!

ps.source: Elite Dangerous could not be focused after {0}; no matching game window was available.
ps.translation: * ELITE DANGEROUS COULD NOT BE FOCUSED AFTER {0}; NO MATCHING GAME WINDOW WAS AVAILABLE. >>>!

ps.source: Elite Dangerous is not running; file operations are available.
ps.translation: * ELITE DANGEROUS IS NOT RUNNING; FILE OPERATIONS ARE AVAILABLE. >>>!

ps.source: Elite must remain visible and foreground while first-footfall notification detection is active.
ps.translation: * ELITE MUST REMAIN VISIBLE AND FOREGROUND WHILE FIRST-FOOTFALL NOTIFICATION DETECTION IS ACTIVE. >>>!

ps.source: Elite session closed normally; waiting for the next journal session.
ps.translation: * ELITE SESSION CLOSED NORMALLY; WAITING FOR THE NEXT JOURNAL SESSION. >>>!

ps.source: Embed location details within image, if known
ps.translation: * EMBED LOCATION DETAILS WITHIN IMAGE, IF KNOWN >>>!

ps.source: Enable EDDN sharing for live Commander sessions
ps.translation: * ENABLE EDDN SHARING FOR LIVE COMMANDER SESSIONS >>>!

ps.source: Enable EDDN uploads in only one application at a time; for example, SrvSurvey or EDMC. Using multiple uploaders can create duplicate submissions.
ps.translation: * ENABLE EDDN UPLOADS IN ONLY ONE APPLICATION AT A TIME; FOR EXAMPLE, SRVSURVEY OR EDMC. USING MULTIPLE UPLOADERS CAN CREATE DUPLICATE SUBMISSIONS. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Green Gas Giant uploads in Settings before publishing historical candidates.
ps.translation: * ENABLE GREEN GAS GIANT UPLOADS IN SETTINGS BEFORE PUBLISHING HISTORICAL CANDIDATES. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Inara uploads in only one application at a time to avoid duplicate Commander events.
ps.translation: * ENABLE INARA UPLOADS IN ONLY ONE APPLICATION AT A TIME TO AVOID DUPLICATE COMMANDER EVENTS. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Inara uploads in only one application at a time to avoid duplicate commander events.
ps.translation: * ENABLE INARA UPLOADS IN ONLY ONE APPLICATION AT A TIME TO AVOID DUPLICATE COMMANDER EVENTS. >>>!

ps.source: Enable OpenVR overlays before resetting headset orientation.
ps.translation: * ENABLE OPENVR OVERLAYS BEFORE RESETTING HEADSET ORIENTATION. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial before loading a system.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL BEFORE LOADING A SYSTEM. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial before preparing a project.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL BEFORE PREPARING A PROJECT. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial before publishing a Fleet Carrier.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL BEFORE PUBLISHING A FLEET CARRIER. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial before publishing ship cargo.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL BEFORE PUBLISHING SHIP CARGO. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial before syncing Fleet Carrier cargo.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL BEFORE SYNCING FLEET CARRIER CARGO. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Raven Colonial in Settings and save the API key for the active Commander.
ps.translation: * ENABLE RAVEN COLONIAL IN SETTINGS AND SAVE THE API KEY FOR THE ACTIVE COMMANDER. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Require FSS to report all bodies when entering a new system is not enough and you want completion to wait for a full FSS identification. Enabled earlier-visit and older-Spansh completion rules remain explicit exceptions.
ps.translation: * ENABLE REQUIRE FSS TO REPORT ALL BODIES WHEN ENTERING A NEW SYSTEM IS NOT ENOUGH AND YOU WANT COMPLETION TO WAIT FOR A FULL FSS IDENTIFICATION. ENABLED EARLIER-VISIT AND OLDER-SPANSH COMPLETION RULES REMAIN EXPLICIT EXCEPTIONS. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Send Journal to VoxStellar for boxel surveying to upload new live Scan, FSDTarget, FSDJump, FSSDiscoveryScan, SAASignalsFound, ScanOrganic, ScanBaryCentre, and CodexEntry events with your Commander name.
ps.translation: * ENABLE SEND JOURNAL TO VOXSTELLAR FOR BOXEL SURVEYING TO UPLOAD NEW LIVE SCAN, FSDTARGET, FSDJUMP, FSSDISCOVERYSCAN, SAASIGNALSFOUND, SCANORGANIC, SCANBARYCENTRE, AND CODEXENTRY EVENTS WITH YOUR COMMANDER NAME. >>>!

ps.source: Enable Show flight warnings and choose a gravity threshold in Exploration overlay settings. The warning appears only when SrvSurvey can identify a nearby landable body in a supported ship, fighter, or SRV flight context.
ps.translation: * ENABLE SHOW FLIGHT WARNINGS AND CHOOSE A GRAVITY THRESHOLD IN EXPLORATION OVERLAY SETTINGS. THE WARNING APPEARS ONLY WHEN SRVSURVEY CAN IDENTIFY A NEARBY LANDABLE BODY IN A SUPPORTED SHIP, FIGHTER, OR SRV FLIGHT CONTEXT. >>>!

ps.source: Enable direct EDSM synchronization in only one application at a time to avoid duplicate requests.
ps.translation: * ENABLE DIRECT EDSM SYNCHRONIZATION IN ONLY ONE APPLICATION AT A TIME TO AVOID DUPLICATE REQUESTS. >>>!

ps.source: Enable global keyboard input below, then use this shortcut to make existing live overlays clickable and draggable. Use it again to save positions and restore click-through mode; it never opens the full editor.
ps.translation: * ENABLE GLOBAL KEYBOARD INPUT BELOW, THEN USE THIS SHORTCUT TO MAKE EXISTING LIVE OVERLAYS CLICKABLE AND DRAGGABLE. USE IT AGAIN TO SAVE POSITIONS AND RESTORE CLICK-THROUGH MODE; IT NEVER OPENS THE FULL EDITOR. >>>!

ps.source: Enable journal and companion-data sharing in only one Elite Dangerous third-party application at a time. If another companion already publishes the same data, leave the equivalent SrvSurvey sharing feature disabled to prevent duplicate entries and conflicting updates.
ps.translation: * ENABLE JOURNAL AND COMPANION-DATA SHARING IN ONLY ONE ELITE DANGEROUS THIRD-PARTY APPLICATION AT A TIME. IF ANOTHER COMPANION ALREADY PUBLISHES THE SAME DATA, LEAVE THE EQUIVALENT SRVSURVEY SHARING FEATURE DISABLED TO PREVENT DUPLICATE ENTRIES AND CONFLICTING UPDATES. >>>!

ps.source: Enable or disable data banners on future screenshots.
ps.translation: * ENABLE OR DISABLE DATA BANNERS ON FUTURE SCREENSHOTS. >>>!

ps.source: Enable the filename, folder, banner, or aerial-alignment options you want.
ps.translation: * ENABLE THE FILENAME, FOLDER, BANNER, OR AERIAL-ALIGNMENT OPTIONS YOU WANT. >>>!

ps.source: Enable the limit to evaluate the current system
ps.translation: * ENABLE THE LIMIT TO EVALUATE THE CURRENT SYSTEM >>>!

ps.source: Enter a biological signal or missing variants to find nearby systems.
ps.translation: * ENTER A BIOLOGICAL SIGNAL OR MISSING VARIANTS TO FIND NEARBY SYSTEMS. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a firegroup configuration name before saving.
ps.translation: * ENTER A FIREGROUP CONFIGURATION NAME BEFORE SAVING. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a generated system name, ordinary system name, or id64 in Top boxel or generated system. Select an EDSM suggestion when one appears so SrvSurvey retains the authoritative id64.
ps.translation: * ENTER A GENERATED SYSTEM NAME, ORDINARY SYSTEM NAME, OR ID64 IN TOP BOXEL OR GENERATED SYSTEM. SELECT AN EDSM SUGGESTION WHEN ONE APPEARS SO SRVSURVEY RETAINS THE AUTHORITATIVE ID64. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a genus, species, and at least one variant color.
ps.translation: * ENTER A GENUS, SPECIES, AND AT LEAST ONE VARIANT COLOR. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a keyboard shortcut or controller chord, or leave blank.
ps.translation: * ENTER A KEYBOARD SHORTCUT OR CONTROLLER CHORD, OR LEAVE BLANK. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a live Elite system before loading Raven sites.
ps.translation: * ENTER A LIVE ELITE SYSTEM BEFORE LOADING RAVEN SITES. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a mineral and 0–16 pending tons.
ps.translation: * ENTER A MINERAL AND 0–16 PENDING TONS. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a name for this route. It will be stored in your commander route library.
ps.translation: * ENTER A NAME FOR THIS ROUTE. IT WILL BE STORED IN YOUR COMMANDER ROUTE LIBRARY. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a name for this saved search.
ps.translation: * ENTER A NAME FOR THIS SAVED SEARCH. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a star-system name to set a custom origin.
ps.translation: * ENTER A STAR-SYSTEM NAME TO SET A CUSTOM ORIGIN. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a system name to search.
ps.translation: * ENTER A SYSTEM NAME TO SEARCH. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a system to browse biological Codex entries.
ps.translation: * ENTER A SYSTEM TO BROWSE BIOLOGICAL CODEX ENTRIES. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a system, optional body/ring and category; saving a new category makes it available to the category filter.
ps.translation: * ENTER A SYSTEM, OPTIONAL BODY/RING AND CATEGORY; SAVING A NEW CATEGORY MAKES IT AVAILABLE TO THE CATEGORY FILTER. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a valid generated system and lower mass code.
ps.translation: * ENTER A VALID GENERATED SYSTEM AND LOWER MASS CODE. >>>!

ps.source: Enter a valid generated system or boxel name.
ps.translation: * ENTER A VALID GENERATED SYSTEM OR BOXEL NAME. >>>!

ps.source: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both blank for an unknown surface origin.
ps.translation: * ENTER BOTH LATITUDE AND LONGITUDE, OR LEAVE BOTH BLANK FOR AN UNKNOWN SURFACE ORIGIN. >>>!

ps.source: Enter coordinates in Travel or send .target here through the in-game chat journal to capture the current location.
ps.translation: * ENTER COORDINATES IN TRAVEL OR SEND .TARGET HERE THROUGH THE IN-GAME CHAT JOURNAL TO CAPTURE THE CURRENT LOCATION. >>>!

ps.source: Enter galactic X, Y, and Z together, or leave all three blank.
ps.translation: * ENTER GALACTIC X, Y, AND Z TOGETHER, OR LEAVE ALL THREE BLANK. >>>!

ps.source: Enter one or more terms in Search settings. Use Up and Down to move through grouped results, Enter to open the selected setting, or select a result directly.
ps.translation: * ENTER ONE OR MORE TERMS IN SEARCH SETTINGS. USE UP AND DOWN TO MOVE THROUGH GROUPED RESULTS, ENTER TO OPEN THE SELECTED SETTING, OR SELECT A RESULT DIRECTLY. >>>!

ps.source: Enter or scan a system with biological signals.
ps.translation: * ENTER OR SCAN A SYSTEM WITH BIOLOGICAL SIGNALS. >>>!

ps.source: Enter the biological signal to find.
ps.translation: * ENTER THE BIOLOGICAL SIGNAL TO FIND. >>>!

ps.source: Enter the current route, boxel, or clipboard target in the Galaxy Map.
ps.translation: * ENTER THE CURRENT ROUTE, BOXEL, OR CLIPBOARD TARGET IN THE GALAXY MAP. >>>!

ps.source: Enter {0} or higher; that suffix is already recorded.
ps.translation: * ENTER {0} OR HIGHER; THAT SUFFIX IS ALREADY RECORDED. >>>!

ps.source: Entire saved search combines recorded systems and bodies from every boxel in that saved search before calculating the average.
ps.translation: * ENTIRE SAVED SEARCH COMBINES RECORDED SYSTEMS AND BODIES FROM EVERY BOXEL IN THAT SAVED SEARCH BEFORE CALCULATING THE AVERAGE. >>>!

ps.source: Entries remain visible in this session, but the log file could not be updated: {0}
ps.translation: * ENTRIES REMAIN VISIBLE IN THIS SESSION, BUT THE LOG FILE COULD NOT BE UPDATED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Equip the genetic sampler and approach a relic tower to begin its heading survey.
ps.translation: * EQUIP THE GENETIC SAMPLER AND APPROACH A RELIC TOWER TO BEGIN ITS HEADING SURVEY. >>>!

ps.source: Equip the genetic sampler and approach a relic tower to record its heading.
ps.translation: * EQUIP THE GENETIC SAMPLER AND APPROACH A RELIC TOWER TO RECORD ITS HEADING. >>>!

ps.source: Error details copied to the clipboard.
ps.translation: * ERROR DETAILS COPIED TO THE CLIPBOARD. >>>!

ps.source: Every Raven site requires a name.
ps.translation: * EVERY RAVEN SITE REQUIRES A NAME. >>>!

ps.source: Every lower level multiplies the work: one boxel has eight direct children, and selecting several levels can create a very large search tree.
ps.translation: * EVERY LOWER LEVEL MULTIPLIES THE WORK: ONE BOXEL HAS EIGHT DIRECT CHILDREN, AND SELECTING SEVERAL LEVELS CAN CREATE A VERY LARGE SEARCH TREE. >>>!

ps.source: Exact predictions are disabled in system-survey settings.
ps.translation: * EXACT PREDICTIONS ARE DISABLED IN SYSTEM-SURVEY SETTINGS. >>>!

ps.source: Exact system names use the shared system resolver. A blank origin uses your current system.
ps.translation: * EXACT SYSTEM NAMES USE THE SHARED SYSTEM RESOLVER. A BLANK ORIGIN USES YOUR CURRENT SYSTEM. >>>!

ps.source: Exceptions changed for this session but could not be saved: {0}
ps.translation: * EXCEPTIONS CHANGED FOR THIS SESSION BUT COULD NOT BE SAVED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Exchange engineering materials at a trader. These are separate from the commodity market.
ps.translation: * EXCHANGE ENGINEERING MATERIALS AT A TRADER. THESE ARE SEPARATE FROM THE COMMODITY MARKET. >>>!

ps.source: Executable releases and reference catalogs are checked and activated independently.
ps.translation: * EXECUTABLE RELEASES AND REFERENCE CATALOGS ARE CHECKED AND ACTIVATED INDEPENDENTLY. >>>!

ps.source: Existing shared map copied into an editable draft.
ps.translation: * EXISTING SHARED MAP COPIED INTO AN EDITABLE DRAFT. >>>!

ps.source: Exobiology totals show samples and rewards that have not yet been sold.
ps.translation: * EXOBIOLOGY TOTALS SHOW SAMPLES AND REWARDS THAT HAVE NOT YET BEEN SOLD. >>>!

ps.source: Expand Activities and select Mining. Use the overlay-settings button beside Mining to enable Surface mining and assign a show/hide shortcut if desired.
ps.translation: * EXPAND ACTIVITIES AND SELECT MINING. USE THE OVERLAY-SETTINGS BUTTON BESIDE MINING TO ENABLE SURFACE MINING AND ASSIGN A SHOW/HIDE SHORTCUT IF DESIRED. >>>!

ps.source: Expand to assign keyboard or controller inputs to actions.
ps.translation: * EXPAND TO ASSIGN KEYBOARD OR CONTROLLER INPUTS TO ACTIONS. >>>!

ps.source: Exploration totals combine jump, scan, mapping, landing, distance, and estimated reward state for the active profile.
ps.translation: * EXPLORATION TOTALS COMBINE JUMP, SCAN, MAPPING, LANDING, DISTANCE, AND ESTIMATED REWARD STATE FOR THE ACTIVE PROFILE. >>>!

ps.source: Explore recorded children to move down the boxel hierarchy. When statistics are opened from a saved-search entry, switch between the selected boxel and the combined saved-search scope; boxels without recorded statistics add nothing to the rollup.
ps.translation: * EXPLORE RECORDED CHILDREN TO MOVE DOWN THE BOXEL HIERARCHY. WHEN STATISTICS ARE OPENED FROM A SAVED-SEARCH ENTRY, SWITCH BETWEEN THE SELECTED BOXEL AND THE COMBINED SAVED-SEARCH SCOPE; BOXELS WITHOUT RECORDED STATISTICS ADD NOTHING TO THE ROLLUP. >>>!

ps.source: Explore sites, review surveys, and track both Ram Tah research missions.
ps.translation: * EXPLORE SITES, REVIEW SURVEYS, AND TRACK BOTH RAM TAH RESEARCH MISSIONS. >>>!

ps.source: Export JSON + CSV writes the detailed snapshot and tabular summary to a folder you choose.
ps.translation: * EXPORT JSON + CSV WRITES THE DETAILED SNAPSHOT AND TABULAR SUMMARY TO A FOLDER YOU CHOOSE. >>>!

ps.source: Export selected fleet-carrier routes as CSV
ps.translation: * EXPORT SELECTED FLEET-CARRIER ROUTES AS CSV >>>!

ps.source: Export selected fleet-carrier routes as Spansh JSON
ps.translation: * EXPORT SELECTED FLEET-CARRIER ROUTES AS SPANSH JSON >>>!

ps.source: Export selected routes as Spansh JSON
ps.translation: * EXPORT SELECTED ROUTES AS SPANSH JSON >>>!

ps.source: Export verified catalog to persist the draft for review, or Discard draft to abandon every unexported shared-template change.
ps.translation: * EXPORT VERIFIED CATALOG TO PERSIST THE DRAFT FOR REVIEW, OR DISCARD DRAFT TO ABANDON EVERY UNEXPORTED SHARED-TEMPLATE CHANGE. >>>!

ps.source: Exported and verified {0} settlement templates; the previous file was backed up.
ps.translation: * EXPORTED AND VERIFIED {0} SETTLEMENT TEMPLATES; THE PREVIOUS FILE WAS BACKED UP. >>>!

ps.source: Exported {0} events ({1} bootstrap) and {2} companion snapshots to {3}.
ps.translation: * EXPORTED {0} EVENTS ({1} BOOTSTRAP) AND {2} COMPANION SNAPSHOTS TO {3}. >>>!

ps.source: Exports only boxels with at least this many recorded systems. Counts and stored data do not change.
ps.translation: * EXPORTS ONLY BOXELS WITH AT LEAST THIS MANY RECORDED SYSTEMS. COUNTS AND STORED DATA DO NOT CHANGE. >>>!

ps.source: External body data is not indexed yet by {0}; retry {1} of {2} is scheduled in {3} seconds.
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL BODY DATA IS NOT INDEXED YET BY {0}; RETRY {1} OF {2} IS SCHEDULED IN {3} SECONDS. >>>!

ps.source: External body data remains unindexed by {0}; automatic retries are paused until the system context changes.
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL BODY DATA REMAINS UNINDEXED BY {0}; AUTOMATIC RETRIES ARE PAUSED UNTIL THE SYSTEM CONTEXT CHANGES. >>>!

ps.source: External body retry state could not be remembered safely: {0}
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL BODY RETRY STATE COULD NOT BE REMEMBERED SAFELY: {0} >>>!

ps.source: External body retry state could not be restored safely: {0}
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL BODY RETRY STATE COULD NOT BE RESTORED SAFELY: {0} >>>!

ps.source: External desktop effects are disabled during diagnostic replay.
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL DESKTOP EFFECTS ARE DISABLED DURING DIAGNOSTIC REPLAY. >>>!

ps.source: External reads and every upload path are visible and separately gated.
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL READS AND EVERY UPLOAD PATH ARE VISIBLE AND SEPARATELY GATED. >>>!

ps.source: External system resolution is clearly reported when a lookup service is unavailable or disabled.
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL SYSTEM RESOLUTION IS CLEARLY REPORTED WHEN A LOOKUP SERVICE IS UNAVAILABLE OR DISABLED. >>>!

ps.source: External timestamps describe when a community service last received data, not guaranteed first-discovery or current in-game completeness. Treat skip rules as workflow filters rather than proof that a system has nothing left to discover.
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL TIMESTAMPS DESCRIBE WHEN A COMMUNITY SERVICE LAST RECEIVED DATA, NOT GUARANTEED FIRST-DISCOVERY OR CURRENT IN-GAME COMPLETENESS. TREAT SKIP RULES AS WORKFLOW FILTERS RATHER THAN PROOF THAT A SYSTEM HAS NOTHING LEFT TO DISCOVER. >>>!

ps.source: External-data enrichment can add prior discovery, traffic, station, and biological context when its privacy setting is enabled.
ps.translation: * EXTERNAL-DATA ENRICHMENT CAN ADD PRIOR DISCOVERY, TRAFFIC, STATION, AND BIOLOGICAL CONTEXT WHEN ITS PRIVACY SETTING IS ENABLED. >>>!

ps.source: FC Routes accepts Spansh Fleet Carrier Router result URLs only.
ps.translation: * FC ROUTES ACCEPTS SPANSH FLEET CARRIER ROUTER RESULT URLS ONLY. >>>!

ps.source: FSS overlays follow FSS focus; body and biology overlays follow the current body; maps follow nearby site or surface state; travel overlays follow targets and routes; shopping follows active construction context.
ps.translation: * FSS OVERLAYS FOLLOW FSS FOCUS; BODY AND BIOLOGY OVERLAYS FOLLOW THE CURRENT BODY; MAPS FOLLOW NEARBY SITE OR SURFACE STATE; TRAVEL OVERLAYS FOLLOW TARGETS AND ROUTES; SHOPPING FOLLOWS ACTIVE CONSTRUCTION CONTEXT. >>>!

ps.source: FSS tuning capture is temporarily unavailable: {0}
ps.translation: * FSS TUNING CAPTURE IS TEMPORARILY UNAVAILABLE: {0} >>>!

ps.source: FSS tuning detection is active, but its diagnostic image could not be saved: {0}
ps.translation: * FSS TUNING DETECTION IS ACTIVE, BUT ITS DIAGNOSTIC IMAGE COULD NOT BE SAVED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: FSS tuning detection is not supported on this platform.
ps.translation: * FSS TUNING DETECTION IS NOT SUPPORTED ON THIS PLATFORM. >>>!

ps.source: FSS tuning detection requires an X11 session; direct screen capture is unavailable on Wayland.
ps.translation: * FSS TUNING DETECTION REQUIRES AN X11 SESSION; DIRECT SCREEN CAPTURE IS UNAVAILABLE ON WAYLAND. >>>!

ps.source: Face the Guardian alignment feature and type .heading again.
ps.translation: * FACE THE GUARDIAN ALIGNMENT FEATURE AND TYPE .HEADING AGAIN. >>>!

ps.source: Face the main structure and confirm the recorded heading.
ps.translation: * FACE THE MAIN STRUCTURE AND CONFIRM THE RECORDED HEADING. >>>!

ps.source: Face the mapped alignment feature and send .heading; send .heading followed by degrees when entering a heading directly.
ps.translation: * FACE THE MAPPED ALIGNMENT FEATURE AND SEND .HEADING; SEND .HEADING FOLLOWED BY DEGREES WHEN ENTERING A HEADING DIRECTLY. >>>!

ps.source: Face the mapped alignment feature and type .heading, or use .heading <degrees>.
ps.translation: * FACE THE MAPPED ALIGNMENT FEATURE AND TYPE .HEADING, OR USE .HEADING <DEGREES>. >>>!

ps.source: Face the mapped alignment feature, then use the configured confirmation control twice.
ps.translation: * FACE THE MAPPED ALIGNMENT FEATURE, THEN USE THE CONFIGURED CONFIRMATION CONTROL TWICE. >>>!

ps.source: Face the relic tower, then toggle shields 2x to record its heading.
ps.translation: * FACE THE RELIC TOWER, THEN TOGGLE SHIELDS 2X TO RECORD ITS HEADING. >>>!

ps.source: Fetching active projects from Raven Colonial...
ps.translation: * FETCHING ACTIVE PROJECTS FROM RAVEN COLONIAL... >>>!

ps.source: Filter systems, rings, minerals or notes
ps.translation: * FILTER SYSTEMS, RINGS, MINERALS OR NOTES >>>!

ps.source: Filters can show only mission logs still needed for the active Ram Tah task.
ps.translation: * FILTERS CAN SHOW ONLY MISSION LOGS STILL NEEDED FOR THE ACTIVE RAM TAH TASK. >>>!

ps.source: Find nearby bodies with selected biological color variants.
ps.translation: * FIND NEARBY BODIES WITH SELECTED BIOLOGICAL COLOR VARIANTS. >>>!

ps.source: Find the last recorded FSD jump into {0}.
ps.translation: * FIND THE LAST RECORDED FSD JUMP INTO {0}. >>>!

ps.source: Find the most recent FSD jump into {0}.
ps.translation: * FIND THE MOST RECENT FSD JUMP INTO {0}. >>>!

ps.source: Find the nearest systems containing a Canonn codex signal.
ps.translation: * FIND THE NEAREST SYSTEMS CONTAINING A CANONN CODEX SIGNAL. >>>!

ps.source: Find → Powerplay connects the system, ring and market decisions.
ps.translation: * FIND → POWERPLAY CONNECTS THE SYSTEM, RING AND MARKET DECISIONS. >>>!

ps.source: Find → Rings combines historical reference rings, your scans and Spansh. Choose Local for cached data, Spansh for online results, or Both. Refine by radius, mineral, ring type, count, overlap or RES annotations.
ps.translation: * FIND → RINGS COMBINES HISTORICAL REFERENCE RINGS, YOUR SCANS AND SPANSH. CHOOSE LOCAL FOR CACHED DATA, SPANSH FOR ONLINE RESULTS, OR BOTH. REFINE BY RADIUS, MINERAL, RING TYPE, COUNT, OVERLAP OR RES ANNOTATIONS. >>>!

ps.source: Fine-tune the commander-specific marker after selecting it on the map.
ps.translation: * FINE-TUNE THE COMMANDER-SPECIFIC MARKER AFTER SELECTING IT ON THE MAP. >>>!

ps.source: Firegroups exceptions were inherited for this session but could not be saved: {0}
ps.translation: * FIREGROUPS EXCEPTIONS WERE INHERITED FOR THIS SESSION BUT COULD NOT BE SAVED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Firegroups has a dedicated overlay settings window with its own exceptions. The button in global overlay settings controls the other Status & utilities panels. Panels shared by several settings categories must be allowed in each of those categories.
ps.translation: * FIREGROUPS HAS A DEDICATED OVERLAY SETTINGS WINDOW WITH ITS OWN EXCEPTIONS. THE BUTTON IN GLOBAL OVERLAY SETTINGS CONTROLS THE OTHER STATUS & UTILITIES PANELS. PANELS SHARED BY SEVERAL SETTINGS CATEGORIES MUST BE ALLOWED IN EACH OF THOSE CATEGORIES. >>>!

ps.source: Firegroups restored. Previous configurations retained in the before-restore file.
ps.translation: * FIREGROUPS RESTORED. PREVIOUS CONFIGURATIONS RETAINED IN THE BEFORE-RESTORE FILE. >>>!

ps.source: Firegroups rollback also failed; use the before-restore file to recover them.
ps.translation: * FIREGROUPS ROLLBACK ALSO FAILED; USE THE BEFORE-RESTORE FILE TO RECOVER THEM. >>>!

ps.source: Firegroups, directly below Fleet Carrier in the sidebar, reads equipped modules from Loadout. Choose A–H with the arrows, add primary and secondary dropdowns with the circled plus buttons, then Add group. The tree previews all assignments. Enter a configuration name and Save; click a saved name to edit, or expand it to inspect the groups. Save and Remove sit beside the name. Each saved row also has a trash button for direct deletion; confirm Yes to delete, or No to keep it.
ps.translation: * FIREGROUPS, DIRECTLY BELOW FLEET CARRIER IN THE SIDEBAR, READS EQUIPPED MODULES FROM LOADOUT. CHOOSE A–H WITH THE ARROWS, ADD PRIMARY AND SECONDARY DROPDOWNS WITH THE CIRCLED PLUS BUTTONS, THEN ADD GROUP. THE TREE PREVIEWS ALL ASSIGNMENTS. ENTER A CONFIGURATION NAME AND SAVE; CLICK A SAVED NAME TO EDIT, OR EXPAND IT TO INSPECT THE GROUPS. SAVE AND REMOVE SIT BESIDE THE NAME. EACH SAVED ROW ALSO HAS A TRASH BUTTON FOR DIRECT DELETION; CONFIRM YES TO DELETE, OR NO TO KEEP IT. >>>!

ps.source: First footfall confirmed on Synuefe NL-N C23-4 B 3
ps.translation: * FIRST FOOTFALL CONFIRMED ON SYNUEFE NL-N C23-4 B 3 >>>!

ps.source: First footfall inferred from Elite's on-screen notification after {0} sample(s); match ratio {1}.
ps.translation: * FIRST FOOTFALL INFERRED FROM ELITE'S ON-SCREEN NOTIFICATION AFTER {0} SAMPLE(S); MATCH RATIO {1}. >>>!

ps.source: First footfall on this body (×5 rewards)
ps.translation: * FIRST FOOTFALL ON THIS BODY (×5 REWARDS) >>>!

ps.source: First-footfall rewards apply to analyzed organisms.
ps.translation: * FIRST-FOOTFALL REWARDS APPLY TO ANALYZED ORGANISMS. >>>!

ps.source: First-footfall screen inference was not configured.
ps.translation: * FIRST-FOOTFALL SCREEN INFERENCE WAS NOT CONFIGURED. >>>!

ps.source: First-footfall state cannot be changed until the current body is known.
ps.translation: * FIRST-FOOTFALL STATE CANNOT BE CHANGED UNTIL THE CURRENT BODY IS KNOWN. >>>!

ps.source: First-footfall state cannot be changed until the current system is known.
ps.translation: * FIRST-FOOTFALL STATE CANNOT BE CHANGED UNTIL THE CURRENT SYSTEM IS KNOWN. >>>!

ps.source: First-footfall status can change reward presentation because a confirmed first footfall multiplies biological sale value.
ps.translation: * FIRST-FOOTFALL STATUS CAN CHANGE REWARD PRESENTATION BECAUSE A CONFIRMED FIRST FOOTFALL MULTIPLIES BIOLOGICAL SALE VALUE. >>>!

ps.source: Fitted loadout grouped by hardpoints, utility, core, military, and optional slots
ps.translation: * FITTED LOADOUT GROUPED BY HARDPOINTS, UTILITY, CORE, MILITARY, AND OPTIONAL SLOTS >>>!

ps.source: Fleet Carrier cargo was not updated: {0}
ps.translation: * FLEET CARRIER CARGO WAS NOT UPDATED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Fleet Carrier cargo will sync from matching Market.json updates.
ps.translation: * FLEET CARRIER CARGO WILL SYNC FROM MATCHING MARKET.JSON UPDATES. >>>!

ps.source: Fleet Carrier reuses the existing Frontier profile. Distance supports two systems, current position, home and your carrier's system.
ps.translation: * FLEET CARRIER REUSES THE EXISTING FRONTIER PROFILE. DISTANCE SUPPORTS TWO SYSTEMS, CURRENT POSITION, HOME AND YOUR CARRIER'S SYSTEM. >>>!

ps.source: Fleet Carrier sits directly below Overview and retains the full carrier profile. Linked Frontier data loads automatically when the commander journal is detected, with the existing cache and refresh cooldown.
ps.translation: * FLEET CARRIER SITS DIRECTLY BELOW OVERVIEW AND RETAINS THE FULL CARRIER PROFILE. LINKED FRONTIER DATA LOADS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN THE COMMANDER JOURNAL IS DETECTED, WITH THE EXISTING CACHE AND REFRESH COOLDOWN. >>>!

ps.source: Flight-warning color and advice escalate at 2 g, 4 g, and 8 g. The panel hides when the body context is stale, while on foot, or while an external game panel has focus.
ps.translation: * FLIGHT-WARNING COLOR AND ADVICE ESCALATE AT 2 G, 4 G, AND 8 G. THE PANEL HIDES WHEN THE BODY CONTEXT IS STALE, WHILE ON FOOT, OR WHILE AN EXTERNAL GAME PANEL HAS FOCUS. >>>!

ps.source: Focus-on-start, focus-on-minimize, focus-after-jump, and minimize-to-tray are independent. Passive overlays remain click-through and do not activate the application window.
ps.translation: * FOCUS-ON-START, FOCUS-ON-MINIMIZE, FOCUS-AFTER-JUMP, AND MINIMIZE-TO-TRAY ARE INDEPENDENT. PASSIVE OVERLAYS REMAIN CLICK-THROUGH AND DO NOT ACTIVATE THE APPLICATION WINDOW. >>>!

ps.source: Focused the next Elite Dangerous window; overlays will follow it.
ps.translation: * FOCUSED THE NEXT ELITE DANGEROUS WINDOW; OVERLAYS WILL FOLLOW IT. >>>!

ps.source: Follow Ship for ship guidance. After disembarking, follow the Rhino chevron back to the parked vehicle.
ps.translation: * FOLLOW SHIP FOR SHIP GUIDANCE. AFTER DISEMBARKING, FOLLOW THE RHINO CHEVRON BACK TO THE PARKED VEHICLE. >>>!

ps.source: Follow communications, objectives, settlement routes, massacre progress, and optional developer-authored quest chapters.
ps.translation: * FOLLOW COMMUNICATIONS, OBJECTIVES, SETTLEMENT ROUTES, MASSACRE PROGRESS, AND OPTIONAL DEVELOPER-AUTHORED QUEST CHAPTERS. >>>!

ps.source: Follow the circular bearing display relative to ship heading. The attack-angle line helps judge descent toward the target.
ps.translation: * FOLLOW THE CIRCULAR BEARING DISPLAY RELATIVE TO SHIP HEADING. THE ATTACK-ANGLE LINE HELPS JUDGE DESCENT TOWARD THE TARGET. >>>!

ps.source: Font sizes apply to shared overlay text roles. Values use half-point increments and update open overlays when previewed or applied.
ps.translation: * FONT SIZES APPLY TO SHARED OVERLAY TEXT ROLES. VALUES USE HALF-POINT INCREMENTS AND UPDATE OPEN OVERLAYS WHEN PREVIEWED OR APPLIED. >>>!

ps.source: For Rig tracking and full command details click here
ps.translation: * FOR RIG TRACKING AND FULL COMMAND DETAILS CLICK HERE >>>!

ps.source: For an active sample, warning color inside the radius means you are too close; success color outside the radius means the next sample is valid.
ps.translation: * FOR AN ACTIVE SAMPLE, WARNING COLOR INSIDE THE RADIUS MEANS YOU ARE TOO CLOSE; SUCCESS COLOR OUTSIDE THE RADIUS MEANS THE NEXT SAMPLE IS VALID. >>>!

ps.source: For example the end system of the {0} boxel is: {1} so you would enter 7640 and choose APPLY
ps.translation: * FOR EXAMPLE THE END SYSTEM OF THE {0} BOXEL IS: {1} SO YOU WOULD ENTER 7640 AND CHOOSE APPLY >>>!

ps.source: Found 1 matching system. Review it before enabling.
ps.translation: * FOUND 1 MATCHING SYSTEM. REVIEW IT BEFORE ENABLING. >>>!

ps.source: Found {0} Green Gas Giant candidate(s); no candidate was published.
ps.translation: * FOUND {0} GREEN GAS GIANT CANDIDATE(S); NO CANDIDATE WAS PUBLISHED. >>>!

ps.source: Found {0} historical Green Gas Giant candidate(s). Publishing sends only the original matching Scan event, commander name, tag, and journal StarPos.
ps.translation: * FOUND {0} HISTORICAL GREEN GAS GIANT CANDIDATE(S). PUBLISHING SENDS ONLY THE ORIGINAL MATCHING SCAN EVENT, COMMANDER NAME, TAG, AND JOURNAL STARPOS. >>>!

ps.source: Found {0} legacy profile source(s). Import creates checksum-verified backups, preserves current-only files, records collisions, and activates the merged copy transactionally.
ps.translation: * FOUND {0} LEGACY PROFILE SOURCE(S). IMPORT CREATES CHECKSUM-VERIFIED BACKUPS, PRESERVES CURRENT-ONLY FILES, RECORDS COLLISIONS, AND ACTIVATES THE MERGED COPY TRANSACTIONALLY. >>>!

ps.source: Found {0} matches. Choose the center system.
ps.translation: * FOUND {0} MATCHES. CHOOSE THE CENTER SYSTEM. >>>!

ps.source: Fresh Market and Cargo events reconcile carrier and ship totals. Ambiguous multi-client cargo is excluded until a fresh unambiguous file write arrives.
ps.translation: * FRESH MARKET AND CARGO EVENTS RECONCILE CARRIER AND SHIP TOTALS. AMBIGUOUS MULTI-CLIENT CARGO IS EXCLUDED UNTIL A FRESH UNAMBIGUOUS FILE WRITE ARRIVES. >>>!

ps.source: From anywhere inside the saved border, face a deposit and add its marker, mineral amount, and density with .mine.
ps.translation: * FROM ANYWHERE INSIDE THE SAVED BORDER, FACE A DEPOSIT AND ADD ITS MARKER, MINERAL AMOUNT, AND DENSITY WITH .MINE. >>>!

ps.source: From anywhere inside the saved border, face a deposit and send .mine <heading> <commodity> <distance km> <low|medium|high>/<low|medium|high>. The bearing and distance start at your live position. A same-commodity marker within 100 m is declined as a likely duplicate. Example: .mine 15 ruby 1.24 high/medium.
ps.translation: * FROM ANYWHERE INSIDE THE SAVED BORDER, FACE A DEPOSIT AND SEND .MINE <HEADING> <COMMODITY> <DISTANCE KM> <LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH>/<LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH>. THE BEARING AND DISTANCE START AT YOUR LIVE POSITION. A SAME-COMMODITY MARKER WITHIN 100 M IS DECLINED AS A LIKELY DUPLICATE. EXAMPLE: .MINE 15 RUBY 1.24 HIGH/MEDIUM. >>>!

ps.source: From the true center, send .mining center here to correct the saved center and ring alignment without moving any deposit markers.
ps.translation: * FROM THE TRUE CENTER, SEND .MINING CENTER HERE TO CORRECT THE SAVED CENTER AND RING ALIGNMENT WITHOUT MOVING ANY DEPOSIT MARKERS. >>>!

ps.source: Frontier account access is unavailable during diagnostic replay.
ps.translation: * FRONTIER ACCOUNT ACCESS IS UNAVAILABLE DURING DIAGNOSTIC REPLAY. >>>!

ps.source: Frontier account linking is currently supported on Windows and Linux.
ps.translation: * FRONTIER ACCOUNT LINKING IS CURRENTLY SUPPORTED ON WINDOWS AND LINUX. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZATION EXPIRED OR WAS REVOKED. CONNECT YOUR ACCOUNT AGAIN. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZATION EXPIRED. UNLINK AND RECONNECT YOUR ACCOUNT. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZATION STORAGE HAS NO PARENT DIRECTORY. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZATION TIMED OUT. PLEASE TRY AGAIN. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZATION WAS CANCELLED OR REPLACED. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER AUTHORIZED {0}, BUT THE ACTIVE JOURNAL BELONGS TO {1}. NO AUTHORIZATION WAS ATTACHED TO THE ACTIVE COMMANDER. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER CALLBACK COMPLETED WITHOUT A RUNNING APPLICATION WINDOW TO RESTORE. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER CALLBACK RESTORED THE RUNNING APPLICATION. >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER COMMUNITY-GOAL DATA COULD NOT BE READ: {0} >>>!

ps.translation: * FRONTIER COULD NOT COMPLETE THE TOKEN EXCHANGE. PLEASE CONNECT AGAIN. >>>!

ps.source: Frontier credential lock has no parent directory.
ps.translation: * FRONTIER CREDENTIAL LOCK HAS NO PARENT DIRECTORY. >>>!

ps.source: Frontier fleet-carrier data could not be read: {0}
ps.translation: * FRONTIER FLEET-CARRIER DATA COULD NOT BE READ: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Only this system constrains rings and nearby markets to the reference system. Reinforce/Undermine plans keep mining and selling in the same system; acquisition plans retain the selected selling destination even when the ring is elsewhere. Ordinary ring-to-market searches compare nearby destinations. Clear Powerplay plan ends that destination link. Galaxy-wide prices deliberately ignore that location restriction.
ps.translation: * ONLY THIS SYSTEM CONSTRAINS RINGS AND NEARBY MARKETS TO THE REFERENCE SYSTEM. REINFORCE/UNDERMINE PLANS KEEP MINING AND SELLING IN THE SAME SYSTEM; ACQUISITION PLANS RETAIN THE SELECTED SELLING DESTINATION EVEN WHEN THE RING IS ELSEWHERE. ORDINARY RING-TO-MARKET SEARCHES COMPARE NEARBY DESTINATIONS. CLEAR POWERPLAY PLAN ENDS THAT DESTINATION LINK. GALAXY-WIDE PRICES DELIBERATELY IGNORE THAT LOCATION RESTRICTION. >>>!
