ps.source: Replayed {0} into the active quest runtime.
ps.translation: * REPLAYED {0} INTO THE ACTIVE QUEST RUNTIME. >>>!

ps.source: Report exported. Open the HTML report in a browser to print or save as PDF.
ps.translation: * REPORT EXPORTED. OPEN THE HTML REPORT IN A BROWSER TO PRINT OR SAVE AS PDF. >>>!

ps.source: Report removed. Undo remains available until the next deletion or restart.
ps.translation: * REPORT REMOVED. UNDO REMAINS AVAILABLE UNTIL THE NEXT DELETION OR RESTART. >>>!

ps.source: Reports preserve the observations behind mining statistics.
ps.translation: * REPORTS PRESERVE THE OBSERVATIONS BEHIND MINING STATISTICS. >>>!

ps.source: Require FSS to report all bodies before completion
ps.translation: * REQUIRE FSS TO REPORT ALL BODIES BEFORE COMPLETION >>>!

ps.source: Requires FSSAllBodiesFound for new local visits. Enabled earlier-visit and older-Spansh completion rules still apply.
ps.translation: * REQUIRES FSSALLBODIESFOUND FOR NEW LOCAL VISITS. ENABLED EARLIER-VISIT AND OLDER-SPANSH COMPLETION RULES STILL APPLY. >>>!

ps.source: Requires proper technique; hard impacts common
ps.translation: * REQUIRES PROPER TECHNIQUE; HARD IMPACTS COMMON >>>!

ps.source: Reset cancelled; totals were not changed.
ps.translation: * RESET CANCELLED; TOTALS WERE NOT CHANGED. >>>!

ps.source: Reset the captured VR headset orientation.
ps.translation: * RESET THE CAPTURED VR HEADSET ORIENTATION. >>>!

ps.source: Resolve bodies in FSS; undiscovered bodies carry a flag and completed system scans carry a completion check.
ps.translation: * RESOLVE BODIES IN FSS; UNDISCOVERED BODIES CARRY A FLAG AND COMPLETED SYSTEM SCANS CARRY A COMPLETION CHECK. >>>!

ps.source: Resolve conflicts, review the final patch, then confirm publication separately.
ps.translation: * RESOLVE CONFLICTS, REVIEW THE FINAL PATCH, THEN CONFIRM PUBLICATION SEPARATELY. >>>!

ps.source: Resolved the imported commander preference to {0} ({1}) and saved its stable identity.{2}
ps.translation: * RESOLVED THE IMPORTED COMMANDER PREFERENCE TO {0} ({1}) AND SAVED ITS STABLE IDENTITY.{2} >>>!

ps.source: Resolved the imported commander preference to {0} ({1}), but could not persist the stable identity: {2}
ps.translation: * RESOLVED THE IMPORTED COMMANDER PREFERENCE TO {0} ({1}), BUT COULD NOT PERSIST THE STABLE IDENTITY: {2} >>>!

ps.source: Response sent to the quest script.
ps.translation: * RESPONSE SENT TO THE QUEST SCRIPT. >>>!

ps.source: Restart SrvSurvey to apply the selected language.
ps.translation: * RESTART SRVSURVEY TO APPLY THE SELECTED LANGUAGE. >>>!

ps.source: Restart SrvSurvey to load the migrated profile.
ps.translation: * RESTART SRVSURVEY TO LOAD THE MIGRATED PROFILE. >>>!

ps.source: Restore mining backup (ZIP or JSON; previous data retained)
ps.translation: * RESTORE MINING BACKUP (ZIP OR JSON; PREVIOUS DATA RETAINED) >>>!

ps.source: Restored the last saved surface coordinates.
ps.translation: * RESTORED THE LAST SAVED SURFACE COORDINATES. >>>!

ps.source: Restrict each overlay category to selected ships or vehicles without changing its normal triggers.
ps.translation: * RESTRICT EACH OVERLAY CATEGORY TO SELECTED SHIPS OR VEHICLES WITHOUT CHANGING ITS NORMAL TRIGGERS. >>>!

ps.source: Resume an older search or organize searches you want to revisit.
ps.translation: * RESUME AN OLDER SEARCH OR ORGANIZE SEARCHES YOU WANT TO REVISIT. >>>!

ps.source: Return a completed or empty system to the active survey.
ps.translation: * RETURN A COMPLETED OR EMPTY SYSTEM TO THE ACTIVE SURVEY. >>>!

ps.source: Return one level toward the search root
ps.translation: * RETURN ONE LEVEL TOWARD THE SEARCH ROOT >>>!

ps.source: Return to the same dialog to disable sharing; pending local messages are removed when consent is withdrawn.
ps.translation: * RETURN TO THE SAME DIALOG TO DISABLE SHARING; PENDING LOCAL MESSAGES ARE REMOVED WHEN CONSENT IS WITHDRAWN. >>>!

ps.source: Review body type, estimated scan/DSS value, biological and geological signals, terraformable status, and landability.
ps.translation: * REVIEW BODY TYPE, ESTIMATED SCAN/DSS VALUE, BIOLOGICAL AND GEOLOGICAL SIGNALS, TERRAFORMABLE STATUS, AND LANDABILITY. >>>!

ps.source: Review found {0} concurrent conflict(s). Reload and reapply those edits before publishing.
ps.translation: * REVIEW FOUND {0} CONCURRENT CONFLICT(S). RELOAD AND REAPPLY THOSE EDITS BEFORE PUBLISHING. >>>!

ps.source: Review passed, but a saved Raven API key is required before publishing.
ps.translation: * REVIEW PASSED, BUT A SAVED RAVEN API KEY IS REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLISHING. >>>!

ps.source: Review passed. Confirm once more to publish these Raven site changes.
ps.translation: * REVIEW PASSED. CONFIRM ONCE MORE TO PUBLISH THESE RAVEN SITE CHANGES. >>>!

ps.source: Review the commander, system, and target path, then select Confirm swap.
ps.translation: * REVIEW THE COMMANDER, SYSTEM, AND TARGET PATH, THEN SELECT CONFIRM SWAP. >>>!

ps.source: Review the data, Commander identity, retry storage, multi-client pause, and duplicate-uploader warning before changing this global setting.
ps.translation: * REVIEW THE DATA, COMMANDER IDENTITY, RETRY STORAGE, MULTI-CLIENT PAUSE, AND DUPLICATE-UPLOADER WARNING BEFORE CHANGING THIS GLOBAL SETTING. >>>!

ps.source: Review the detected Commander and destination, then choose Back up, verify, and import.
ps.translation: * REVIEW THE DETECTED COMMANDER AND DESTINATION, THEN CHOOSE BACK UP, VERIFY, AND IMPORT. >>>!

ps.source: Review the included sites and output path, then copy the bundle path or file, open its folder, or open the Guardian Science Corps destination.
ps.translation: * REVIEW THE INCLUDED SITES AND OUTPUT PATH, THEN COPY THE BUNDLE PATH OR FILE, OPEN ITS FOLDER, OR OPEN THE GUARDIAN SCIENCE CORPS DESTINATION. >>>!

ps.source: Review the marker name, type, angle, distance, rotation, status, relic heading, and component materials. Reference values are shown in the same controls but remain disabled.
ps.translation: * REVIEW THE MARKER NAME, TYPE, ANGLE, DISTANCE, ROTATION, STATUS, RELIC HEADING, AND COMPONENT MATERIALS. REFERENCE VALUES ARE SHOWN IN THE SAME CONTROLS BUT REMAIN DISABLED. >>>!

ps.source: Review the summary, then confirm to publish this project.
ps.translation: * REVIEW THE SUMMARY, THEN CONFIRM TO PUBLISH THIS PROJECT. >>>!

ps.source: Review the system, body, construction market, build type, layout, architect, and notes before confirming publication.
ps.translation: * REVIEW THE SYSTEM, BODY, CONSTRUCTION MARKET, BUILD TYPE, LAYOUT, ARCHITECT, AND NOTES BEFORE CONFIRMING PUBLICATION. >>>!

ps.source: Review the target and select Confirm restore. The verified backup will be retained.
ps.translation: * REVIEW THE TARGET AND SELECT CONFIRM RESTORE. THE VERIFIED BACKUP WILL BE RETAINED. >>>!

ps.source: Review what SrvSurvey sends before opting in.
ps.translation: * REVIEW WHAT SRVSURVEY SENDS BEFORE OPTING IN. >>>!

ps.source: Review, copy, and open this application's diagnostic logs.
ps.translation: * REVIEW, COPY, AND OPEN THIS APPLICATION'S DIAGNOSTIC LOGS. >>>!

ps.source: Reward bands changed for this session but could not be saved: {0}
ps.translation: * REWARD BANDS CHANGED FOR THIS SESSION BUT COULD NOT BE SAVED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Rewards, first-footfall multipliers, sale removal, death rollback, active samples, exact predictions, the biology browser, Codex Bingo, prior-scan guidance, and surface radar trackers use the WinForms contracts. Canonn prior rings draw on the surface radar when that setting is enabled.
ps.translation: * REWARDS, FIRST-FOOTFALL MULTIPLIERS, SALE REMOVAL, DEATH ROLLBACK, ACTIVE SAMPLES, EXACT PREDICTIONS, THE BIOLOGY BROWSER, CODEX BINGO, PRIOR-SCAN GUIDANCE, AND SURFACE RADAR TRACKERS USE THE WINFORMS CONTRACTS. CANONN PRIOR RINGS DRAW ON THE SURFACE RADAR WHEN THAT SETTING IS ENABLED. >>>!

ps.source: Rhino moving — tracker changes paused until position and heading are steady for one second.
ps.translation: * RHINO MOVING — TRACKER CHANGES PAUSED UNTIL POSITION AND HEADING ARE STEADY FOR ONE SECOND. >>>!

ps.source: Rig bars set trackers immediately; three seconds empty clears them.
ps.translation: * RIG BARS SET TRACKERS IMMEDIATELY; THREE SECONDS EMPTY CLEARS THEM. >>>!

ps.source: Rig location could not be saved: {0}
ps.translation: * RIG LOCATION COULD NOT BE SAVED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Rig locations are saved for this commander and body.
ps.translation: * RIG LOCATIONS ARE SAVED FOR THIS COMMANDER AND BODY. >>>!

ps.source: Rig locations cleared after returning to your ship.
ps.translation: * RIG LOCATIONS CLEARED AFTER RETURNING TO YOUR SHIP. >>>!

ps.source: Rig locations cleared by the --- chat command.
ps.translation: * RIG LOCATIONS CLEARED BY THE --- CHAT COMMAND. >>>!

ps.source: Rig locations could not be cleared: {0}
ps.translation: * RIG LOCATIONS COULD NOT BE CLEARED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Rig locations · cyan: collect · red: too close to deploy
ps.translation: * RIG LOCATIONS · CYAN: COLLECT · RED: TOO CLOSE TO DEPLOY >>>!

ps.source: Rig trackers could not be updated: {0}
ps.translation: * RIG TRACKERS COULD NOT BE UPDATED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Rig trackers updated from the Rhino HUD.
ps.translation: * RIG TRACKERS UPDATED FROM THE RHINO HUD. >>>!

ps.source: Right Click Panels to edit individual Opacity/Scale
ps.translation: * RIGHT CLICK PANELS TO EDIT INDIVIDUAL OPACITY/SCALE >>>!

ps.source: Right-click a ring to bookmark it, save the online observation locally, copy the system or open a reference site. Historical journal import adds this commander's rings and missions without starting sessions.
ps.translation: * RIGHT-CLICK A RING TO BOOKMARK IT, SAVE THE ONLINE OBSERVATION LOCALLY, COPY THE SYSTEM OR OPEN A REFERENCE SITE. HISTORICAL JOURNAL IMPORT ADDS THIS COMMANDER'S RINGS AND MISSIONS WITHOUT STARTING SESSIONS. >>>!

ps.source: Right-click another preview to edit that pane. The toolbar checkmark saves every change and closes the editor.
ps.translation: * RIGHT-CLICK ANOTHER PREVIEW TO EDIT THAT PANE. THE TOOLBAR CHECKMARK SAVES EVERY CHANGE AND CLOSES THE EDITOR. >>>!

ps.source: Ring saved to your local discoveries.
ps.translation: * RING SAVED TO YOUR LOCAL DISCOVERIES. >>>!

ps.source: Rollback candidate verified; starting external helper...
ps.translation: * ROLLBACK CANDIDATE VERIFIED; STARTING EXTERNAL HELPER... >>>!

ps.source: Rotate Alpha site screenshots by 90° and truncate.
ps.translation: * ROTATE ALPHA SITE SCREENSHOTS BY 90° AND TRUNCATE. >>>!

ps.source: Rotate outlines and bar guides clockwise by 2 degrees
ps.translation: * ROTATE OUTLINES AND BAR GUIDES CLOCKWISE BY 2 DEGREES >>>!

ps.source: Rotate outlines and bar guides counterclockwise by 2 degrees
ps.translation: * ROTATE OUTLINES AND BAR GUIDES COUNTERCLOCKWISE BY 2 DEGREES >>>!

ps.source: Route Manager, FC Routes, and Boxel auto-copy are mutually exclusive.
ps.translation: * ROUTE MANAGER, FC ROUTES, AND BOXEL AUTO-COPY ARE MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE. >>>!

ps.source: Route overlays keep destination and next-hop information visible while the Galaxy Map or route is active.
ps.translation: * ROUTE OVERLAYS KEEP DESTINATION AND NEXT-HOP INFORMATION VISIBLE WHILE THE GALAXY MAP OR ROUTE IS ACTIVE. >>>!

ps.source: Route progress could not be saved: {0}
ps.translation: * ROUTE PROGRESS COULD NOT BE SAVED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Route progress reset in the draft. Save Changes to keep it.
ps.translation: * ROUTE PROGRESS RESET IN THE DRAFT. SAVE CHANGES TO KEEP IT. >>>!

ps.source: Route progress saved in a paused state.
ps.translation: * ROUTE PROGRESS SAVED IN A PAUSED STATE. >>>!

ps.source: Route tracking deactivated. The saved route and its progress were preserved.
ps.translation: * ROUTE TRACKING DEACTIVATED. THE SAVED ROUTE AND ITS PROGRESS WERE PRESERVED. >>>!

ps.source: SDL controller discovery is unavailable on this platform.
ps.translation: * SDL CONTROLLER DISCOVERY IS UNAVAILABLE ON THIS PLATFORM. >>>!

ps.source: SDL controller input could not start: {0}
ps.translation: * SDL CONTROLLER INPUT COULD NOT START: {0} >>>!

ps.source: SDL supports standard gamepads, joysticks, and HOTAS devices. Select a device, enable it, then click a shortcut field and press controller buttons to assign them. Input is accepted while SrvSurvey or Elite Dangerous has focus.
ps.translation: * SDL SUPPORTS STANDARD GAMEPADS, JOYSTICKS, AND HOTAS DEVICES. SELECT A DEVICE, ENABLE IT, THEN CLICK A SHORTCUT FIELD AND PRESS CONTROLLER BUTTONS TO ASSIGN THEM. INPUT IS ACCEPTED WHILE SRVSURVEY OR ELITE DANGEROUS HAS FOCUS. >>>!

ps.source: SIMULATED GAME STATE • DRAG TO MOVE • RIGHT-CLICK FOR OPACITY / SCALE
ps.translation: * SIMULATED GAME STATE • DRAG TO MOVE • RIGHT-CLICK FOR OPACITY / SCALE >>>!

ps.source: Save Ruins aerial screenshots into site-type sub-folders
ps.translation: * SAVE RUINS AERIAL SCREENSHOTS INTO SITE-TYPE SUB-FOLDERS >>>!

ps.source: Save a Raven API key before Fleet Carrier cargo can sync.
ps.translation: * SAVE A RAVEN API KEY BEFORE FLEET CARRIER CARGO CAN SYNC. >>>!

ps.source: Save a Raven API key before publishing a Fleet Carrier.
ps.translation: * SAVE A RAVEN API KEY BEFORE PUBLISHING A FLEET CARRIER. >>>!

ps.source: Save a Raven API key before ship cargo can publish.
ps.translation: * SAVE A RAVEN API KEY BEFORE SHIP CARGO CAN PUBLISH. >>>!

ps.source: Save a Raven API key before syncing Fleet Carrier cargo.
ps.translation: * SAVE A RAVEN API KEY BEFORE SYNCING FLEET CARRIER CARGO. >>>!

ps.source: Save a diagnostic capture when the tuning panel cannot be found
ps.translation: * SAVE A DIAGNOSTIC CAPTURE WHEN THE TUNING PANEL CANNOT BE FOUND >>>!

ps.source: Save a named overlay state when its palette and typography are ready; choose saved states from the dropdown or reload the original defaults.
ps.translation: * SAVE A NAMED OVERLAY STATE WHEN ITS PALETTE AND TYPOGRAPHY ARE READY; CHOOSE SAVED STATES FROM THE DROPDOWN OR RELOAD THE ORIGINAL DEFAULTS. >>>!

ps.source: Save a surface mining location's center and map its deposits with case-insensitive chat commands.
ps.translation: * SAVE A SURFACE MINING LOCATION'S CENTER AND MAP ITS DEPOSITS WITH CASE-INSENSITIVE CHAT COMMANDS. >>>!

ps.source: Save also remembers your search filters.
ps.translation: * SAVE ALSO REMEMBERS YOUR SEARCH FILTERS. >>>!

ps.source: Save mining settings to persist search filters and preferences for this commander.
ps.translation: * SAVE MINING SETTINGS TO PERSIST SEARCH FILTERS AND PREFERENCES FOR THIS COMMANDER. >>>!

ps.source: Save or select a bookmark before attaching screenshots.
ps.translation: * SAVE OR SELECT A BOOKMARK BEFORE ATTACHING SCREENSHOTS. >>>!

ps.source: Save or undo the current Route Workspace changes before activating another route.
ps.translation: * SAVE OR UNDO THE CURRENT ROUTE WORKSPACE CHANGES BEFORE ACTIVATING ANOTHER ROUTE. >>>!

ps.source: Save or undo the current Route Workspace changes before changing next-hop auto-copy here.
ps.translation: * SAVE OR UNDO THE CURRENT ROUTE WORKSPACE CHANGES BEFORE CHANGING NEXT-HOP AUTO-COPY HERE. >>>!

ps.source: Save or undo the current Route Workspace definition and note changes before deactivating it.
ps.translation: * SAVE OR UNDO THE CURRENT ROUTE WORKSPACE DEFINITION AND NOTE CHANGES BEFORE DEACTIVATING IT. >>>!

ps.source: Save overlay positions, opacity, and scale
ps.translation: * SAVE OVERLAY POSITIONS, OPACITY, AND SCALE >>>!

ps.source: Save survey to persist the Commander record after reviewing notes, groups, obelisks, and survey points.
ps.translation: * SAVE SURVEY TO PERSIST THE COMMANDER RECORD AFTER REVIEWING NOTES, GROUPS, OBELISKS, AND SURVEY POINTS. >>>!

ps.source: Save systems and mining rings in your own categories.
ps.translation: * SAVE SYSTEMS AND MINING RINGS IN YOUR OWN CATEGORIES. >>>!

ps.source: Save, resume, and audit a boxel project
ps.translation: * SAVE, RESUME, AND AUDIT A BOXEL PROJECT >>>!

ps.source: Saved '{0}', but the Guardian aerial copy failed; the original BMP was retained: {1}
ps.translation: * SAVED '{0}', BUT THE GUARDIAN AERIAL COPY FAILED; THE ORIGINAL BMP WAS RETAINED: {1} >>>!

ps.source: Saved '{0}', but the original BMP could not be removed: {1}
ps.translation: * SAVED '{0}', BUT THE ORIGINAL BMP COULD NOT BE REMOVED: {1} >>>!

ps.source: Saved development state could not be reloaded: {0}
ps.translation: * SAVED DEVELOPMENT STATE COULD NOT BE RELOADED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Saved in the legacy-compatible system data file.
ps.translation: * SAVED IN THE LEGACY-COMPATIBLE SYSTEM DATA FILE. >>>!

ps.source: Saved one completed dock-to-dock trip to {0}.
ps.translation: * SAVED ONE COMPLETED DOCK-TO-DOCK TRIP TO {0}. >>>!

ps.source: Saved overlay theme state '{0}' was not found.
ps.translation: * SAVED OVERLAY THEME STATE '{0}' WAS NOT FOUND. >>>!

ps.source: Saved surface mining locations and deposit maps
ps.translation: * SAVED SURFACE MINING LOCATIONS AND DEPOSIT MAPS >>>!

ps.source: Saved {0} completed trip(s), then stopped without appending the remaining row(s): {1}
ps.translation: * SAVED {0} COMPLETED TRIP(S), THEN STOPPED WITHOUT APPENDING THE REMAINING ROW(S): {1} >>>!

ps.source: Saved {0} live overlay position(s) and restored click-through mode.{1}
ps.translation: * SAVED {0} LIVE OVERLAY POSITION(S) AND RESTORED CLICK-THROUGH MODE.{1} >>>!

ps.source: Saved {0} overlay position/opacity override(s), including scale settings{1}{2}{3}
ps.translation: * SAVED {0} OVERLAY POSITION/OPACITY OVERRIDE(S), INCLUDING SCALE SETTINGS{1}{2}{3} >>>!

ps.source: Saved {0} overlay setting(s). Visible overlays update immediately.{1}
ps.translation: * SAVED {0} OVERLAY SETTING(S). VISIBLE OVERLAYS UPDATE IMMEDIATELY.{1} >>>!

ps.source: Saving a personal API key enables direct EDSM account synchronization for the active Commander. SrvSurvey sends the current Commander name shown here, which must match the Commander registered with EDSM. This is separate from EDDN sharing and does not enable EDDN.
ps.translation: * SAVING A PERSONAL API KEY ENABLES DIRECT EDSM ACCOUNT SYNCHRONIZATION FOR THE ACTIVE COMMANDER. SRVSURVEY SENDS THE CURRENT COMMANDER NAME SHOWN HERE, WHICH MUST MATCH THE COMMANDER REGISTERED WITH EDSM. THIS IS SEPARATE FROM EDDN SHARING AND DOES NOT ENABLE EDDN. >>>!

ps.source: Saving a personal API key enables supported Inara uploads only for the commander shown. Removing that key disables uploads for that commander.
ps.translation: * SAVING A PERSONAL API KEY ENABLES SUPPORTED INARA UPLOADS ONLY FOR THE COMMANDER SHOWN. REMOVING THAT KEY DISABLES UPLOADS FOR THAT COMMANDER. >>>!

ps.source: Saving project visibility to Raven Colonial...
ps.translation: * SAVING PROJECT VISIBILITY TO RAVEN COLONIAL... >>>!

ps.source: Scales the complete application interface. Oversized choices are reduced only as needed to fit the active monitor.
ps.translation: * SCALES THE COMPLETE APPLICATION INTERFACE. OVERSIZED CHOICES ARE REDUCED ONLY AS NEEDED TO FIT THE ACTIVE MONITOR. >>>!

ps.source: Scan a body in the FSS to populate this list.
ps.translation: * SCAN A BODY IN THE FSS TO POPULATE THIS LIST. >>>!

ps.source: Scan a system with biological signals to begin.
ps.translation: * SCAN A SYSTEM WITH BIOLOGICAL SIGNALS TO BEGIN. >>>!

ps.source: Scan the first specimen with the Genetic Sampler.
ps.translation: * SCAN THE FIRST SPECIMEN WITH THE GENETIC SAMPLER. >>>!

ps.source: Scanned {0} journal(s) and {1} Codex event(s); merged {2} earlier global/regional first(s).{3}{4}
ps.translation: * SCANNED {0} JOURNAL(S) AND {1} CODEX EVENT(S); MERGED {2} EARLIER GLOBAL/REGIONAL FIRST(S).{3}{4} >>>!

ps.source: Scanned {0} journals and {1} Codex events; added {2} global/regional firsts.{3}{4}
ps.translation: * SCANNED {0} JOURNALS AND {1} CODEX EVENTS; ADDED {2} GLOBAL/REGIONAL FIRSTS.{3}{4} >>>!

ps.source: Scanning historical journals without changing profile data...
ps.translation: * SCANNING HISTORICAL JOURNALS WITHOUT CHANGING PROFILE DATA... >>>!

ps.source: Scanning, approaching, or docking can infer system/site data locally, but none of those actions alone publishes the system record.
ps.translation: * SCANNING, APPROACHING, OR DOCKING CAN INFER SYSTEM/SITE DATA LOCALLY, BUT NONE OF THOSE ACTIONS ALONE PUBLISHES THE SYSTEM RECORD. >>>!

ps.source: Scans add local rings and hotspots. Shared Mining bookmarks add your overlap, RES and rating notes.
ps.translation: * SCANS ADD LOCAL RINGS AND HOTSPOTS. SHARED MINING BOOKMARKS ADD YOUR OVERLAP, RES AND RATING NOTES. >>>!

ps.source: Screenshot conversion has its own source, destination, naming, banner, and image-embedding controls. High-resolution naming is determined from the Elite game client dimensions rather than whichever desktop happens to be primary.
ps.translation: * SCREENSHOT CONVERSION HAS ITS OWN SOURCE, DESTINATION, NAMING, BANNER, AND IMAGE-EMBEDDING CONTROLS. HIGH-RESOLUTION NAMING IS DETERMINED FROM THE ELITE GAME CLIENT DIMENSIONS RATHER THAN WHICHEVER DESKTOP HAPPENS TO BE PRIMARY. >>>!

ps.source: Screenshot file processing is unavailable during diagnostic replay.
ps.translation: * SCREENSHOT FILE PROCESSING IS UNAVAILABLE DURING DIAGNOSTIC REPLAY. >>>!

ps.source: Screenshot processing can convert new images, organize them, and embed useful site data without changing old captures.
ps.translation: * SCREENSHOT PROCESSING CAN CONVERT NEW IMAGES, ORGANIZE THEM, AND EMBED USEFUL SITE DATA WITHOUT CHANGING OLD CAPTURES. >>>!

ps.source: Search event, commander, system, file, or JSON
ps.translation: * SEARCH EVENT, COMMANDER, SYSTEM, FILE, OR JSON >>>!

ps.source: Search for a previously visited system.
ps.translation: * SEARCH FOR A PREVIOUSLY VISITED SYSTEM. >>>!

ps.source: Search guides, settings, symbols, or workflows
ps.translation: * SEARCH GUIDES, SETTINGS, SYMBOLS, OR WORKFLOWS >>>!

ps.source: Search procedural boxels, track every generated system, and choose what counts as complete.
ps.translation: * SEARCH PROCEDURAL BOXELS, TRACK EVERY GENERATED SYSTEM, AND CHOOSE WHAT COUNTS AS COMPLETE. >>>!

ps.source: Search the durable game journal record and export a bounded diagnostic replay package.
ps.translation: * SEARCH THE DURABLE GAME JOURNAL RECORD AND EXPORT A BOUNDED DIAGNOSTIC REPLAY PACKAGE. >>>!

ps.source: Search−/Search+ adjust the movement search allowance in pixels. The readout and optional Search bounds outline show its extent; this does not move or rotate the guides. Keep the search area inside the capture frame. After changing size, height, rotation or alignment, select Test again. No label learning is required.
ps.translation: * SEARCH−/SEARCH+ ADJUST THE MOVEMENT SEARCH ALLOWANCE IN PIXELS. THE READOUT AND OPTIONAL SEARCH BOUNDS OUTLINE SHOW ITS EXTENT; THIS DOES NOT MOVE OR ROTATE THE GUIDES. KEEP THE SEARCH AREA INSIDE THE CAPTURE FRAME. AFTER CHANGING SIZE, HEIGHT, ROTATION OR ALIGNMENT, SELECT TEST AGAIN. NO LABEL LEARNING IS REQUIRED. >>>!

ps.source: Secure Frontier account storage is currently supported on Windows and Linux.
ps.translation: * SECURE FRONTIER ACCOUNT STORAGE IS CURRENTLY SUPPORTED ON WINDOWS AND LINUX. >>>!

ps.source: Secure Frontier token storage is unavailable. Install the 'secret-tool' utility and unlock a Secret Service compatible keyring, then try again.
ps.translation: * SECURE FRONTIER TOKEN STORAGE IS UNAVAILABLE. INSTALL THE 'SECRET-TOOL' UTILITY AND UNLOCK A SECRET SERVICE COMPATIBLE KEYRING, THEN TRY AGAIN. >>>!

ps.source: See your path from the search root, move between boxels at the same level, or open a smaller child boxel. This does not move between systems in the table.
ps.translation: * SEE YOUR PATH FROM THE SEARCH ROOT, MOVE BETWEEN BOXELS AT THE SAME LEVEL, OR OPEN A SMALLER CHILD BOXEL. THIS DOES NOT MOVE BETWEEN SYSTEMS IN THE TABLE. >>>!

ps.source: Select Configure sharing, review the journal and companion-file data SrvSurvey can send, then enable live-session sharing and save.
ps.translation: * SELECT CONFIGURE SHARING, REVIEW THE JOURNAL AND COMPANION-FILE DATA SRVSURVEY CAN SEND, THEN ENABLE LIVE-SESSION SHARING AND SAVE. >>>!

ps.source: Select Confirm clear to remove all unclaimed organic rewards. Active sample progress will be kept.
ps.translation: * SELECT CONFIRM CLEAR TO REMOVE ALL UNCLAIMED ORGANIC REWARDS. ACTIVE SAMPLE PROGRESS WILL BE KEPT. >>>!

ps.source: Select Confirm removal to remove local development progress. The state file is backed up first.
ps.translation: * SELECT CONFIRM REMOVAL TO REMOVE LOCAL DEVELOPMENT PROGRESS. THE STATE FILE IS BACKED UP FIRST. >>>!

ps.source: Select Confirm reset to clear all six exploration totals.
ps.translation: * SELECT CONFIRM RESET TO CLEAR ALL SIX EXPLORATION TOTALS. >>>!

ps.source: Select Disable and confirm to remove the API key and cancel pending delivery for that Commander. Switching Commanders loads that profile's separate EDSM state.
ps.translation: * SELECT DISABLE AND CONFIRM TO REMOVE THE API KEY AND CANCEL PENDING DELIVERY FOR THAT COMMANDER. SWITCHING COMMANDERS LOADS THAT PROFILE'S SEPARATE EDSM STATE. >>>!

ps.source: Select Open Library to browse saved searches by favorite, name, creation date, last modified date, completion, and notes. Resume Selected restores its tree, options, and completed systems.
ps.translation: * SELECT OPEN LIBRARY TO BROWSE SAVED SEARCHES BY FAVORITE, NAME, CREATION DATE, LAST MODIFIED DATE, COMPLETION, AND NOTES. RESUME SELECTED RESTORES ITS TREE, OPTIONS, AND COMPLETED SYSTEMS. >>>!

ps.source: Select Refresh to scan commander profiles and the game state.
ps.translation: * SELECT REFRESH TO SCAN COMMANDER PROFILES AND THE GAME STATE. >>>!

ps.source: Select Save to Library. The first save asks for a name and notes, preloading the top system as the name. Progress then syncs to that library entry automatically.
ps.translation: * SELECT SAVE TO LIBRARY. THE FIRST SAVE ASKS FOR A NAME AND NOTES, PRELOADING THE TOP SYSTEM AS THE NAME. PROGRESS THEN SYNCS TO THAT LIBRARY ENTRY AUTOMATICALLY. >>>!

ps.source: Select Start search. SrvSurvey opens the top boxel, merges local Commander history with available Spansh observations, and chooses the lowest incomplete suffix.
ps.translation: * SELECT START SEARCH. SRVSURVEY OPENS THE TOP BOXEL, MERGES LOCAL COMMANDER HISTORY WITH AVAILABLE SPANSH OBSERVATIONS, AND CHOOSES THE LOWEST INCOMPLETE SUFFIX. >>>!

ps.translation: * SELECT A CODEX CATEGORY OR ENTRY >>>!

ps.source: Select a commander and confirm the all-history Codex merge first.
ps.translation: * SELECT A COMMANDER AND CONFIRM THE ALL-HISTORY CODEX MERGE FIRST. >>>!

ps.translation: * SELECT A COMMANDER AND CONFIRM THE VERIFIED HISTORICAL SYSTEM REBUILD FIRST. >>>!

ps.source: Select a completed session for notes, screenshots and exports. HTML reports work offline and can be printed or saved as PDF. Imported CSV summaries retain their original fields.

ps.source: Select a completed session to edit notes or attach screenshots. Export HTML for graphs, material breakdowns and the prospecting timeline; open it in a browser to print or save as PDF.
ps.translation: * SELECT A COMPLETED SESSION TO EDIT NOTES OR ATTACH SCREENSHOTS. EXPORT HTML FOR GRAPHS, MATERIAL BREAKDOWNS AND THE PROSPECTING TIMELINE; OPEN IT IN A BROWSER TO PRINT OR SAVE AS PDF. >>>!

ps.source: Select a controller before enabling controller input.
ps.translation: * SELECT A CONTROLLER BEFORE ENABLING CONTROLLER INPUT. >>>!

ps.source: Select a mapped Guardian ruins or structure survey to author its master template.
ps.translation: * SELECT A MAPPED GUARDIAN RUINS OR STRUCTURE SURVEY TO AUTHOR ITS MASTER TEMPLATE. >>>!

ps.source: Select a row to copy it or inspect it on Canonn and Spansh.

ps.source: Select a saved configuration to remove.
ps.translation: * SELECT A SAVED CONFIGURATION TO REMOVE. >>>!

ps.source: Select a system and choose Find rings in selected system. This switches to Rings and searches that exact system. Adjust mineral and ring type as needed. For acquisition, uncheck Only this system to compare surrounding rings; the chosen acquisition destination is retained separately. Select a ring and choose Selling stations to open Markets → Sell mined cargo. The plan context shows the mining origin and Powerplay destination.
ps.translation: * SELECT A SYSTEM AND CHOOSE FIND RINGS IN SELECTED SYSTEM. THIS SWITCHES TO RINGS AND SEARCHES THAT EXACT SYSTEM. ADJUST MINERAL AND RING TYPE AS NEEDED. FOR ACQUISITION, UNCHECK ONLY THIS SYSTEM TO COMPARE SURROUNDING RINGS; THE CHOSEN ACQUISITION DESTINATION IS RETAINED SEPARATELY. SELECT A RING AND CHOOSE SELLING STATIONS TO OPEN MARKETS → SELL MINED CARGO. THE PLAN CONTEXT SHOWS THE MINING ORIGIN AND POWERPLAY DESTINATION. >>>!

ps.source: Select a system from the search results.
ps.translation: * SELECT A SYSTEM FROM THE SEARCH RESULTS. >>>!

ps.translation: * SELECT AN EVENT AND CONFIRM THAT REPLAY MAY CHANGE ACTIVE QUEST PROGRESS. >>>!

ps.source: Select an organism to begin sampling.

ps.source: Select folder containing quest definition files
ps.translation: * SELECT FOLDER CONTAINING QUEST DEFINITION FILES >>>!

ps.source: Select the Active Commander card to open the current Frontier profile. Overview remains at the top of the sidebar.
ps.translation: * SELECT THE ACTIVE COMMANDER CARD TO OPEN THE CURRENT FRONTIER PROFILE. OVERVIEW REMAINS AT THE TOP OF THE SIDEBAR. >>>!

ps.translation: * SELECT THE RUINS LAYOUT WITH THE ACTIVE FIRE GROUP, THEN USE THE CONFIGURED CONFIRMATION CONTROL TWICE. >>>!

ps.translation: * SELECT TO OPEN THIS SURVEY MAP >>>!

ps.translation: * SELECTED PROJECTS APPEAR IN AGGREGATE CARGO REQUIREMENTS. CHANGES ARE SENT ONLY WHEN YOU CHOOSE SAVE SELECTION. >>>!

ps.translation: * SEND --- IN GAME CHAT TO CLEAR ALL RIGS AND SURFACE BOOKMARKS ON THE CURRENT BODY, INCLUDING RESOURCE, BIOLOGY, AND REGULAR TRACKER BOOKMARKS. THIS WORKS EVEN WHEN AUTOMATIC RIG CLEARING IS DISABLED AND DOES NOT ERASE SCAN HISTORY OR BOOKMARKS ON OTHER BODIES. >>>!

ps.source: To move an existing marker, clear it first, drive to the new position, and press its chord again to set it there.
ps.translation: * TO MOVE AN EXISTING MARKER, CLEAR IT FIRST, DRIVE TO THE NEW POSITION, AND PRESS ITS CHORD AGAIN TO SET IT THERE. >>>!

ps.source: Toggle first-footfall state for the current body.
ps.translation: * TOGGLE FIRST-FOOTFALL STATE FOR THE CURRENT BODY. >>>!

ps.source: Toggles a thin red vertical guide at the exact center of the Elite window. Use the Rhino driving view, place a distant mining-location circle under the guide, then read the visible game compass heading for the .mine command. Turret mode does not show the required heading. Run the command again to hide the guide.
ps.translation: * TOGGLES A THIN RED VERTICAL GUIDE AT THE EXACT CENTER OF THE ELITE WINDOW. USE THE RHINO DRIVING VIEW, PLACE A DISTANT MINING-LOCATION CIRCLE UNDER THE GUIDE, THEN READ THE VISIBLE GAME COMPASS HEADING FOR THE .MINE COMMAND. TURRET MODE DOES NOT SHOW THE REQUIRED HEADING. RUN THE COMMAND AGAIN TO HIDE THE GUIDE. >>>!

ps.source: Totals changed for this session but could not be saved: {0}
ps.translation: * TOTALS CHANGED FOR THIS SESSION BUT COULD NOT BE SAVED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Track Odyssey ground conflict-zone bonds and active ship massacre missions with the same journal rules as the original application.
ps.translation: * TRACK ODYSSEY GROUND CONFLICT-ZONE BONDS AND ACTIVE SHIP MASSACRE MISSIONS WITH THE SAME JOURNAL RULES AS THE ORIGINAL APPLICATION. >>>!

ps.source: Track active builds, choose which projects feed the cargo list, and inspect live construction requirements.
ps.translation: * TRACK ACTIVE BUILDS, CHOOSE WHICH PROJECTS FEED THE CARGO LIST, AND INSPECT LIVE CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS. >>>!

ps.source: Track and publish cargo on ship (Needs API Key)
ps.translation: * TRACK AND PUBLISH CARGO ON SHIP (NEEDS API KEY) >>>!

ps.source: Track the six rigs automatically from their HUD bars. Detection adds a missing tracker immediately and clears its location only after three continuous seconds of empty readings.
ps.translation: * TRACK THE SIX RIGS AUTOMATICALLY FROM THEIR HUD BARS. DETECTION ADDS A MISSING TRACKER IMMEDIATELY AND CLEARS ITS LOCATION ONLY AFTER THREE CONTINUOUS SECONDS OF EMPTY READINGS. >>>!

ps.source: Trailblazers cargo - before: {0:N0} bought / {1:N0} sold / {2:N0} transferred; after: {3:N0} / {4:N0} / {5:N0}.
ps.translation: * TRAILBLAZERS CARGO - BEFORE: {0:N0} BOUGHT / {1:N0} SOLD / {2:N0} TRANSFERRED; AFTER: {3:N0} / {4:N0} / {5:N0}. >>>!

ps.source: Transferred update ownership has no installation plan.
ps.translation: * TRANSFERRED UPDATE OWNERSHIP HAS NO INSTALLATION PLAN. >>>!

ps.source: Travel → Distance follows FC Routes. Calculate distances and save a home system there.
ps.translation: * TRAVEL → DISTANCE FOLLOWS FC ROUTES. CALCULATE DISTANCES AND SAVE A HOME SYSTEM THERE. >>>!

ps.source: Treat systems visited before the start date as complete
ps.translation: * TREAT SYSTEMS VISITED BEFORE THE START DATE AS COMPLETE >>>!

ps.source: Treat systems whose Spansh body data predates the start date as complete
ps.translation: * TREAT SYSTEMS WHOSE SPANSH BODY DATA PREDATES THE START DATE AS COMPLETE >>>!

ps.source: Try a workspace name, overlay title, icon, journal event, setting, or task such as scanning, importing, or plotting a route.
ps.translation: * TRY A WORKSPACE NAME, OVERLAY TITLE, ICON, JOURNAL EVENT, SETTING, OR TASK SUCH AS SCANNING, IMPORTING, OR PLOTTING A ROUTE. >>>!

ps.source: Tune the FSS to a planet
ps.translation: * TUNE THE FSS TO A PLANET >>>!

ps.source: Two vehicle columns sit above the rig chevrons, with cargo capacity below them.
ps.translation: * TWO VEHICLE COLUMNS SIT ABOVE THE RIG CHEVRONS, WITH CARGO CAPACITY BELOW THEM. >>>!

ps.source: Type .add followed by a valid Guardian point type while at the point.
ps.translation: * TYPE .ADD FOLLOWED BY A VALID GUARDIAN POINT TYPE WHILE AT THE POINT. >>>!

ps.source: Type .note followed by text to append a site note.
ps.translation: * TYPE .NOTE FOLLOWED BY TEXT TO APPEND A SITE NOTE. >>>!

ps.source: Type .site <type> to select the mapped Guardian layout.
ps.translation: * TYPE .SITE <TYPE> TO SELECT THE MAPPED GUARDIAN LAYOUT. >>>!

ps.source: Type A, B, or G for common ruins layouts, or send .site followed by a supported layout name.
ps.translation: * TYPE A, B, OR G FOR COMMON RUINS LAYOUTS, OR SEND .SITE FOLLOWED BY A SUPPORTED LAYOUT NAME. >>>!

ps.source: Type A, B, or G for ruins, or .site <type> for any mapped Guardian layout.
ps.translation: * TYPE A, B, OR G FOR RUINS, OR .SITE <TYPE> FOR ANY MAPPED GUARDIAN LAYOUT. >>>!

ps.source: Type at least 3 characters for system suggestions.
ps.translation: * TYPE AT LEAST 3 CHARACTERS FOR SYSTEM SUGGESTIONS. >>>!

ps.source: Type more words to narrow the results
ps.translation: * TYPE MORE WORDS TO NARROW THE RESULTS >>>!

ps.source: Understand procedural boxels, run bounded system surveys, navigate nested search trees, and preserve multiple research projects.
ps.translation: * UNDERSTAND PROCEDURAL BOXELS, RUN BOUNDED SYSTEM SURVEYS, NAVIGATE NESTED SEARCH TREES, AND PRESERVE MULTIPLE RESEARCH PROJECTS. >>>!

ps.source: Understand the live Commander state, multi-Commander selection, and the difference between current-session and historical data.
ps.translation: * UNDERSTAND THE LIVE COMMANDER STATE, MULTI-COMMANDER SELECTION, AND THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN CURRENT-SESSION AND HISTORICAL DATA. >>>!

ps.source: Unknown compatible JSON fields are preserved where the modern store supports lossless merging. Incompatible reference catalogs are ignored safely and reported in logs.
ps.translation: * UNKNOWN COMPATIBLE JSON FIELDS ARE PRESERVED WHERE THE MODERN STORE SUPPORTS LOSSLESS MERGING. INCOMPATIBLE REFERENCE CATALOGS ARE IGNORED SAFELY AND REPORTED IN LOGS. >>>!

ps.source: Unknown coordinates are not treated as nearby. Bundled observations are historical; multiple hotspots alone do not establish an overlap. Local searches show at most 500 rings.
ps.translation: * UNKNOWN COORDINATES ARE NOT TREATED AS NEARBY. BUNDLED OBSERVATIONS ARE HISTORICAL; MULTIPLE HOTSPOTS ALONE DO NOT ESTABLISH AN OVERLAP. LOCAL SEARCHES SHOW AT MOST 500 RINGS. >>>!

ps.source: Unknown points use the cyan dotted survey treatment, absent points use translucent gray, present points use their POI-specific legacy color, and empty puddles use gold with a yellow edge.
ps.translation: * UNKNOWN POINTS USE THE CYAN DOTTED SURVEY TREATMENT, ABSENT POINTS USE TRANSLUCENT GRAY, PRESENT POINTS USE THEIR POI-SPECIFIC LEGACY COLOR, AND EMPTY PUDDLES USE GOLD WITH A YELLOW EDGE. >>>!

ps.source: Unread message counts are shown in the application and the compact quest indicator.
ps.translation: * UNREAD MESSAGE COUNTS ARE SHOWN IN THE APPLICATION AND THE COMPACT QUEST INDICATOR. >>>!

ps.source: Update cache cleanup retained an inaccessible directory: {0}
ps.translation: * UPDATE CACHE CLEANUP RETAINED AN INACCESSIBLE DIRECTORY: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Update canceled before installation handoff. The prepared candidate was removed and no files were changed.
ps.translation: * UPDATE CANCELED BEFORE INSTALLATION HANDOFF. THE PREPARED CANDIDATE WAS REMOVED AND NO FILES WERE CHANGED. >>>!

ps.source: Update canceled. The other SrvSurvey instances remain open and no files were changed.
ps.translation: * UPDATE CANCELED. THE OTHER SRVSURVEY INSTANCES REMAIN OPEN AND NO FILES WERE CHANGED. >>>!

ps.source: Update health confirmation did not come from the installed replacement.
ps.translation: * UPDATE HEALTH CONFIRMATION DID NOT COME FROM THE INSTALLED REPLACEMENT. >>>!

ps.source: Update helper outcome was not available for request {0} within {1}.
ps.translation: * UPDATE HELPER OUTCOME WAS NOT AVAILABLE FOR REQUEST {0} WITHIN {1}. >>>!

ps.source: Update history cleanup could not run: {0}
ps.translation: * UPDATE HISTORY CLEANUP COULD NOT RUN: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Update history cleanup retained an inaccessible directory: {0}
ps.translation: * UPDATE HISTORY CLEANUP RETAINED AN INACCESSIBLE DIRECTORY: {0} >>>!

ps.source: Update instance registration is unavailable; continuing with process-name and executable-path discovery. {0}
ps.translation: * UPDATE INSTANCE REGISTRATION IS UNAVAILABLE; CONTINUING WITH PROCESS-NAME AND EXECUTABLE-PATH DISCOVERY. {0} >>>!

ps.source: Update status has not been checked.
ps.translation: * UPDATE STATUS HAS NOT BEEN CHECKED. >>>!

ps.source: Update {0} was aborted before completion; the active installation was preserved.{1}
ps.translation: * UPDATE {0} WAS ABORTED BEFORE COMPLETION; THE ACTIVE INSTALLATION WAS PRESERVED.{1} >>>!

ps.source: Update {0} was rolled back; the previous installation was restored.{1}
ps.translation: * UPDATE {0} WAS ROLLED BACK; THE PREVIOUS INSTALLATION WAS RESTORED.{1} >>>!

ps.source: Updated {0} linked Fleet Carrier cargo entry(s) from {1}.
ps.translation: * UPDATED {0} LINKED FLEET CARRIER CARGO ENTRY(S) FROM {1}. >>>!

ps.source: Updated {0} linked squadron Fleet Carrier cargo entry(s) from ship cargo diff.
ps.translation: * UPDATED {0} LINKED SQUADRON FLEET CARRIER CARGO ENTRY(S) FROM SHIP CARGO DIFF. >>>!

ps.source: Updated {0}. A verified state backup was retained.
ps.translation: * UPDATED {0}. A VERIFIED STATE BACKUP WAS RETAINED. >>>!

ps.source: Upload newly calculated settlement geometry to Canonn
ps.translation: * UPLOAD NEWLY CALCULATED SETTLEMENT GEOMETRY TO CANONN >>>!

ps.source: Uploaded a {0} Green Gas Giant candidate.
ps.translation: * UPLOADED A {0} GREEN GAS GIANT CANDIDATE. >>>!

ps.source: Uploaded newly calculated settlement geometry to Canonn.
ps.translation: * UPLOADED NEWLY CALCULATED SETTLEMENT GEOMETRY TO CANONN. >>>!

ps.source: Uploaded settlement geometry for {0} to Canonn.
ps.translation: * UPLOADED SETTLEMENT GEOMETRY FOR {0} TO CANONN. >>>!

ps.source: Use .tower to record the nearest relic tower state, .empty for an empty puddle, and .note followed by text to append a site note.
ps.translation: * USE .TOWER TO RECORD THE NEAREST RELIC TOWER STATE, .EMPTY FOR AN EMPTY PUDDLE, AND .NOTE FOLLOWED BY TEXT TO APPEND A SITE NOTE. >>>!

ps.source: Use Add measured point only while the selected survey is the active site and valid surface position, body radius, site heading, and Commander position agree.
ps.translation: * USE ADD MEASURED POINT ONLY WHILE THE SELECTED SURVEY IS THE ACTIVE SITE AND VALID SURFACE POSITION, BODY RADIUS, SITE HEADING, AND COMMANDER POSITION AGREE. >>>!

ps.source: Use Audit all boxels when you need every branch refreshed against local history and Spansh rather than only the current boxel. Large audits require explicit confirmation because they can make more than 1,000 requests.
ps.translation: * USE AUDIT ALL BOXELS WHEN YOU NEED EVERY BRANCH REFRESHED AGAINST LOCAL HISTORY AND SPANSH RATHER THAN ONLY THE CURRENT BOXEL. LARGE AUDITS REQUIRE EXPLICIT CONFIRMATION BECAUSE THEY CAN MAKE MORE THAN 1,000 REQUESTS. >>>!

ps.source: Use Check All or Uncheck All, then select the allowed entries under Small, Medium, Large and Vessel / Vehicle. Changes save immediately.
ps.translation: * USE CHECK ALL OR UNCHECK ALL, THEN SELECT THE ALLOWED ENTRIES UNDER SMALL, MEDIUM, LARGE AND VESSEL / VEHICLE. CHANGES SAVE IMMEDIATELY. >>>!

ps.source: Use Clear primary only when you intentionally want aggregate planning across visible projects.
ps.translation: * USE CLEAR PRIMARY ONLY WHEN YOU INTENTIONALLY WANT AGGREGATE PLANNING ACROSS VISIBLE PROJECTS. >>>!

ps.source: Use Copy next, or enable Auto-copy next system in Galaxy Map, then paste the name into the Galaxy Map. Boxel, Route Manager, and FC Route auto-copy are mutually exclusive.
ps.translation: * USE COPY NEXT, OR ENABLE AUTO-COPY NEXT SYSTEM IN GALAXY MAP, THEN PASTE THE NAME INTO THE GALAXY MAP. BOXEL, ROUTE MANAGER, AND FC ROUTE AUTO-COPY ARE MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE. >>>!

ps.source: Use FSS, body, system, route, and screenshot tools without losing the familiar original-overlay cues.
ps.translation: * USE FSS, BODY, SYSTEM, ROUTE, AND SCREENSHOT TOOLS WITHOUT LOSING THE FAMILIAR ORIGINAL-OVERLAY CUES. >>>!

ps.source: Use Local discoveries / import journals to review your own scans and import earlier journals. Search destinations returns to online/local combined searching. Provider page starts at 0; station searches use 20 results per page.
ps.translation: * USE LOCAL DISCOVERIES / IMPORT JOURNALS TO REVIEW YOUR OWN SCANS AND IMPORT EARLIER JOURNALS. SEARCH DESTINATIONS RETURNS TO ONLINE/LOCAL COMBINED SEARCHING. PROVIDER PAGE STARTS AT 0; STATION SEARCHES USE 20 RESULTS PER PAGE. >>>!

ps.source: Use Mark Next Empty only when the Galaxy Map confirms that the next incomplete system does not exist. The marker is retained and the search skips to the following target.
ps.translation: * USE MARK NEXT EMPTY ONLY WHEN THE GALAXY MAP CONFIRMS THAT THE NEXT INCOMPLETE SYSTEM DOES NOT EXIST. THE MARKER IS RETAINED AND THE SEARCH SKIPS TO THE FOLLOWING TARGET. >>>!

ps.source: Use Next Elite window when several game clients are open and an overlay needs to follow a different window.
ps.translation: * USE NEXT ELITE WINDOW WHEN SEVERAL GAME CLIENTS ARE OPEN AND AN OVERLAY NEEDS TO FOLLOW A DIFFERENT WINDOW. >>>!

ps.source: Use Refresh boxel to merge systems from the local Commander profile, the active route, and Spansh. Community databases contain only submitted observations, so an unknown system is not proof that it does not exist.
ps.translation: * USE REFRESH BOXEL TO MERGE SYSTEMS FROM THE LOCAL COMMANDER PROFILE, THE ACTIVE ROUTE, AND SPANSH. COMMUNITY DATABASES CONTAIN ONLY SUBMITTED OBSERVATIONS, SO AN UNKNOWN SYSTEM IS NOT PROOF THAT IT DOES NOT EXIST. >>>!

ps.source: Use Settings > Overlay behavior and layout to disable individual overlays or change their triggers.
ps.translation: * USE SETTINGS > OVERLAY BEHAVIOR AND LAYOUT TO DISABLE INDIVIDUAL OVERLAYS OR CHANGE THEIR TRIGGERS. >>>!

ps.source: Use Show system notes to edit notes for the current system without leaving the game context.
ps.translation: * USE SHOW SYSTEM NOTES TO EDIT NOTES FOR THE CURRENT SYSTEM WITHOUT LEAVING THE GAME CONTEXT. >>>!

ps.source: Use Size−/Size+ for circle diameter, Height−/Height+ for oval proportions, and R−/R+ for outline rotation. Gap−/Gap+ move the cyan bar curves closer to or farther below the circles without changing the outlines. Align them with the middle of the deployed rig's segmented bar. The curves show the expected bar shape; detection groups matching colored segments and ignores neutral circle outlines. Each circle centre can be positioned independently to match the sloping cockpit HUD.
ps.translation: * USE SIZE−/SIZE+ FOR CIRCLE DIAMETER, HEIGHT−/HEIGHT+ FOR OVAL PROPORTIONS, AND R−/R+ FOR OUTLINE ROTATION. GAP−/GAP+ MOVE THE CYAN BAR CURVES CLOSER TO OR FARTHER BELOW THE CIRCLES WITHOUT CHANGING THE OUTLINES. ALIGN THEM WITH THE MIDDLE OF THE DEPLOYED RIG'S SEGMENTED BAR. THE CURVES SHOW THE EXPECTED BAR SHAPE; DETECTION GROUPS MATCHING COLORED SEGMENTS AND IGNORES NEUTRAL CIRCLE OUTLINES. EACH CIRCLE CENTRE CAN BE POSITIONED INDEPENDENTLY TO MATCH THE SLOPING COCKPIT HUD. >>>!

ps.source: Use Stop search when you want the live Boxel workflow inactive while retaining both its current profile state and its linked library progress.
ps.translation: * USE STOP SEARCH WHEN YOU WANT THE LIVE BOXEL WORKFLOW INACTIVE WHILE RETAINING BOTH ITS CURRENT PROFILE STATE AND ITS LINKED LIBRARY PROGRESS. >>>!

ps.source: Use Track location 1 through 8 shortcuts to toggle reusable surface bookmarks.
ps.translation: * USE TRACK LOCATION 1 THROUGH 8 SHORTCUTS TO TOGGLE REUSABLE SURFACE BOOKMARKS. >>>!

ps.source: Use Up and Down to move, Enter to open the selected setting, or Escape to clear the search.
ps.translation: * USE UP AND DOWN TO MOVE, ENTER TO OPEN THE SELECTED SETTING, OR ESCAPE TO CLEAR THE SEARCH. >>>!

ps.source: Use a persisted folder for non-default Windows installations, Proton prefixes, and copied profiles.
ps.translation: * USE A PERSISTED FOLDER FOR NON-DEFAULT WINDOWS INSTALLATIONS, PROTON PREFIXES, AND COPIED PROFILES. >>>!

ps.source: Use body type, geology, and stellar clues to narrow the search for a surface-mining commodity. Prices are a community snapshot and can change.
ps.translation: * USE BODY TYPE, GEOLOGY, AND STELLAR CLUES TO NARROW THE SEARCH FOR A SURFACE-MINING COMMODITY. PRICES ARE A COMMUNITY SNAPSHOT AND CAN CHANGE. >>>!

ps.source: Use current restores the active Commander system as the distance origin.
ps.translation: * USE CURRENT RESTORES THE ACTIVE COMMANDER SYSTEM AS THE DISTANCE ORIGIN. >>>!

ps.source: Use downloaded bio data from Canonn and Spansh
ps.translation: * USE DOWNLOADED BIO DATA FROM CANONN AND SPANSH >>>!

ps.source: Use last updated time from Spansh not EDSM
ps.translation: * USE LAST UPDATED TIME FROM SPANSH NOT EDSM >>>!

ps.source: Use one of the five original Guardian plotter sizes.
ps.translation: * USE ONE OF THE FIVE ORIGINAL GUARDIAN PLOTTER SIZES. >>>!

ps.source: Use only one EDDN uploader at a time. Disable sharing in SrvSurvey when EDMC or another application already publishes the same events.
ps.translation: * USE ONLY ONE EDDN UPLOADER AT A TIME. DISABLE SHARING IN SRVSURVEY WHEN EDMC OR ANOTHER APPLICATION ALREADY PUBLISHES THE SAME EVENTS. >>>!

ps.source: Use the Boxel workspace after choosing a procedurally generated system whose surrounding sequence you want to survey.
ps.translation: * USE THE BOXEL WORKSPACE AFTER CHOOSING A PROCEDURALLY GENERATED SYSTEM WHOSE SURROUNDING SEQUENCE YOU WANT TO SURVEY. >>>!

ps.source: Use the Composition Scanner to identify organisms.
ps.translation: * USE THE COMPOSITION SCANNER TO IDENTIFY ORGANISMS. >>>!

ps.source: Use the Multiple commanders card on Overview to launch an isolated SrvSurvey process for another saved profile.
ps.translation: * USE THE MULTIPLE COMMANDERS CARD ON OVERVIEW TO LAUNCH AN ISOLATED SRVSURVEY PROCESS FOR ANOTHER SAVED PROFILE. >>>!

ps.source: Use the Raven links when you need to review a project or system in the website.
ps.translation: * USE THE RAVEN LINKS WHEN YOU NEED TO REVIEW A PROJECT OR SYSTEM IN THE WEBSITE. >>>!

ps.source: Use the Rhino mining radar, rig key chords, vehicle guidance, and cargo display while working on a planetary surface.
ps.translation: * USE THE RHINO MINING RADAR, RIG KEY CHORDS, VEHICLE GUIDANCE, AND CARGO DISPLAY WHILE WORKING ON A PLANETARY SURFACE. >>>!

ps.source: Use the check button to save every staged position, or X to close and restore the original layout.
ps.translation: * USE THE CHECK BUTTON TO SAVE EVERY STAGED POSITION, OR X TO CLOSE AND RESTORE THE ORIGINAL LAYOUT. >>>!

ps.source: Use the configurable jump-information shortcut to show or hide the route overlay manually.
ps.translation: * USE THE CONFIGURABLE JUMP-INFORMATION SHORTCUT TO SHOW OR HIDE THE ROUTE OVERLAY MANUALLY. >>>!

ps.source: Use the global overlay visibility shortcut when you need to hide or restore every detached overlay at once.
ps.translation: * USE THE GLOBAL OVERLAY VISIBILITY SHORTCUT WHEN YOU NEED TO HIDE OR RESTORE EVERY DETACHED OVERLAY AT ONCE. >>>!

ps.source: Use the most recent visit to {0}.
ps.translation: * USE THE MOST RECENT VISIT TO {0}. >>>!

ps.source: Use the mouse wheel or − / + controls to zoom. Drag the map to pan after zooming in. Right-click to place or remove a 4.5 km planning circle; hold the right button and drag to move it.
ps.translation: * USE THE MOUSE WHEEL OR − / + CONTROLS TO ZOOM. DRAG THE MAP TO PAN AFTER ZOOMING IN. RIGHT-CLICK TO PLACE OR REMOVE A 4.5 KM PLANNING CIRCLE; HOLD THE RIGHT BUTTON AND DRAG TO MOVE IT. >>>!

ps.source: Use the origin guidance to align an aerial screenshot. Type .map to return.
ps.translation: * USE THE ORIGIN GUIDANCE TO ALIGN AN AERIAL SCREENSHOT. TYPE .MAP TO RETURN. >>>!

ps.source: Use the original SrvSurvey shortcuts while either this application or Elite Dangerous has focus.
ps.translation: * USE THE ORIGINAL SRVSURVEY SHORTCUTS WHILE EITHER THIS APPLICATION OR ELITE DANGEROUS HAS FOCUS. >>>!

ps.source: Use the original local-flora naming contract, retain an imported image cache, or download biology references for offline browsing.
ps.translation: * USE THE ORIGINAL LOCAL-FLORA NAMING CONTRACT, RETAIN AN IMPORTED IMAGE CACHE, OR DOWNLOAD BIOLOGY REFERENCES FOR OFFLINE BROWSING. >>>!

ps.source: Use the overlay color and warning text to distinguish valid in-radius destinations, out-of-radius systems, low mass codes, and already-surveyed systems.
ps.translation: * USE THE OVERLAY COLOR AND WARNING TEXT TO DISTINGUISH VALID IN-RADIUS DESTINATIONS, OUT-OF-RADIUS SYSTEMS, LOW MASS CODES, AND ALREADY-SURVEYED SYSTEMS. >>>!

ps.source: Use the overlay position editor to move or resize the panel. Its colors follow the selected overlay theme, including Monochrome Companion.
ps.translation: * USE THE OVERLAY POSITION EDITOR TO MOVE OR RESIZE THE PANEL. ITS COLORS FOLLOW THE SELECTED OVERLAY THEME, INCLUDING MONOCHROME COMPANION. >>>!

ps.source: Use the overlay-settings icon beside a supported navigation category to open only that activity's overlay controls. The main Settings workspace remains the complete view.
ps.translation: * USE THE OVERLAY-SETTINGS ICON BESIDE A SUPPORTED NAVIGATION CATEGORY TO OPEN ONLY THAT ACTIVITY'S OVERLAY CONTROLS. THE MAIN SETTINGS WORKSPACE REMAINS THE COMPLETE VIEW. >>>!

ps.source: Use the quest communications shortcut to show or hide the overlay without stopping the quest.
ps.translation: * USE THE QUEST COMMUNICATIONS SHORTCUT TO SHOW OR HIDE THE OVERLAY WITHOUT STOPPING THE QUEST. >>>!

ps.source: Use the screenshot-data shortcut to enable or disable banners for future images.
ps.translation: * USE THE SCREENSHOT-DATA SHORTCUT TO ENABLE OR DISABLE BANNERS FOR FUTURE IMAGES. >>>!

ps.source: Use the sidebar icon at the top-right of the navigation column to collapse it into a narrow strip and give the current workspace more room. The same icon restores navigation; your selected workspace stays open and the window keeps its size.
ps.translation: * USE THE SIDEBAR ICON AT THE TOP-RIGHT OF THE NAVIGATION COLUMN TO COLLAPSE IT INTO A NARROW STRIP AND GIVE THE CURRENT WORKSPACE MORE ROOM. THE SAME ICON RESTORES NAVIGATION; YOUR SELECTED WORKSPACE STAYS OPEN AND THE WINDOW KEEPS ITS SIZE. >>>!

ps.source: Use the smallest targeted recovery before considering a profile import or reset.
ps.translation: * USE THE SMALLEST TARGETED RECOVERY BEFORE CONSIDERING A PROFILE IMPORT OR RESET. >>>!

ps.source: Useful actions include overlay visibility, live interaction, map zoom, jump/FSS/body/station panels, colony shopping, system notes, boxel copy/paste, quest communications, VR adjustment, surface bookmarks, and screenshot data.
ps.translation: * USEFUL ACTIONS INCLUDE OVERLAY VISIBILITY, LIVE INTERACTION, MAP ZOOM, JUMP/FSS/BODY/STATION PANELS, COLONY SHOPPING, SYSTEM NOTES, BOXEL COPY/PASTE, QUEST COMMUNICATIONS, VR ADJUSTMENT, SURFACE BOOKMARKS, AND SCREENSHOT DATA. >>>!

ps.source: Uses carriers linked in RavenColonial. Cargo updates follow the existing colonization sync settings.
ps.translation: * USES CARRIERS LINKED IN RAVENCOLONIAL. CARGO UPDATES FOLLOW THE EXISTING COLONIZATION SYNC SETTINGS. >>>!

ps.source: Uses current Spansh station data for pads, economies, faction, relevant services, and prohibited commodities. Alt+I toggles the overlay manually.
ps.translation: * USES CURRENT SPANSH STATION DATA FOR PADS, ECONOMIES, FACTION, RELEVANT SERVICES, AND PROHIBITED COMMODITIES. ALT+I TOGGLES THE OVERLAY MANUALLY. >>>!

ps.source: Uses the Spansh system timestamp instead of the newest EDSM body timestamp in Jump Info and Galaxy Map summaries. This is a read-only lookup and does not publish journal data.
ps.translation: * USES THE SPANSH SYSTEM TIMESTAMP INSTEAD OF THE NEWEST EDSM BODY TIMESTAMP IN JUMP INFO AND GALAXY MAP SUMMARIES. THIS IS A READ-ONLY LOOKUP AND DOES NOT PUBLISH JOURNAL DATA. >>>!

ps.source: Uses the original SrvSurvey translations where available. New port-only text falls back to English.
ps.translation: * USES THE ORIGINAL SRVSURVEY TRANSLATIONS WHERE AVAILABLE. NEW PORT-ONLY TEXT FALLS BACK TO ENGLISH. >>>!

ps.source: Uses the same body-class, terraformability, discovery, mapping, Odyssey, and probe-efficiency formula as the WinForms application.
ps.translation: * USES THE SAME BODY-CLASS, TERRAFORMABILITY, DISCOVERY, MAPPING, ODYSSEY, AND PROBE-EFFICIENCY FORMULA AS THE WINFORMS APPLICATION. >>>!

ps.source: Using separate native overlay windows for the current desktop host.
ps.translation: * USING SEPARATE NATIVE OVERLAY WINDOWS FOR THE CURRENT DESKTOP HOST. >>>!

ps.source: Using {0} validated catalog(s) from the imported legacy profile; all others use embedded defaults.
ps.translation: * USING {0} VALIDATED CATALOG(S) FROM THE IMPORTED LEGACY PROFILE; ALL OTHERS USE EMBEDDED DEFAULTS. >>>!

ps.source: VR calibration '{0}' must be a string.
ps.translation: * VR CALIBRATION '{0}' MUST BE A STRING. >>>!

ps.source: VR calibrations could not be loaded: {0}
ps.translation: * VR CALIBRATIONS COULD NOT BE LOADED: {0} >>>!

ps.source: VR overlay adjustment captures and resets orientation through dedicated actions; capability and status are reported when the runtime is unavailable.
ps.translation: * VR OVERLAY ADJUSTMENT CAPTURES AND RESETS ORIENTATION THROUGH DEDICATED ACTIONS; CAPABILITY AND STATUS ARE REPORTED WHEN THE RUNTIME IS UNAVAILABLE. >>>!

ps.source: VR override '{0}/{1}' could not be verified before saving.
ps.translation: * VR OVERRIDE '{0}/{1}' COULD NOT BE VERIFIED BEFORE SAVING. >>>!

ps.source: VR scale must be from 0.1 to 50 and all coordinates must be finite.
ps.translation: * VR SCALE MUST BE FROM 0.1 TO 50 AND ALL COORDINATES MUST BE FINITE. >>>!

ps.source: Validated embedded reference catalogs are active.
ps.translation: * VALIDATED EMBEDDED REFERENCE CATALOGS ARE ACTIVE. >>>!

ps.source: Validating the Raven API key without saving it...
ps.translation: * VALIDATING THE RAVEN API KEY WITHOUT SAVING IT... >>>!

ps.source: Verification complete; restarting SrvSurvey with the migrated profile...
ps.translation: * VERIFICATION COMPLETE; RESTARTING SRVSURVEY WITH THE MIGRATED PROFILE... >>>!

ps.source: Verified update replacement startup with the handoff helper.
ps.translation: * VERIFIED UPDATE REPLACEMENT STARTUP WITH THE HANDOFF HELPER. >>>!

ps.source: Very unforgiving; small mistakes = hull damage or death
ps.translation: * VERY UNFORGIVING; SMALL MISTAKES = HULL DAMAGE OR DEATH >>>!

ps.source: Visible live overlays are clickable and can be dragged. Use the shortcut again to save and restore click-through mode.
ps.translation: * VISIBLE LIVE OVERLAYS ARE CLICKABLE AND CAN BE DRAGGED. USE THE SHORTCUT AGAIN TO SAVE AND RESTORE CLICK-THROUGH MODE. >>>!

ps.source: Visit the selected site before editing its commander survey.
